We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale. 

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

- Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

- The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

- Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

- We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

- A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

- Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

- You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

- A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

- Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

- Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

- Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work 

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation 

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

- Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes. 
- Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements. 
- Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed. 
- Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise. 
- Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility. 
- Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port. 
- Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures. 

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

- Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
- Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
- Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work. 
- Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required. 

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

- Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy. 
- Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations. 
- Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format. 
- Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities. 
- Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work. 
- Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery. 
- Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise. 
- Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions. 
- Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others. 
- Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems. 

Physical Requirements:

- Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory. 
- The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively. 
- The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential. 
- Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment. 
- Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling. 
- The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities. 
- Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs. 
- The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required. 
- Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required. 

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

Notice

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

title: Product Manager, Homepage
description:
About Wolt 

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

What You'll Be Doing 

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

- Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.

- Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.

- Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.

- Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

What You'll Need to Thrive 

Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

- Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.

- You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.

- You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.

- You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.

- You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.

- You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.

- You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).

- You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. 

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Strategy - Senior Business Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Kurz und knapp

Du suchst nicht nur einen Job, sondern eine Spielwiese, auf der du die Zukunft des E-Commerce aktiv mitgestaltest? Bei uns übernimmst du dabei die Rolle eines Inhouse Consultants: Du verbindest Strategie, Technologie und das tägliche Einkaufserlebnis von Hunderttausenden KundInnen.

Das erwartet dich 

- 
End-to-End Projektmanagement: Du konzipierst und steuerst Projekte zur Optimierung unserer App-Storefront und des digitalen Einkaufserlebnisses.

- 
Business Development: Du identifizierst Potenziale zur Steigerung von Kundenzufriedenheit und kommerziellem Erfolg (Marge, Conversion, Retention) und setzt diese eigenverantwortlich um.

- 
Schnittstellenfunktion: Du agierst als Brückenbauer zwischen Category Management, Tech-Teams und dem Marketing, um komplexe Kampagnen und Features erfolgreich auszurollen.

- 
Data-Driven Decisions: Mittels A/B-Tests, Zielgruppenanalysen und KPI-Monitoring (Besucherzahlen, Absatz etc.) validierst du deine Ideen und optimierst unsere Plattform kontinuierlich.

- 
Operative Exzellenz: Du hast die Fäden in der Hand - von der strategischen Planung bis hin zur präzisen Umsetzung sichtbarer Änderungen in der App.

Das bringst du mit 

- Ein abgeschlossenes Masterstudium (Wirtschaft, Marketing, Analytics oder vergleichbar)

- Fließende Deutsch- und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse 

- 2+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in einem dynamischen Umfeld (E-Commerce, Consulting, LEH oder Start-up)

- Starke Projektmanagement-Fähigkeiten, ein Auge für Details und die Fähigkeit, auch unter Hochdruck strukturiert zu arbeiten.

- Du hast eine Affinität für Daten und bringst idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit SQL oder relationalen Datenbanken mit.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

- Starte mit uns durch: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Treibe Projekte eigenständig voran, teste neue Ideen und profitiere von Trainings, während du den Erfolg unseres Unternehmens direkt mitgestaltest.

- Verpflegung: Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück und Mittagessen in unserem Büro, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.

- Unvergessliche Momente: Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.

- Ein moderner Workspace: Unser neu renoviertes Büro ist auf Zusammenarbeit ausgelegt und bietet dir flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie 30 Urlaubstage.

- Individuelle Mobilität : Du entscheidest, wie du zu uns kommst. Wir bieten ein subventioniertes Deutschlandticket und ein „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm an.

- Wohlbefinden & Gleichgewicht: Wir bieten dir professionelle Unterstützung für deine mentale Gesundheit mit OpenUp. Und dank unseres hundefreundlichen Büros ist dein vierbeiniger Begleiter nach Absprache willkommen.

- Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.

- Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und unsere Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.

- You bring together internal resources that enable you to be successful sales professional

- You will navigate negotiations with professionalism, understanding the art of give-and-take

- By joining Qualtrics, you become part of a team that dares to pursue groundbreaking experiences.

- Our mission is to build technology that positively impacts businesses and makes them more human.

- Maintaining a real-time understanding of Qualtrics' solution offerings and the competitive landscape to assist in figuring out win-based proposals and pricing

- Challenges excite us, as we view them as opportunities for growth and positive transformation.

- We are not merely observers of change; we actively initiate and drive it.

- Qualtrics Experience Program - A bonus each year for an experience of your choosing

- At Qualtrics we are constantly working to create an environment where everyone feels safe and comfortable coming to work and can, as a result of our culture, make their best possible contribution to our team

CarOnSale ist die KI-gestützte Plattform für den B2B-Gebrauchtwagenhandel in Europa. One Platform. One Profit Engine.

Was du mitbringst

- Mindestens zwei Jahre Führungserfahrung mit einem Vertriebsteam von mehr als sechs Personen

- Erfahrung im Außendienst sowie im Hunting- und Farming-Modell

- Erfahrung im Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger, komplexer Produkte – du überzeugst mit Argumenten und gibst dieses Wissen an dein Team weiter

- Erfahrung im Teamaufbau und Performance-Coaching, mit operativer Nähe zum Tagesgeschäft

- Virtual Stock Options – du beteiligst dich am Erfolg

Bewirb dich jetzt – dein Lebenslauf reicht.

- Verantworte Initiativen End-to-End : von Research und Business Case über Priorisierung, Briefing und Umsetzung bis zur Messung des tatsächlichen Impacts – und passe deine Strategie datenbasiert an.

Dein Profil 

- Du bringst mehrjährige, fundierte SEO-Erfahrung mit und hast bereits eigenständig größere SEO-, Organic-Growth- oder Search-Initiativen entwickelt und umgesetzt – idealerweise für größere Websites, Plattformen, Marketplaces oder andere komplexe digitale Produkte.

- Du kannst konkrete Beispiele nennen, bei denen deine Entscheidungen zu messbaren Verbesserungen bei organischer Sichtbarkeit, Traffic, Conversion, Leads oder anderen Business-KPIs geführt haben.

- Du verfügst über ein sehr gutes Verständnis von Search Intent, Content SEO, Informationsarchitektur, interner Verlinkung und technischen SEO-Grundlagen und kannst beurteilen, welche Hebel den größten Impact versprechen.

- AI Search, AEO und GEO sind für dich mehr als Buzzwords: Du beschäftigst dich aktiv damit, wie sich Search verändert, experimentierst mit neuen Ansätzen und kannst klassische SEO-Prinzipien auf neue Search Experiences übertragen. Wir erwarten dabei nicht, dass du bereits jahrelange AEO-Erfahrung mitbringst.

title: Flight Software Architect
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

The Flight Software Architect plays a key role in defining and maintaining the software architecture for our spacecraft flight software. The role ensures that the flight software architecture meets mission needs, system-level requirements, and safety and reliability objectives, while remaining scalable, maintainable, and suitable for the evolving needs of our spacecraft platforms. Working closely with Flight Software, Systems Engineering, Avionics, GNC, Mission Operations, and other functional disciplines, the Flight Software Architect drives architectural decisions, technical consistency, and the integration of software across the spacecraft.

Key Responsibilities 

In your capacity as Flight Software Architect, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

What we would love to see from you 

- Software architecture & design — Define, develop, and maintain the overall flight software architecture, including software components, interfaces, data flows, and execution models, ensuring alignment with spacecraft system architecture and mission objectives.

- Technical leadership & architectural decisions — Drive key architectural decisions and establish design principles, technical standards, and best practices for flight software development. Provide technical guidance to software engineers and ensure consistency across software components and development activities.

- System integration & interfaces — Define and coordinate software interfaces with avionics, onboard computers, sensors, actuators, GNC, communication systems, and other spacecraft subsystems. Ensure robust integration across functional disciplines and support the resolution of cross-system technical challenges.

- Requirements & traceability — Translate mission and system-level requirements into software architectural requirements, design constraints, and interface specifications. Ensure traceability between requirements, architecture, implementation, and verification, working closely with Systems Engineering and functional chain owners.

- Reliability, safety & performance — Ensure that architectural decisions address fault tolerance, robustness, timing constraints, resource utilization, failure detection and recovery, and overall spacecraft reliability. Contribute to safety analyses, failure management strategies, and the definition of appropriate software verification and validation approaches.

- Verification, validation & technical risk management — Identify and mitigate architectural risks, assess technical trade-offs, and support design reviews, integration campaigns, and verification activities. Ensure that the architecture is validated against mission requirements and that critical technical assumptions are verified early in the development lifecycle.

- Cross-functional collaboration & technical communication — Act as a technical reference for flight software architecture, facilitating alignment between Flight Software, Systems Engineering, Avionics, GNC, Mission Operations, and external partners, including ESA where applicable. Communicate architectural decisions, constraints, and trade-offs clearly to both technical teams and project stakeholders.

In the role of Flight Software Architect, ideally, you will have the following: 

- 10–15 years of professional experience in software engineering, including substantial experience in flight software, embedded software, or safety- and mission-critical systems.

- Proven experience defining and evolving software architectures for complex critical software systems , ideally for spacecraft, launch vehicles, satellites, or other aerospace applications.

- Strong knowledge of real-time embedded software , operating systems, hardware–software interfaces, resource-constrained computing, and distributed or fault-tolerant systems.

- Experience translating system-level requirements into software architectures, interface specifications, and verification strategies.

- A solid understanding of software integration, testing, verification and validation, and configuration and change management in a complex engineering environment.

- Experience with architectural trade-off analysis, technical risk management, and making sound engineering decisions under performance, reliability, schedule, and resource constraints.

- The ability to work effectively across multiple engineering disciplines and align stakeholders around clear technical solutions.

- Strong structured thinking, analytical skills, and the ability to simplify complex technical challenges into robust and maintainable architectures.

- Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions, document design rationale, and provide technical guidance to multidisciplinary teams.

- A strong ownership mindset, a pragmatic approach to problem-solving, and a passion for developing reliable software that enables humanity’s exploration of space.

Why you should join us! 

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is: 

- We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

- We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them 

- We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?

title: MAIT Additive Manufacturing Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

We want you as a talented MAIT Additive Manufacturing Engineer to help us in our mission by contributing significantly to Additive Manufacturing (AM) technology, development and in-house production for our Vehicles Nyx Earth and Nyx Moon.

The ideal candidate will play a key role as an MAIT Additive Manufacturing Engineer, working on the development and qualification of additive manufacturing (AM) processes, including the definition of print parameters for new materials. This role will also involve supporting the certification of AM components to comply with high industry standards, including NASA regulations. 

Role Overview 

As an MAIT Additive Manufacturing Engineer, you will play a key role in the development, qualification, and industrialization of Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) technologies for critical aerospace hardware.

You will support the full lifecycle of aerospace hardware, from manufacturability assessment and process development through qualification, certification, and production readiness. Working closely with Design Engineering, Materials & Processes, Quality, Testing, and Manufacturing teams, you will contribute to the delivery of flight-ready components across TEC's propulsion and space systems programs.

This is a technically demanding role with direct impact on flight hardware development, manufacturing capability, and future production scalability.

Key Responsibilities 

- Own the manufacturing and qualification of mission-critical flight hardware.

- Develop, optimize, and qualify LPBF processes for a range of high-performance alloys.

- Define and manage material characterization campaigns, support test execution, and analyze the resulting data.

- Take over build preparation, LPBF process simulation, and process monitoring data analysis.

- Execute qualification and certification activities for AM hardware in accordance with aerospace requirements and internal quality processes.

- Troubleshoot manufacturing challenges and drive continuous improvement in process capability, quality, productivity, and inspection methodologies.

- Author technical documentation and collaborate with internal teams, external suppliers, laboratories, and certification bodies.

Required Qualifications 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Aerospace Engineering, or related field.

- Hands-on experience with metal LPBF systems in an industrial environment.

- Experience in LPBF process development, material and part verification.

- Knowledge in material characterization methodologies, including the selection and interpretation of material property and mechanical testing data.

- Proficiency in CAD for part design modification, LPBF build design, and support generation. Experience with Siemens NX and PLM tools such as Teamcenter is a plus.

- Strong communication, analytical problem-solving, and effective collaboration across multidisciplinary and international teams.

- Fluent in English.

Preferred Qualifications 

- 3+ years of experience in LPBF process and hardware qualification for complex aerospace propulsion systems.

- Strong understanding of DFAM principles, LPBF process physics and parameters.

- Familiarity with aerospace materials such as nickel-based superalloys, titanium alloys, copper alloys, as well as stainless steels. Refractory alloys is a plus.

- Hands-on experience in machine operation, material characterization, including metallography, microstructural characterization, and mechanical testing.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Agents (m/f/x)
description:
About this role 

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Agentic SOC team. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. This team's mission is to build LLM-powered agents that augment our security analysts, taking on repetitive investigation and triage work so humans can focus on the judgment-heavy parts of the job.

You will work in a small, full-stack team of 2 to 3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets, and who is excited about shipping agents into a real production SOC where correctness, latency, and cost all matter.

In this role 

- Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production. You are trusted to take a high-level goal and turn it into a plan without close supervision.

- Lead the design and delivery of LLM agents that plug into our SOC workflows, including tool design, prompt and context engineering, evals, and guardrails. Make sound tradeoffs on accuracy, cost, latency, and how much autonomy to give the agent versus keeping a human in the loop.

- Drive technical design discussions in your stream and, where the work calls for it, influence architecture and standards beyond it. Set the bar for code quality, testing, and documentation on your team.

- Ground engineering decisions in outcomes. Push back when the "why" is unclear, propose simpler or faster paths to the business result, and stay close to the security analysts and customers your agents are meant to serve.

- Mentor engineers on your team and across the stream through pairing, code review, and design feedback. Act as a multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor.

- Participate in hiring: interview candidates, help shape the bar, and support onboarding.

- Contribute to a psychologically safe and outcome-oriented team culture. Lead by example in incidents and high-pressure moments.

- The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, with a commitment to travel to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week.

What you will need 

- 5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently.

- Depth in at least one technical area and broad competence across the stack. You have designed and shipped systems where performance, security, reliability, and maintainability all mattered, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made.

- Experience with strongly typed languages (Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP, or similar). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our stack quickly.

- Hands-on experience building LLM agents, with evidence they were useful. You have built and shipped at least one non-trivial LLM-powered agent or agentic workflow, in production or as a side project with real users. You can speak concretely about the design choices you made around tool use, context and state, evals, failure handling, autonomy, cost, and latency and, just as importantly, what the agent changed for the people using it.

- Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow.

- A track record of raising the level of engineers around you through mentoring, code review, and design feedback.

- Strong communication skills. You can translate technical tradeoffs for engineers, product managers, and leadership, and you write designs and decisions in a way others can build on.

- Knowledge of secure coding practices and secure development principles to build safe, trusted systems.

- Fluency in English is a must.

What we offer 

- Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe.

- Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact.

- A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering and AI-augmented security operations: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice for both how we build and how our SOC operates.

- Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure.

- Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.

- Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe.

- We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together.

About Eye Security 

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply!

PlaytestCloud’s Player Insights Platform™ helps game studios improve their games through feedback from real players. Over 60% of the top-grossing game studios have tested their games with PlaytestCloud.

🏆 Independent and established. We are bootstrapped and profitable, with more than 400 paying game studios and over one million playtesters. 

Our player community 

PlaytestCloud runs one of the largest proprietary player panels in games: a large, growing, global community of players who take part because they care about making the games they play better. 

This isn't a role where you're building a panel from scratch. You'll be advising a mature Research Operations team that's already investing in the long-term health, quality, and strategic development of that community. 

Our goal is simple: help game studios make better decisions through real player insight. You'll play a central role in keeping that community trusted, representative, engaged, and ready for what game developers need next. 

About the role 

We're hiring an experienced, analytical Panel Manager (f/m/d) to shape the next stage of PlaytestCloud's proprietary player panel. Your job: figure out what makes a panel strong and scalable, then turn that understanding into measurable action. You'll identify the metrics that matter most, find opportunities to improve panel quality and availability, and build a practical framework that helps us serve studios better as we grow. This is a freelance contract (3–6 months) with a clear mission: build a stronger foundation for how we measure, manage, and grow our player panel. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Panel strategy and ownership. Take ownership of the health and growth of PlaytestCloud's global player panel. 

- Metrics and insight. Define and track the metrics that connect panel performance, player experience, studio needs, and business growth. 

- Opportunity identification. Analyze panel data to find the highest-impact opportunities, constraints, and risks. 

- Actionable improvements. Turn insight into practical recommendations, and work with the right teams to implement and measure them. 

- Cross-functional collaboration. Partner closely with Research Operations, Product, and GTM to make sure the panel supports great outcomes for our studios. 

- Sustainable foundations. Set up a reporting rhythm, performance framework, and roadmap the team can keep using after the contract ends. 

Your profile 

Must-have: 

- Panel experience. Recent hands-on experience managing, running, growing, or optimizing a large participant panel, research-participant community, or gaming community — including participant supply, retention, quality, segmentation, and/or incentive strategy. 

- Commercial and analytical mindset. You know how to find the few metrics that actually matter, connect them to customer and business outcomes, and use data to make good calls. 

- Tool competency. Comfortable querying databases in SQL, and familiar with agentic AI tools like Claude or Codex. 

- Ownership. You're a self-starter who likes taking on an ambiguous challenge, building structure around it, and driving it forward on your own. 

- Practical problem-solving. You turn analysis into clear priorities and action, not insight for its own sake. 

- Strong communication. You can explain complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical people alike. 

- Strong English. Comfortable communicating in written and spoken English on a remote, international team. 

Great to have: 

- Qualitative research experience. Experience supporting or working closely with qualitative user research, including participant recruitment, study operations, interviews, usability testing, or research synthesis. 

- Games and player research. Interest in games, player research, or the gaming industry. Direct games-recruitment experience is not required.

title: Creative Strategist · Paid Social, KI-native (m/w/d)
description:
Warum es diese Stelle gibt

Infinos ist eine der größten Telemedizin-Plattformen für medizinische Abnehmtherapie in Deutschland. Wir machen einen mittleren 7-stelligen Jahresumsatz und haben bis heute kein Investorengeld genommen. Zwei Gründer, ein Team von rund 8 Leuten, tausende Patienten, die wir jeden Monat begleiten.

Ich bin Linus, einer der beiden Gründer und habe die Creatives für unsere Ads bisher zum großen Teil selbst gemacht. Das Marketing wächst schneller, als ich es neben allem anderen leisten kann. Deshalb suche ich die Person, die diesen Bereich übernimmt und mit uns ausbaut.

Was du machst

- Den Markt beobachten: was die Konkurrenz in Deutschland und im Ausland schaltet und was im Abnehmmarkt außerhalb der Medizin funktioniert.

- Daraus testbare Konzepte machen, jeweils mit klarer Hypothese und mehreren Hooks, und davon jede Woche neue an den Start bringen.

- Creatives selbst bauen, vor allem mit KI: Statics, Animationen und Schnitte aus vorhandenem Material.

- Drehs organisieren, mit uns Gründern, unserem Team und UGC-Creator, von Briefing und Skript bis zur Abnahme.

- Auswerten, was läuft und daraus die nächste Runde ableiten.

- Später dazu: unseren Newsletter und Shortform-Content für TikTok und Reels.

Deine ersten 90 Tage

- Woche 1: deine erste eigene Ad ist live.

- Monat 1: Marktbeobachtung und Ideenplanung laufen über dich und jede Woche gehen neue Tests von dir raus.

- Monat 3: du gibst deine Ads selbst frei, kennst die Regeln für Werbung im Gesundheitsbereich sicher und hast einen Plan, wie wir organisch auf Shortform wachsen.

Wen wir suchen

- Du hast schon Creatives für Paid Social gebaut, die gelaufen sind und weißt, warum sie funktioniert haben. Wie groß das Budget dahinter war, ist zweitrangig.

- Du baust selbst, statt nur zu briefen, und arbeitest dafür täglich mit KI-Tools für Bild, Video, Stimme und Text.

- Du schreibst gute deutsche Hooks und Skripte. Sehr gute deutsche Sprachkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind deshalb Voraussetzung.

- Du verstehst, warum jemand mit Übergewicht nach Hilfe sucht und warum er sie dann oft doch nicht annimmt und du schreibst darüber ohne Herablassung.

- Du hast Lust, dich in die Regeln für Werbung im Gesundheitsbereich einzuarbeiten. Was wir zeigen dürfen und was nicht, bringen wir dir bei.

- Du willst die Stelle in Vollzeit machen und nicht nebenbei.

Hilfreich, aber nicht nötig: Erfahrung in Health, Fitness oder Ernährung oder mit anderer regulierter Werbung, ein Netzwerk an UGC-Creator, Videoschnitt. Wenn du aus dem Performance-Marketing kommst und kreativer arbeiten willst, bewirb dich trotzdem.

Was wir bieten

- €48.000–60.000 Fixgehalt, je nach Erfahrung.

- Virtuelle Unternehmensanteile aus unserem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungspool (VSOP). Die Höhe besprechen wir im ersten Gespräch.

- KI-Tooling ohne Budgetgrenze.

- Remote mit regelmäßigen Teamtreffen vor Ort und freier Zeiteinteilung, solange die Arbeit stimmt.

- Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit beiden Gründern und ehrliches Feedback in beide Richtungen.

- 30 Tage Urlaub.

So bewirbst du dich

Kein Anschreiben. Im Bewerbungsformular hier auf join fragen wir dich zwei Dinge: warum du die richtige Person für diese Rolle bist, mit deiner Erfahrung und dem, was du bisher erreicht hast, gern mit Zahlen. Und welche unserer Ads aus der Meta Ad Library du anders machen würdest, mit einem Satz, wie.

Wir antworten innerhalb von 3 Tagen. Dann:

- 30 Minuten Videocall mit Jan und mir. Wir erzählen, wie wir arbeiten und warum es die Stelle gibt. Du erzählst uns, was du bisher gemacht hast und was du suchst.

- Eine Probeaufgabe von etwa 4 bis 5 Stunden: Markt anschauen, ein Testpaket entwickeln und ein Creative fertig bauen.

- 30 Minuten, in denen du uns die Probeaufgabe vorstellst und wir über die Erwartungen beider Seiten sprechen.

- Angebot, schriftlich. Vom ersten Gespräch bis hierhin brauchen wir in der Regel zwei bis drei Wochen.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. 

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. 

About the Role:

As a Solution Architect in the Field Engineering team, you will span both technical pre‑sales and post‑sales, serving as a trusted advisor to our enterprise customers throughout their lifecycle. In pre‑sales, you will qualify technical fit, design future‑state architectures, run evaluations, and demonstrate how Vercel unlocks measurable business outcomes. Post-sales, you will act as a technical quarterback, helping customers successfully adopt and standardize on Vercel by aligning the right resources at the right time. You will guide architecture and implementation decisions, identify when to engage Professional Services or Developer Success, and work across Product and Engineering to unblock customers and drive long-term success for critical AI and Web workloads.

If you’re based within commuting distance of our London or Berlin office, the role includes in-office anchor days. 

What You Will Do

- Partner with Sales to lead technical discovery, qualify customer use cases, and shape solution strategy for key opportunities.

- Design target architectures for modern Agentic workflows, and AI and web applications on Vercel, including frontends, APIs, data and edge services, and integrations with headless and composable ecosystems (CMS, commerce, payments, media, analytics).

- Create and deliver tailored demos, technical presentations, and workshops that clearly articulate Vercel’s value and differentiate our platform.

- Own and run proofs of concept and pilots end‑to‑end: define success criteria, guide implementation, remove technical blockers, and ensure executive‑level outcomes are documented.

- Act as lead architect post‑sale for strategic accounts, guiding onboarding, reference implementations, migration patterns, and best practices for building and operating on Vercel.

- Proactively engage with customers on performance, reliability, and cost optimization, using metrics like Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse, and observability data to drive continuous improvement.

- Collaborate with other members of the Field Engineering Team to standardise playbooks, reusable assets, and patterns that scale across customers and regions.

- Respond to and coordinate security, compliance, and architecture reviews, partnering with internal specialists on areas like data protection and regulatory requirements.

- Capture recurring themes, patterns, and gaps from the field and feed them back into Product and Engineering roadmaps as the technical Voice of the Customer.

- Contribute to internal enablement and external content (reference architectures, example repos, talks, and blog posts) that help developers be successful on Vercel.

- Some travel elements are expected relating to industry events, customer on-sites.

About You

- You have significant experience in a customer‑facing technical role (solutions architect, sales engineer, platform architect, Agency Software Engineer) working with modern web or cloud platforms.

- You bring strong hands‑on skills with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web frameworks, ideally including Next.js, and are comfortable reviewing and discussing application code with engineering teams.

- You understand web performance, caching, networking, and security fundamentals, ideally AI/LLM powered applications and Agentic workflows and can translate them into practical guidance for enterprise architectures.

- You are equally comfortable discussing business outcomes with executives and implementation details with developers, switching context quickly while maintaining credibility.

- You have a track record of owning complex technical projects, juggling multiple stakeholders, and delivering on time in fast‑moving environments.

- You thrive in collaborative field teams, enjoy mentoring others, and value clear, concise communication and documentation.

- You are familiar with cloud platforms (such as AWS, Azure, or GCP) and how SaaS and edge platforms integrate into broader enterprise architectures.

- You have empathy for developers and a passion for great developer experience, and you enjoy helping teams build accurate mental models of how platforms work.

- Bonus if you have experience of building AI powered applications, or Agentic workloads, ideally leveraging tooling such as the AI SDK.

Bonus If You

- Have production experience deploying and operating Next.js or other modern frontend frameworks on Vercel or similar platforms.

- Have worked with organisations standardising on composable architectures (headless CMS, commerce, search, analytics, and identity providers).

- Hold cloud or architecture certifications (for example, Cloud Solutions Architect certifications) or have led large‑scale migrations to cloud‑native platforms.

- Are familiar with security and privacy standards such as SOC 2, PCI DSS, or HIPAA and have participated in customer security reviews.

Benefits:

- Competitive compensation package, including equity.

- Inclusive Healthcare Package.

- Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.

- Flexible Time Off.

- We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. The compute and data generation scale of our product workloads pushes the boundaries of standard cluster deployments, and you'll be at the forefront of helping build out and ensure reliability of this system. You will work closely across the entirety of the engineering team to ensure the operational success of our backend and a variety of customer deployments. Nice to have: 

- Experience utilizing open source tooling

- Experience with deploying software on either public clouds (e.g., AWS) or on-premise clusters

title: Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients: Growth & Expansion
description:
Your Role

As Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients (f/m/d) you own the complete growth loop for LIQID's digitally-led clients: from a newly created lead to the first investment, and from there to the next top-up, the second portfolio and the next product. Acquisition and expansion sit in one team with one mandate, so you build a single growth system instead of handing clients over at the funnel's end. LIQID is hybrid by design: for this segment the experience is digital-first, and you decide precisely where a human touch from our advisors accelerates conversion or growth – and where it doesn't.

What you'll do

- End-to-End Segment Ownership: Own the digital client lifecycle from Lead → Signup → Checkout → First Investment → Activation → Expansion. You define the segment's North Star and KPI tree across conversion and expansion – lead-to-funded conversion, time to fund, time to first top-up, multi-product rate, share of wallet – and you are accountable for net new money from the segment, not for a single funnel stage.

- Lead Conversion & Onboarding Experience: Design and optimize the journeys that turn leads into funded clients – lead nurturing, signup, onboarding and checkout – together with Product Design, Marketing and Sales. You shape the first-product strategy – which entry offer converts which persona – and make sure the brand promise and premium positioning carry through every step that builds trust and drives conversion.

- Digital Up- & Cross-Sell: Turn first-time investors into multi-product clients: top-ups and savings plans, second portfolios, additional account types and access to new asset classes such as private markets. You find natural product sequences through path and cohort analysis, build the in-product moments and lifecycle campaigns that convert them, and prove impact with causal measurement rather than correlation stories.

- Hybrid Where It Pays Off: Define when a human touch turns a hesitant prospect into a client or a single-product client into a long-term relationship – callback offers at checkout drop-off, advisor triggers at wealth thresholds, and a clean handover to our Private Wealth team as clients grow. Every human touchpoint is designed, triggered and measured, not left to chance.

- Thought Leadership with Hands-on Mentality: Act as Product Manager and Product Owner for a cross-functional team of Engineering, Design and Product Ops, working closely with Marketing and Sales. Y ou build on shared onboarding and banking infrastructure owned by our platform teams, prioritize transparently by impact and effort – which also means saying no – and grow into the thought leader for digital wealth growth at LIQID.

What you bring

- Background: 7+ years in Product Management or Growth for digital consumer products, with ownership of both conversion and monetization or expansion outcomes. FinTech, WealthTech, banking or subscription businesses are a strong plus.

- Growth & Analytical Depth: Hands-on with funnel, cohort and LTV analysis. You define metrics before you build, establish baselines, can query data yourself, and know the difference between a significant result and a lucky one.

- Technical & AI Fluency: Experience working with product analytics and CRM data. You are comfortable discussing architecture and API trade-offs with engineers and use AI tooling to prototype, analyze and ship faster.

- Domain Curiosity & Client Empathy: Genuine interest in investing and capital markets, and an understanding that converting someone to invest a significant share of their wealth is a trust decision, not an impulse purchase.

- Communication & Language: Fluent in German and English, able to align Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing and Sales around one growth agenda and to represent your roadmap credibly toward leadership. Drive & Motivation: Comfortable in fast-paced, high-ownership scale-up environments. Y ou want to own outcomes, not backlogs, and you are excited to build the growth engine of a digital-first wealth manager in an AI-native product organization.

What we offer 

- Diversity : Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one.

- Flexibility : We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind.

- Appreciation : You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas.

- Development : We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget up to €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display.

- Smart Money : As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers.

- Well-being : Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that.

What happens next 

An excellent candidate, experience and transparency are our top priorities in the interview process. The different stages help us understand how a potential collaboration could look.

- Initial Call with our Talent Partner : A casual introduction and discussion to align your expectations with the role.

- Video Call with Head of Product : You will learn more about the performance expectations and specific role requirements from our leadership team.

- Take-home Assessment with live Presentation round : A take home task, followed by a 90-minute live session with two team members.

- In-Person Meeting : You will meet some team members onsite, tour our office and sit down with our Head of Product to discuss final alignments.

About us 

We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit.

We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions – ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €4 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including LGT , Toscafund , HQ Trust , and Project A .

LIQID is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, age, religion, gender, ethnicity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by equal opportunity laws.

title: Senior Security Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
WHO WE ARE We prioritise privacy as a fundamental right, delivering the most secure communication experience across various industries. Our cutting-edge encryption technology and robust security measures have made us a trusted partner in the technology, finance, healthcare, and government sectors. If you are passionate about redefining secure communication and want to be part of an innovative team, join us as a Senior Product Manager within our Product Engineering organisation. Together, let us build a world where privacy and security shape the future of communication. 

GENERAL INFORMATION - Employment Type: 12-month contract with the possibility of extension 

- Previous working experience: 5-7 years in Product Security 

- Working hours: 40hrs/week 

- Working Location: Remote EU / Berlin 

- Desired start date: As soon as possible 

YOUR CHALLENGE AT WIRE Be ready to play an essential role by joining our Information Security Team. You will become a pioneer in transforming how organisations and governments communicate securely. You will work closely with the Director of Information Security and interact with the engineering, product, and other teams regularly. Your areas of work are: 

Product Security 

- You review security- or privacy-critical changes and implement or propose solutions to potential issues 

- You help to maintain security documentation of the product with focus on product certifications 

- You communicate with internal and external stakeholders regarding product security topics 

- You support new feature development from a security point of view to identify possible security or privacy pitfalls early in the process 

- You contribute to internal security audits, risk assessments and threat modelling workshops 

- You conduct security awareness trainings regarding your field of responsibility 

Platform Security 

- You are responsible for our Platform Security controls 

- You support technical due diligence to ensure compliance with information security and data protection requirements 

- You oversee the incident management process and team members involved in resolving the incident 

- You help to maintain documentation of security- and privacy-related processes 

- You support Wire’s identity and access management 

- You drive the implementation and maintenance of SecOps measures for our Platform 

YOUR PROFILE Essential requirements 

- Proficient understanding of secure software development practices, including threat modelling and security architecture review for products. 

- Hands-on experience assessing security and privacy risks in product features (e.g., authentication, encryption, data handling, APIs). 

- Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals (e.g., AWS) and common infrastructure tools (Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm). 

- Experience supporting security certifications/compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, GDPR). 

- Strong communication skills and experience engaging both technical and non-technical stakeholders on security and privacy topics. 

Strong plus 

- Ideally, you have relevant security and/or DevOps certifications, such as CKS , etc. 

- You are familiar with GitHub, Jira and Confluence. 

Further qualifications and skills 

- You are a good communicator and you like to work in a team. 

- You are interested in and keep up with trends and news from the InfoSec world. 

- You are self-motivated to identify security problems and engage with teams to find solutions. 

- You like to do in-depth research on your own and present the results to the team. 

- You have programming experience, preferably with one or more of JavaScript, TypeScript, Swift, Kotlin, Java , Rust and Haskell . 

- You have a thorough understanding of security code reviews, bug triage based on common metrics like CVSS, and vulnerability management. 

- You have a practical, working understanding of basic cryptographic ciphers/algorithms and understand protocols or concepts like Elliptic Curve, TLS, Public Key Infrastructure and Messaging Layer Security. 

- You have a strong understanding of application security frameworks like OWASP Top 10. 

- You bring thorough knowledge of OAuth, SSO, Identity and Access Management systems. 

- You are willing to subject yourself to the S2 security check of the German Government . 

This role can be performed remotely from Germany or another EU country. Regular travel to our Berlin office for workshops, and selected in-person collaboration sessions is expected. 

WHY WIRE? - Join a market-proven company with more than 1,000 customers and help Wire become the trusted secure communications partner for organisations that care deeply about security and privacy.
- Participate in Wire’s long-term success through VSOPs.
- 30 days of vacation entitlement, allowing you to take well-deserved time off and maintain a healthy work-life balance.
- With an Urban Sports Club subscription, stay balanced and mentally and physically healthy.
- Investment in professional development with an annual education budget of €1,000 and access to top-notch learning resources.
- Work from a beautiful office in the heart of Berlin or choose a mix of working from anywhere vs. spending selected days together in our office to connect on a personal level.
- Enjoy fresh breakfast in the office, daily fruits, snacks, free soft drinks, and a nice Barista coffee machine.
- Wire is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the grounds of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability or race.

CONTACT Join us in shaping the future of secure communication. Click Apply now to submit your CV - we look forward to meeting you!

description:

Now we are getting started in earnest in the UK: living24.uk is live – our price comparison site for furniture, home furnishings, garden and décor, as well as white goods and home electronics. The launch is done, the technology works. What decides the pace now are the retailers: the more relevant shops list their ranges on living24.uk, the stronger the comparison for users – and the faster the portal grows.

This is not selling from a tidy list of existing accounts. You take on a freshly launched market and build the partner portfolio that living24.uk runs on. Whoever delivers over the next few months will shape what moebel.de looks like in the UK.

That is why we are looking for you as Senior Sales Manager UK.

- A hunter's mindset: you keep your own pipeline full, cold outreach included, and get deals over the line
- An appetite for building: pace and open questions appeal to you more than a field that has already been ploughed
- Working from the numbers, with clean CRM records as the basis for how you steer
- Willingness to travel across the UK and to regular meetings in Hamburg
- Fluent English at negotiation level – German is a plus, not a requirement

Four times a year we meet for Company Week 

Working together in the office, pushing projects forward, pizza evenings and a party to finish.

In the heart of Hamburg

title: Product Manager, Homepage
description:
About Wolt 

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

What You'll Be Doing 

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

- Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.

- Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.

- Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.

- Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

What You'll Need to Thrive 

Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

- Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.

- You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.

- You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.

- You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.

- You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.

- You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.

- You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).

- You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. 

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a product marketer at Vanta, you’ll help bring this vision to life by defining the new category of trust management, shaping Vanta’s positioning and differentiators externally, and influencing our product and business roadmap. Research, analysis, curiosity, storytelling, and project management are just a few of the attributes of our team – in addition to being open, empathetic, and genuinely nice people.

As the EMEA Product Marketing lead, you will be responsible for bringing Vanta’s story to the EMEA audience to help us drive sustainable growth in the market. You’ll craft compelling messaging that’s tailored to the region, based on insights from buyer and market research. You’ll lead product launches to help amplify Vanta’s presence in the region, and partner closely with our product management team to identify growth opportunities for us to continue building our product. Finally, you’ll partner closely with our GTM organisation to expand Vanta’s footprint and accelerate our growth.

What you’ll do as a Product Marketing Lead at Vanta: 

- Define and manage go-to-market (GTM) strategy for Vanta’s business in EMEA tailored to the unique opportunities across the EMEA region

- Develop tailored messaging and positioning for EMEA based on market research and customer insights

- Partner with our EMEA growth team on the development and execution of targeted marketing campaigns, including tailored messaging and content that effectively engage local audiences and drive business objectives

- Plan and execute large product launches (including GTM enablement of sales and customer success), report back on performance, and optimize our launch processes for scale

- Author compelling content for each stage of the customer journey, from blog posts to sales collateral

- Talk regularly to Vanta’s customers, analyze your own data, and understand our competitive landscape to help shape the product strategy and roadmap and inform Vanta’s overall EMEA marketing strategy

- Partner closely with the EMEA team at Vanta – including demand gen, sales, customer success, and product—to help achieve our objectives in the market

- Refine Vanta’s pricing and packaging based on deep insights around the market, our product value, and customer needs in partnership with finance, operations, product, sales, and customer success

- Be a strong customer champion, creative marketer, and problem solver

How to be successful in this role: 

- Have 7+ years of Product Marketing experience, with an emphasis on B2B SaaS

title: Member Experience Training & Quality Specialist - UK
description:
Mission 

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. 

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose 

The Member Experience Training & Quality Specialist makes the Neko member experience standard real on the ground. You deliver our member experience training to teams across the business, primarily clinic teams and centralised support teams, and you run the quality assurance activity that tells us whether the standard is actually landing in practice.

This is a delivery role at the heart of a live culture change programme. You will facilitate training that shifts mindset, not just process, run experience audits against CARE and the Member First Manifesto, and turn what you see into coaching and improvement. As markets scale, you keep the standard consistent across every site and cohort, and rising over time.

You own the coordination and logistics that keep training and quality assurance running: scheduling sessions and audits, and organising the people, spaces and materials each one needs. You report to the Hospitality Programme Lead and support the wider rollout, so you will also play a hands-on part in projects and launch activity as new clinics and teams come online.

What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months 

- Stage 1 and Stage 2 member experience training delivered consistently to every new clinic cohort in your market, with 30-day reviews showing the mindset shift is landing, not just attendance being logged. (Member First, always) 

- A regular quality assurance rhythm is live: experience audits across clinic and support teams, scored consistently against CARE and the Member First Manifesto, with clear findings shared back to the teams and their leads. (Impact, not activity) 

- Audit insight turned into action: recurring friction points named early and at least two concrete experience improvements implemented with clinic and support leads. (Optimistic truth-seeking) 

- Support team training built out and delivered alongside clinic training, so centralised member support holds the same standard as the clinic floor. (Chase 10X, not 10%) 

- The ongoing learning ecosystem running smoothly, including the monthly AI role play and quiz, with completion tracked and shared with Clinic Leads as a coaching tool, not a performance measure. (Tech-enabled, human-centred) 

- A training and audit calendar owned end to end: sessions scheduled around clinic rotas and cohort timing, facilitators, rooms, materials and joining details arranged, and audits planned on a set cadence so every site and team is covered without gaps. (Impact, not activity) 

Minimum Requirements 

- 3+ years in training delivery, learning and development, hospitality, or member and customer experience, ideally in a high-touch service, hospitality, or premium retail environment.

- A confident facilitator, comfortable leading a room of clinicians and operators and holding attention and energy across a full-day session.

- Hands-on experience running quality assurance or experience audits, mystery shopping, or service standard reviews, with the ability to score consistently and give feedback that changes behaviour.

- A sharp eye for service detail and what separates a good experience from an exceptional one, drawn from service design and hospitality thinking rather than process alone.

- Organised and self-directed, able to run a training and audit calendar across multiple sites and cohorts without dropping the standard.

- Excellent written and verbal communication, and the credibility to influence teams and leads who do not report to you.

- Willingness to travel regularly between clinic sites, and occasionally between markets.

- Experience supporting a multi-site clinic, hospitality, or retail rollout as it scales.

- Experience with digital learning tools, an LMS, or AI-enabled training and assessment.
