title: Senior Security Engineering Consultant
description:
Nomios’ mission is to build a secure and connected future. Organisations across the globe depend on us to help secure and connect their digital infrastructures.

As part of our continued UK growth, we are expanding our Professional Services capability and seeking a Security Engineering Consultant to deliver specialist security engineering and operations consultancy across our customer base.

This is a hands-on technical role within the Security Operations domain, focused on helping customers improve and automate their SOC functions, tooling, and detection capabilities. You will work across a range of technologies and engagements, from SOAR and SIEM implementation through to vulnerability management, exposure management, and process automation.

Your role as Senior Security Engineering Consultant 

The Security Engineering Consultant role sits within the Security Operations Team, working directly with the Nomios SOC Engineering team.

This is a senior, customer-facing Professional Services role within our Security Engineering function, focused on detection engineering and automation. You will lead the design and delivery of detection and response capabilities across SIEM, XDR and SOAR platforms. This includes building detection rules, developing automations, and creating operational playbooks that support effective SOC outcomes.

A key aspect of the role is ownership of the detection as code approach, ensuring detections and automations are developed, structured and delivered in a consistent and scalable way. Working directly with customers, you will define detection strategies, design use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK, and guide improvements in visibility, coverage and response maturity. You will work closely with platform onboarding and engineering teams, supplementing them with specialist expertise in detection engineering and automation, rather than focusing on platform deployment itself. 

The role combines hands-on engineering with advisory responsibilities, with a clear focus on delivering high-quality outcomes and enabling customers to operate and evolve their detection capabilities.

Responsibilities 

Key responsibilities of the role include:

Deliver 

- Design and deliver detection rulesets across SIEM and XDR platforms

- Develop and tune detection logic using KQL or equivalent query languages

- Design detection use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK and real-world attack techniques

- Map customer log sources to detection use cases to assess coverage and identify gaps

- Design and implement SOAR automations, integrations and response workflows

- Develop and document customer incident response playbooks aligned to detection outputs

- Translate threat intelligence and operational learnings into improved detections and automations

- Deliver detection as code pipelines, including structured use case development and versioning approaches

- Produce clear technical and customer-facing deliverables, including detection strategies, use case catalogues and coverage assessments

Collaborate 

- Work directly with customers as a trusted technical consultant

- Lead workshops covering detection engineering, use case design and SOC maturity

- Guide customers on improving detection coverage and aligning to MITRE ATT&CK

- Clearly explain detection strategies, gaps and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Work closely with platform onboarding and engineering teams to ensure smooth integration of delivered detections and automations

- Support SOC teams by ensuring delivered outputs are practical, usable and aligned to operational workflows

Improve 

- Contribute to the continuous evolution of detection use cases, playbooks and automation patterns

- Support development of reusable detection content and delivery standards

- Contribute to lab work, testing and validation of detection approaches

- Identify gaps in telemetry, logging and enrichment, and provide recommendations to strengthen detection outcomes

Job Requirements 

At Nomios, we’re looking for #smartpeople who bring #highenergy, curiosity and a strong desire to learn. If you're someone who enjoys working collaboratively, communicates clearly and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Required Skills and Experience 

- Strong hands-on experience with SIEM engineering, including developing and tuning detection rules, with Microsoft Sentinel preferred 

- Experience writing detection logic using KQL or similar query languages 

- Proven experience designing and implementing SOAR automations and playbooks such as Logic Apps, Cortex XSOAR or similar 

- Scripting and automation capability using Python, PowerShell or similar, including working with APIs 

- Experience designing detection use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK 

- Strong understanding of detection coverage and how log sources map to the attack lifecycle

- Experience with XDR or EDR platforms such as Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike or Cortex 

- Understanding of cloud environments, particularly Azure, and associated security telemetry 

- Experience working in customer-facing or consultancy roles 

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly

Technical Competencies 

- SIEM and XDR platforms, including Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Palo Alto XSIAM or XDR, CrowdStrike and SentinelOne 

- SOAR development, including automation and playbook design using platforms such as Palo Alto XSOAR or similar 

- Scripting and integration using Python, PowerShell or similar, including API-driven automation 

- Detection engineering aligned to MITRE ATT&CK, including use case design, ruleset development and coverage assessment 

- Log source mapping and normalisation to support detection use cases 

- Network Detection and Response technologies such as Vectra AI, Corelight or similar 

- Cloud security and telemetry, particularly within Azure environments 

- Threat intelligence integration and enrichment to support detection and response 

- Development of customer playbooks and response workflows aligned to SOC operations 

- General awareness of emerging technologies, including AI-driven security tooling and their application within detection and response

Job Specifics 

- Location: This is a hybrid role, while the role is primarily remote, typically 70% to 80% percent of the time, there will be a requirement to travel to customer sites and attend the Basingstoke office as required to support delivery, workshops and engagements.

(free hot & cold drinks, breakfast items, snacks, lunches, and regular takeaway Fridays are provided to all staff in the office!).

You will be part of a collaborative engineering environment, working across a wide range of customer environments and technologies. The role offers exposure to real-world threats, modern detection approaches, and the opportunity to shape how Security Operations capabilities are designed and delivered.

- Deep expertise across treasury, liquidity, solvability, capital, solvency, statutory reporting and tax risk. 

- Accounting expertise; ideally with an accounting qualification.

- Experience working across multiple regulatory jurisdictions and engaging directly with regulators and auditors.

title: Senior Sales Manager - Issuing

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

How You’ll Make an Impact

- Consultative Expert: Help prospects evaluate Checkout.com, handling detailed questions about our product capabilities, serving as a consultant and industry expert.

- Full Cycle Orchestration: Lead the entire Sales process, acting as the main point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders.

What We’re Looking For 

- Experience: 5+ years of Sales experience, with at least 3 years specifically within Payments or Card Issuing.

- AI & Productivity: Proficient in leveraging AI-powered sales tools to augment prospecting and analyze deal intelligence to accelerate the sales cycle.

- Technical Passion: Tech-savvy with a passion for how technology is transforming finance.

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

As our first EMEA Strategic Customer Success Manager, you’ll help define what strategic success looks like at incident.io , and become the trusted partner who makes us core to how the biggest enterprises run reliability.

What that looks like day to day

You’ll work with a small number of our largest, most complex and highest-value customers. These are established, often global and regulated enterprises, where buying decisions take time, many business units are involved, and incident management is part of a wider move away from legacy tools and processes. You’ll be their strategic partner across the full lifecycle, from early involvement in the deal with Sales through to adoption and expansion, and from the on-call engineer to the CIO and CTO.

You’ll help land strategic logos with focused first contracts, then build the business case and success plan that turns them into larger deals. From there you’ll expand across the enterprise, mapping the organisation, finding champions and repeating proven wins across business units and regions. You’ll run Executive Business Reviews and connect our leadership with theirs, tying what we do to what matters to their business: operational resilience, regulatory risk, the cost of downtime, tool consolidation, MTTR reduction and incident process maturity.

You’ll lead onboarding and migrations in organisations that move carefully, moving them off legacy tools and ITSM-led processes and making the change stick, including deeper adoption across Response, On-call, Status Pages and our AI capabilities. You’ll spot and reduce business, operational and reputational risk before it becomes visible, and bring Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing and Support together around shared goals for each account, including expansion and renewals.

You’ll also work directly with Product and Engineering on the roadmap and design partnerships. As the first EMEA Strategic CSM and third on the team overall, you’ll help define our strategic CS playbook, support high-stakes deals and help develop your peers as the segment grows.

Who you are

- You have significant experience in Customer Success, Account Management or Technical Account Management, managing strategic or Fortune 500-scale accounts in enterprise SaaS. Traditional enterprises like financial services, insurance, pharma, retail or private equity are ideal. Developer tooling, observability or incident management is a plus.

- You’ve driven adoption, retention and expansion in large, complex accounts with many stakeholders, and you have results you can point to.

- You know how to land small and grow large, turning a pilot or single business unit into a multi-BU footprint over a long sales cycle.

- Building a business case doesn’t faze you, nor does navigating procurement, security, legal and change management in slow-moving organisations.

- You’re confident with senior technical executives, running EBRs and strategic planning sessions, and just as comfortable going deep with SREs and platform engineers.

- You’re technically fluent in modern engineering organisations, on-call, incident response, SRE practices and the observability and DevOps ecosystem, and you can translate it for business stakeholders.

- You have strong commercial judgement, partner well with Sales on renewals and expansion, and get ahead of customer challenges rather than reacting to them.

- You’re autonomous and comfortable with ambiguity. You’re excited to define the role, not just step into it.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

- Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

- Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

- First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

- Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

- Meaningful equity. We’re rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

- Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We’re all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

- Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we’re doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

- Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

title: Director of Quality
description:
About LILT 

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation. 

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone , regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues— Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1 —guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation , Canva , the United States Department of Defense , the United States Air Force , ASICS , and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

Location: Remote or hybrid, EMEA or US Eastern time zone

Team: Production, Quality

Reports to: VP Production

Direct reports: Quality Manager (AMER, customer staffing) and 2 Quality Coordinators

About the role

As Director of Quality, you will own LILT's quality system end to end: standards, audit, compliance, procedures, continuous improvement, and the roadmap and operation of our Quality Agents . You'll help move Quality from a primarily reactive, execution-led function to a proactive, data-driven partner for customers and internal teams, with quality designed into our AI-native workflows.

You'll be the person who can run a customer audit while simultaneously shipping an improved agent evaluation. As the single Quality partner for Customer Success, Production, Research and Product, you'll turn customer requirements into measurable acceptance criteria, effective controls and better models and workflows. You'll advise customers on the right quality, cost and speed mix, including where automated, agent-verified and human-verified workflows are appropriate, with stronger assurance for high-risk and regulated content.

We're looking for a hands-on Quality SME and operator with real depth in both worlds: experience designing and building AI agents and improving LLM output, and a solid grounding in traditional quality management. You'll bring senior expertise in data, AI, customer advisory and process, and make sure quality work prevents recurrence rather than stopping at rework or ticket closure.

What you'll do

Quality Agent leadership 

- Evaluate, design and build reliable Quality Agents with well-defined tools and clear, structured instructions.

- Use orchestration patterns to evolve from a single agent to multi-agent systems.

- Define evaluation criteria, test sets and success metrics for agent performance, and run agents in production with clear monitoring and escalation paths.

- Drive adoption across teams and show measurable reductions in manual quality effort.

Research and Product partnership 

- Work closely with Research and Product on ADQ, LLM model improvements, AI Review, AI QA, and new and emerging AI workflows.

- Turn quality findings into product requirements, evaluation criteria and continuous feedback loops that improve model and workflow output.

- Act as the voice of quality in roadmap discussions, and help decide where human review, AI review or both are needed.

Audit, compliance and procedure 

- Own LILT's approach to internal and external audits, including ISO certification (e.g. ISO 17100, ISO 18587, ISO 9001) and customer audits.

- Plan and run periodic internal audits, manage evidence collection, and track corrective and preventive actions to closure.

- Standardise and maintain SOPs, workflows and quality documentation, and keep them current as AI workflows change how we work.

- Make sure quality processes meet customer, contractual and regulatory requirements.

Customer advisory 

- Partner with Customer Success and Delivery to define proactive quality programmes, success metrics and governance for strategic accounts, including AI-forward enterprise and life science / regulatory programmes.

- Translate customer quality requirements into clear pre-delivery acceptance criteria, validation methods and risk-appropriate controls.

- Advise customers on the right quality, cost and speed mix and where automated, agent-verified, human-verified or combined workflows are appropriate.

- Represent LILT's quality function as a credible subject-matter authority in customer business reviews, audits and escalations, using quality data and metrics to demonstrate fitness for purpose.

Continuous improvement 

- Lead structured CI across the Commercial business: root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, KPI reviews and retrospectives.

- Own a proactive quality metrics framework that makes errors, PQs, rework and trends visible, and use it to prioritise improvements and demonstrate outcomes.

- Strengthen quality controls across review, delivery and follow-through, including mandatory account-specific checks, intervention on critical findings and clear escalation ownership.

- Partner with Product and Engineering to automate checks and escalation, and verify that corrective actions prevent recurrence rather than ending at rework or ticket closure.

Expert Operations partnership 

- Partner with Expert Supply and Ops to embed processes, guidance and quality feedback that maintain a high-quality pipeline of experts.

- Use quality findings and recurring failure patterns to improve expert qualification, guidance and ongoing quality management.

Team leadership 

- Lead and develop the Quality team, including the customer-facing Quality Manager and Quality Coordinators.

- Establish the team's operating cadence and evolve how the team works as Quality Agents reduce manual coordination work.

- Oversee embedded Quality Manager staffing sold as a service to customers, ensuring the role owns the specific quality programmes and initiatives those customers pay for.

- Develop playbooks for AI-driven quality management and keep staffing-as-a-service delivery aligned with LILT's quality standards.

What you'll bring

Must have 

- Agent design and build: demonstrable, hands-on experience designing, building and running LLM-based agents in production. Please be ready to walk us through agents you have built.

- Data-driven quality management: scripting or data skills (e.g. Python, SQL), with experience turning quality data into actionable metrics, preventive controls and measurable improvements.

- LLM model improvement: proven experience improving LLM output quality.

- Significant experience running quality systems , including leading audits (internal and external), compliance programmes, and writing and maintaining processes and procedures. Quality certifications such as Six Sigma are a plus.

- Experience leading structured CI (RCA, CAPA, KPI reviews).

- Experience managing and developing people.

- Customer advisory and cross-functional partnership: a clear communicator who can translate customer quality requirements into acceptance criteria and governance, advise on quality, cost and speed trade-offs, and work credibly with customers, executives and technical teams.

Nice to have 

- Background in localisation, translation or language services.

- Experience in customer-facing quality roles for enterprise accounts.

- Research and Product collaboration: a track record of working with research scientists and product managers to turn quality insight into product requirements and shipped improvements.

Our Story 

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech 

What sets our platform apart:

- Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

- Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

- 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

- Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review

LILT in the News 

- Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies!

- LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List .

- LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

- Check out all our news on our website .

title: Staff  Software Engineer (Agentic Search) - Crawler
description:
About Nebius: 

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product 

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible.

We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role 

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to work on the content acquisition and crawling infrastructure of a novel search engine tailored for agentic AI consumption.

In this role, you will focus on building systems that discover, fetch, and continuously refresh content from the open web and other large-scale data sources. You will design distributed crawling, scheduling, and ingestion infrastructure capable of operating at internet scale while balancing coverage, freshness, resource efficiency, and reliability. You will work on systems that process billions of URLs, manage high-throughput data flows, and ensure that high-quality content is consistently available to downstream indexing and retrieval systems.

In this position, your responsibility will be to: 

- Design, implement, and operate web-scale crawling systems for acquiring content from the internet

- Build ingestion workflows for internal and external data sources, including crawlers, structured feeds, and partner integrations

- Develop crawl scheduling, prioritisation, recrawl policies, and freshness strategies

- Build systems for URL discovery, deduplication, content extraction, and crawl orchestration

- Ensure reliable operation of crawling infrastructure under high-throughput conditions

- Define observability and quality metrics for crawl coverage, freshness, throughput, and content quality

- Monitor resource usage, bandwidth consumption, and infrastructure cost

- Collaborate with indexing and ML teams to ensure acquired content meets retrieval and ranking requirements

- Enable safe experimentation with crawling strategies and content acquisition policies

You may be a good fit if you: 

- 8+ years of experience building backend or distributed systems

- Strong Go or C++ expertise 

- Experience with large-scale distributed systems (10k+ RPS, billions of URLs, high-throughput pipelines)

- Understanding of web protocols (HTTP, DNS, TLS), crawling, scraping, and content extraction

- Experience operating production systems and debugging failures in distributed environments

- Strong understanding of scalability, fault tolerance, and resource management

Strong candidates may also have experience with: 

- Web crawling

- Building streaming data pipelines and event-driven systems

- Kafka, Pulsar, NATS, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging platforms

- Designing distributed schedulers, queues, and asynchronous processing systems

- Spark, Flink, Beam, or MapReduce

- Ad tech, social networks, search engines, or other large-scale content platforms

title: Deputy Accounting Director (freelance/contractor)
description:
About Mirakl: 

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com .

Mirakl in Numbers: 

- 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40

- 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values: 

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

- 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success

- 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results

- 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence

- 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture

- 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the role

Mirakl is looking for a senior contractor to join its Finance team and provide operational leadership in an international, multi-entity environment.

Reporting to the Accounting & Tax Director, you will secure the continuity and quality of day-to-day accounting operations while supporting the monthly and annual close.

The role also offers the opportunity to contribute to the transformation of the Finance function, particularly through the identification, testing and adoption of relevant automation and AI use cases. The successful candidate will combine strong accounting expertise with a pragmatic, hands-on approach to process improvement and change management.

Contractor 

6 months 

Start: ASAP 

Location: Paris or Bordeaux (aller-retour à prévoir à Bordeaux 1 fois par mois) 

Key responsibilities

Accounts Payable and Procure-to-Pay

- Own and coordinate the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay process, from supplier creation and invoice receipt through to validation, booking and payment.

- Coordinate the Accounts Payable team and ensure timely processing of invoices across Mirakl’s entities.

- Monitor invoice workflows, approvals, purchase orders, blocked invoices and outstanding supplier balances.

- Review invoice coding, supporting documentation and accounting treatment, and act as an escalation point for complex supplier issues.

- Coordinate payment runs and ensure that payment files are prepared accurately and in line with internal approval procedures.

- Maintain robust controls over vendor master data, bank details, payment approvals and segregation of duties.

Accounting operations and close support

- Support the Accounting & Tax Director in the coordination of the monthly and annual close process.

- Review AP-related cut-off and other accounting entries.

- Monitor the reconciliation and clean-up of relevant balance sheet accounts and support the review of intercompany transactions.

- Coordinate with local accounting firms and external service providers across Mirakl’s international perimeter.

- Contribute to audit preparation and respond to requests from external auditors and other stakeholders.

- Ensure that accounting evidence, procedures and control documentation are complete, accessible and up to date.

Finance transformation, automation and AI

- Contribute to Mirakl’s Finance AI transformation roadmap by identifying high-value use cases within AP, Procure-to-Pay and accounting operations.

- Participate in discovery phases, workshops and experiments aimed at improving invoice processing, data quality, reconciliations, reporting and operational support.

- Help assess and test AI-enabled workflows, automation solutions and Finance agents, working closely with Finance, Data and other stakeholders.

- Translate operational requirements into clear process, data and control requirements for automation and AI initiatives.

- Support the adoption of new tools by documenting processes, defining operating guidelines, monitoring results and helping teams embed new ways of working.

- Remain attentive to data quality, confidentiality, traceability, human oversight and appropriate controls when using AI in Finance processes.

Candidate profile

- 8+ years of experience in accounting, finance operations or accounting management

- Previous experience as an Accounting Manager, Deputy Accounting Director

- Experience in a multi-entity, international environment; experience in a fast-growing technology or SaaS company is a strong advantage.

- Solid understanding of accounting principles, closing processes, cut-off, reconciliations and internal controls.

- Experience working with external accounting firms and international subsidiaries.

- Strong knowledge of ERP and finance systems

- Interest in Finance transformation, automation and AI, with the ability to translate operational needs into practical use cases.

- Autonomous, hands-on and solution-oriented, with excellent organisational, analytical and communication skills.

- Fluent English required; French is a strong advantage.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French.

While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews .

title: Doctorant.e: Quantification des pesticides dans les dépôts atmosphériques : Origine et Variabilité  CDD 36 mois à IMT Nord Europe
description:
Unité : CERI EE (IMT NE) et Institut de Chimie et Procédés pour l'Energie l'Environnement et la Santé (ICPEES, UMR 7515 CNRS, Université de Strasbourg)

Responsable hiérarchique : Nadine Locoge (IMT NE)

Responsable fonctionnel : Dr. Aude Bourin (IMT NE), Prof. Alexandre Tomas (IMT NE), et Prof. Maurice Millet (Université de Strasbourg)

Catégorie : 

Nature de l’emploi : Doctorat 

Lieu de travail : Strasbourg / Douai 

Contexte : 

Le doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration scientifique entre le Centre d’Enseignement, Recherche et Innovation Energie Environnement (CERI EE) d’IMT Nord Europe et l’UMR 7515 CNRS-UNISTRA : ICPEES (Institut de Chimie et Procédés pour l’Energie, l’Environnement et la Santé) dont l’objectif est de renseigner l’influence des pluies sur les dépôts de pesticides au niveau national, en plus des données existantes dans l’air ambiant.

L’IMT Nord Europe est une école sous tutelle du ministère de l’économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique. IMT Nord Europe est née en 2017 de la fusion de Télécom Lille et de l’École des Mines de Douai. Elle compte aujourd’hui parmi les plus Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs au Nord de Paris avec plus 2200 élèves, dont un quart d’apprentis, plus de 600 diplômés par an et un réseau de 15 000 diplômés. Elle fait partie de l’Institut Mines Télécom, premier groupe public de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France, et est partenaire de l’université de Lille.

IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.

Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20 000 m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les trois domaines « Systèmes Numériques », « Energie Environnement » et « Matériaux et Procédés ».

Le CERI EE d’IMT Nord Europe développe des activités au cœur des transitions énergétiques et environnementales. Sa recherche est orientée vers les sciences de l'atmosphère, la qualité des environnements intérieurs et les enjeux de l’efficacité énergétique et de la décarbonation. La candidate/le candidat intégrera l’un des 3 axes thématiques du CERI EE, l’axe OSPA (Observations, Sources et Processus physico-chimiques Atmosphériques).

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr et celui du CERI EE https://recherche.imt-nord-europe.fr/energie-environnement-ceri 

L’ICPEES (Institut de Chimie et Procédés pour l'Energie, l'Environnement et la Santé, UMR 7515 du CNRS et de l’Université de Strasbourg) a été créé en janvier 2013 lorsque deux laboratoires, le Laboratoire des matériaux, surfaces et procédés pour la catalyse (LMSPC) et le Laboratoire d'ingénierie des polymères pour les hautes technologies (LIPHT), décident de fusionner. Lors de la fusion, les trois équipes du LIPHT et les sept équipes du LMSPC ont été structurées en trois départements de recherche : catalyse et matériaux, chimie moléculaire et analytique, ingénierie des polymères.

La transversalité des compétences présentes au sein de l’Institut permet de traiter des problématiques globales allant de la synthèse des molécules à l’élaboration de l’objet final pour des applications liées à l'Energie, l'Environnement ou la Santé. L’implication forte des équipes de l’unité dans les recherches fondamentales avec une visée applicative a permis au laboratoire de se positionner sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur et d’acquérir une renommée internationale. Les collaborations académiques tant nationales qu’internationales ont contribué aussi aux développements de nouveaux axes de recherche inexploités à l’heure actuelle. Les développements avals des recherches menées au sein de l’unité ont également permis de tisser de nombreuses collaborations avec le monde socio-économique en apportant des solutions concrètes aux différentes demandes sociétales et en développant de nouveaux procédés en adéquation avec les nouvelles législations. 

Les activités de recherche au sein de l’unité ne peuvent être menées d’une manière sereine, sans l’appui fort des pôles de soutien à la recherche, qui ont permis de fluidifier les demandes techniques et administratives. L’excellente cohésion entre ces pôles et les équipes de recherche a contribué également à mieux anticiper des problèmes éventuels et à d’optimiser le fonctionnement quotidien au sein de l’unité. En 2020, la direction de l’ICPEES a organisé le service commun technique en 3 pôles : le Pôle Caractérisation, le Pôle Ingénierie et Développement et le Pôle Chimie.

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’ICPEES :

https://icpees.unistra.fr 

Missions : 

Le doctorant aura pour mission d’évaluer la dynamique des dépôts atmosphériques de pesticides à différentes échelles spatiales et temporelles en collaboration avec l’observatoire MERA ( https://www.lcsqa.org/fr/le-dispositif-mera ) et les AASQA ( https://www.atmo-france.org/ ) sur le territoire national. Dans un premier temps, il devra adapter les méthodes d’analyse de pesticides existantes en GC/MSMS et LC/MSMS dans l’équipe « CAMATES ( C himie A nalytique MAT ériaux, E nvironnement S anté) » de l’ICPEES (UMR 7515 CNRS-UNISTRA), en particulier intégrer les pesticides de la liste prioritaire de l’ANSES [1] et ceux du dispositif Pesticides coordonné par le LCSQA [2] ( https://www.lcsqa.org/fr/le-dispositif-pesticides ). Il aura également pour mission de déterminer la méthode technique d’extraction de ces molécules et de quantifier l’effet de matrice/interférences potentiels que peuvent générer les eaux pluviales et les dépôts secs. Pour cela, il disposera d’échantillons réels de dépôts totaux (humides et secs) qu’il dopera avec des molécules non présentes dans les échantillons et des étalons marqués.

Il aura ensuite la tâche d’analyser les échantillons de dépôts atmosphériques collectés de manière hebdomadaire pendant 1 an sur plusieurs sites d’étude et également de quantifier si la réfrigération des échantillons pendant leur stockage dans le préleveur est indispensable.

Enfin, il aura à interpréter et analyser les résultats en termes d’occurrence, de variabilité spatiale et temporelle (influence de l’activité agricole), de relation avec les conditions météorologiques (trajectoire des masses d’air) et de corrélation avec d’autres polluants atmosphériques ou des mesures de pesticides dans l’air ambiant réalisées en parallèle par les AASQA.

Activités : 

- Instrumentation pour les dépôts atmosphériques et développements analytiques (t0 – t6) -- à Douai puis Strasbourg

- effectuer des essais techniques pour vérifier la conformité des appareils de collecte des dépôts atmosphériques (Douai)

- modification de méthodes existantes en GC/MSMS et LC/MSMS (retraits/ajouts de molécules),

- développement MSMS des nouvelles molécules,

- validation de la méthode (limites de détection et de quantification, répétabilité, reproductibilité,…)

- choix de la méthode de préparation des échantillons (LLE, SPE, SPME, …),

- évaluation des interférences et de l’effet de matrice par dopage avec des étalons deutérés et des molécules de pesticides non présentes dans les échantillons (screening de la présence/absence en amont)

2. Analyse des échantillons collectés sur le terrain (t7 – t20) – à Strasbourg

- gestion hebdomadaire des échantillons : réception, extraction, analyses, conditionnement des flacons

- traitement des résultats obtenus d’analyses : prétraitement des données, intégration des chromatogrammes, identification des composés, quantification et validation des résultats avec contrôle qualité

3. Interprétation des résultats acquis (t21 – t28) -- à Douai

4. Rédaction de publications, du mémoire de thèse et valorisations à l’international (t21 – t36) – à Douai

Participations éventuelles aux activités d’enseignement en chimie analytique (TP en Licence pour l’Université de Strasbourg) ( dans la limite de 64 heures par année scolaire).

Profil du candidat : (Prérequis/ Diplôme)

description:

À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom :

L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. L'IMT est membre fondateur de l’Alliance Industrie du Futur. Il est doublement labellisé Carnot pour la qualité de sa recherche partenariale. Vidéo de présentation de l'Institut Mines-Télécom 

Missions

- Conduire des travaux de recherche fondamentale et appliquée en informatique sur l’identification d’état et la détection des conditions de compétition dans les systèmes temps réel.

- Étudier et développer des approches visant à améliorer la fiabilité et les performances des systèmes de réseaux distribués.

- Mobiliser des modèles formels temps réel, des méthodes d’identification d’état et des stratégies de détection des conditions de compétition.

- Contribuer au développement de nouvelles méthodes d’analyse et de vérification des systèmes temps réel.

Activités

1. Mener des travaux de recherche sur l’identification d’état et la détection des conditions de compétition dans les systèmes temps réel 

- Participer activement et régulièrement aux réunions de l’équipe de recherche.

- Collaborer avec les membres de l’équipe à la conduite des travaux scientifiques.

- Modéliser des systèmes de réseaux distribués à l’aide d’automates temporisés ( Timed Automata ) et de machines à états finis temporisées ( Timed Finite State Machines ).

- Spécifier et vérifier des propriétés temporelles, notamment les conditions de compétition, à l’aide de solveurs et d’outils de vérification formelle tels qu’UPPAAL.

- Mettre en œuvre et évaluer des méthodes existantes de génération de séquences d’identification d’état pour les automates temporisés et les machines à états finis temporisées, notamment les séquences de synchronisation ( synchronizing sequences ), de détermination de l’état initial ( homing sequences ) et de distinction ( distinguishing sequences ).

- Exploiter des techniques telles que les arbres de successeurs et les méthodes d’abstraction pour dériver des séquences d’identification d’état.

- Concevoir de nouvelles stratégies d’identification d’état et de détection des conditions de compétition.

- Réaliser des expérimentations, analyser les résultats et évaluer les performances des méthodes développées.

2. Valoriser et diffuser les résultats de recherche 

- Rédiger des articles scientifiques et contribuer à leur publication dans des revues et conférences internationales.

- Présenter les résultats des travaux lors de conférences, séminaires, colloques et autres manifestations scientifiques.

- Participer aux échanges scientifiques et contribuer à la diffusion des connaissances au sein de la communauté de recherche.

3. Contribuer aux activités d’enseignement et d’encadrement 

- Participer à l’encadrement des étudiants dans le cadre de projets de recherche, de travaux pratiques ou de projets académiques.

- Contribuer aux activités d’enseignement en lien avec les domaines scientifiques du projet.

Formation

- Doctorat ou PhD depuis moins de 3 ans

Compétences, connaissances et expériences indispensables 

- Expertise scientifique : maîtriser l’analyse des systèmes temps réel réactifs et comprendre les liens entre les conditions de compétition et l’identification de l’état final.

- Détection des conditions de compétition : maîtriser les concepts liés à la détection des conditions de compétition et à la théorie de la concurrence.

- Vérification formelle : maîtriser les méthodes de vérification de la concurrence entre les entrées et les sorties dans les automates temporisés et les machines à états finis temporisées.

- Identification d’état : maîtriser les concepts et les méthodes d’identification d’état, notamment les séquences de synchronisation et de distinction pour les automates temporisés et les machines à états finis temporisées.

- Robustesse des séquences : analyser les conditions de robustesse des séquences d’identification d’état vis-à-vis des conditions de compétition.

- Outils de vérification : utiliser des outils et solveurs de vérification formelle, notamment UPPAAL et Z3.

- Programmation : mobiliser des compétences en programmation pour la mise en œuvre, l’expérimentation et l’évaluation des méthodes développées.

- Langues : maîtriser l’anglais à l’écrit et à l’oral. La connaissance du français constitue un atout.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables

- connaissance et expérience pertinente en matière de réseaux, de cloud et de systèmes distribués seraient un atout.

Capacités et aptitudes

title: Sales Account Executive - Cybersecurity
description:
Passionate about Cybersecurity, open-source or network effect products? Interested in Sales? 

Join CrowdSec to build a safer internet for everyone.

What we do 

We aim to deter opportunistic and organized cybercrime through an Internet-scale, real-time security network. This network is powered by hundreds of thousands of servers sharing the aggression they block with our open-source software. By coupling this local behavior analysis and sharing its findings within our community, we create a real-time map of IP addresses used by cybercriminals, a large-scale reputation system, and a Crowd-Sourced Cyber Threat Intelligence of unprecedented magnitude that will counter the vast majority of technical hacks.

Who We Are 

CrowdSec is a human-sized team of cybersecurity experts. Most of the team has worked remotely since day 1. The CrowdSec solution is used in 180+ countries, it is a well-known, unique, collaborative, open-source security solution that protects hundreds thousands of users. We are animated by a mission: making the Internet a safer place, all together.

Role 

As an Account Executive (AE), you will work with the Sales team to help them scale, create new opportunities, interact with them, convert them to Leads, and take the accounts to signature. This will be done in collaboration with the BDRs, presales, Marketing, and Support teams to ensure the most pleasant customer journey.

Must-have 

- A track record of success in selling Cybersecurity software solutions

- A pre-existing customer/contact base to work on to kickstart your tenure

description:
Your mission You own the direction of our formal verification business. Our managers keep delivery predictable. You decide what the organisation becomes.

You report to the CEO and are a member of the executive leadership team. You carry the FV consulting business as a whole — where it goes, how it performs, who leads it — and you answer for it. You will not solve verification problems, and you will rarely run a project or an account yourself. Concretely, you own:

- Direction . The roadmap for FV consulting. Which capabilities, markets and problem domains we pursue, and what we decline.
- Customers. You are the face of LUBIS EDA to our key accounts and at executive level. You open the doors your managers cannot, and you carry the conversations that decide a long-term relationship.
- Organisation . Structure, standards, playbooks, talent pipelines, and the career framework in practice. You keep improving how we work, and you decide when a new technology — AI among them — changes the way we deliver.
- Leaders . Our Verification Managers report to you. You hire them, develop them, and grow the bench behind them. This is the main measure of the role.
- Quality . Holding the quality bar under commercial pressure. Our entire positioning depends on it.
- Product interface . What our engineers learn on customer projects is the best input our software roadmap gets.

Your profile You have developed leaders, not "only" engineers. You have set direction where there was no precedent, made the calls, and carried an organisation with you. You build systems that outlast your attention. 

You need credibility in formal verification. Not to overrule your senior engineers. You need it to make the calls only you can make: is a capability gap real, is a quality standard achievable at the price we quote, does a bet on a new formal domain hold. 

YOUR EXPERIENCE - 12+ years in semiconductor verification, EDA or adjacent engineering services. 
- 5+ years in leadership, including managers reporting to you. 
- Fluent in formal methods and their trade-offs. Credible with a customer’s engineering leadership and on a conference stage. 
- You know how technical services are priced and defended on quality rather than volume. 
- Nice-to-have: you have scaled a technical organisation past start-up stage, where the systems had to be built. 

Why us? LUBIS is growing, and we’re looking for a Head of Formal Verification. 

This is one of those roles where you don’t just join an organisation. You help build it. 

Our formal sign-off business is growing. Our customers are getting bigger. So are our ambitions. We’re looking for someone who wants real ownership of what comes next: how we develop our people, how we deliver outstanding projects, how we work with our customers, and what world-class technical consulting at LUBIS should look like. 

You’ll work directly with our leadership team. You’ll have the freedom to shape structures and standards. You’ll build an organisation around some of the strongest formal verification expertise in the market. 

We’re not looking for someone to maintain what already exists. We’re looking for someone who gets excited about making it better, bigger and more professional. 

If you want a leadership role with real influence, and the chance to build something you’ll be proud of, come build it with us.

title: CISO
description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane 

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 500,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Why is this role important for Pennylane?

Pennylane is building Pennylane Financial Services (PFS), a newly created regulated subsidiary applying for ACPR authorisations as a payment institution and a financing company.

This step is foundational to delivering a comprehensive financial-services product for our clients, on a model that is robust, scalable, and supervision-ready.

From day one, the ACPR will expect PFS to demonstrate clear security governance, effective oversight of critical dependencies, and credible evidence of operational resilience - with a strong security-by-design approach.

How will you contribute to the project?

You will own PFS’s security governance and overall security and resilience policy, under the direct supervision of the Chief Compliance and Risk Officer.

Your contribution is to design a risk and control framework that is proportionate to PFS’s activity and regulatory expectations, and to ensure PFS can evidence "security by design" through auditable, inspection-ready artefacts.

In practice, this includes:

- Policy alignment: ensure consistency between PFS and Pennylane SAS security policies, leveraging the group framework where appropriate while prioritising PFS’s regulatory obligations.

- Security by design: translate requirements into actionable standards and control expectations, embedded into product and engineering delivery.

- Operational resilience: shape incident-management and continuity expectations, ensure they are testable, and drive evidence of effective execution.

- Oversight of key stakeholders: establish effective oversight of Pennylane SAS and key providers, with clear expectations, monitoring and remediation follow-through.

This is a role for a technically credible security leader with strategic judgement - with the technical depth to challenge architectures, controls and evidence, and the seniority to own governance and executive reporting.

What will your day-to-day responsibilities be?

- Own PFS Information Security policy: define, maintain and continuously improve PFS security governance, standards and policy set.

- Manage the PFS risk and control framework: maintain the security risk taxonomy, control objectives, key risks/KRIs, escalation thresholds, and evidence expectations.

- Embed security-by-design into the Product/Tech development cycle: leverage Pennylane SAS policies and existing ways of working where applicable, ensuring PFS security requirements and regulatory obligations are reflected in the delivery lifecycle, change process and go/no-go decisions, without creating unnecessary process overhead.

- Ensure operational resilience / continuity / testing: define resilience requirements and ensure end-to-end testing and exercises produce usable evidence and tracked remediation.

- Manage outsourcing arrangements and audits: oversee security aspects of outsourcing arrangements (intragroup and third parties), ensure auditability and follow through on findings and remediation.

- Provide executive-level reporting: deliver clear, decision-oriented reporting on information-security posture, incidents, resilience testing and remediation to PFS management and the Supervisory Board.

KPIs / signals: 

- Policy & standards effectiveness: evidence of adoption (e.g., security requirements consistently reflected in delivery artefacts for material initiatives) and reduction of recurring “same class” issues over time.

- Core security KRIs (within risk appetite): a small set of measurable KRIs with thresholds and owners (e.g., critical vulnerability exposure, privileged-access exceptions, key third-party risks), tracked and escalated when outside appetite.

- Resilience testing KPIs: tests/exercises executed vs plan; % of high-severity findings remediated within agreed timelines; retest completion for failed scenarios.

- Incident classification & remediation tracking: consistent classification, timely escalation, and tracked remediation to closure (including post-incident action closure rate).

- Audit follow-up tracking: audit findings/actions ageing, % overdue by severity, and executive visibility on the top overdue items.

- Threat & vulnerability landscape monitoring: regular review of the external threat/vulnerability landscape and its concrete impact on PFS priorities (what changes in controls, monitoring, or roadmap).

Ramp-up / expectations during the probation period: 

- Establish the initial PFS security governance baseline (policy set, decision rights, reporting cadence).

- Propose and align a first set of PFS security KRIs and risk appetite thresholds (with owners and escalation path).

- Produce a first resilience testing plan (what is tested, frequency, evidence expected) and agree success criteria.

- Put in place an incident classification approach and a remediation tracking routine that is audit-ready.

Profile we are looking for

Must-have 

- Fintech and/or Banking experience

- Strong experience in information security, technology risk, cyber-risk or security assurance, with ownership of complex topics.

- Proven ability to design and run security governance and a risk/control framework with audit-ready evidence.

- Experience working with outsourced / third-party / group-shared technology services while retaining accountability.

- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including executive-level reporting.

- Professional fluency in French and English.

Nice to have 

- Operational resilience experience, including DORA-aligned practices (incident management, continuity, testing, third-party oversight).

- Knowledge of payment and authentication topics (SCA, strong authentication and account recovery patterns).

- Exposure to PCI DSS scope and payment-card security concepts.

- Payment fraud and transaction-monitoring familiarity (fraud patterns, controls, investigations, and collaboration with Fraud/AML stakeholders).

Why is this role important for Pennylane?

Pennylane is building Pennylane Financial Services (PFS), a newly created regulated subsidiary applying for ACPR authorisations as a payment institution and a financing company.

From day one of licensing, PFS must be able to operate in full regulatory compliance - not only through policies, but through reliable execution: clear ownership, predictable reporting routines, auditable evidence, and effective coordination across Operations, Finance/Accounting and Compliance & Risk.

This role is critical to organise and run that regulatory function, with the ambition to progressively consolidate regulatory reporting ownership within PFS.

How will you contribute to the project?

You will help build and operate the regulatory office of Pennylane Financial Services, working across Compliance & Risk, Finance, Legal, Operations and Technology.

Your initial priority will be to turn PFS’s regulatory requirements into a reliable operating framework: a complete obligations inventory, clear ownership, an integrated regulatory calendar, and effective controls over regulatory reporting and evidence.

In practice, you will:

- maintain the authoritative inventory of PFS’s regulatory obligations;

- coordinate the regulatory-reporting portfolio and directly produce selected returns;

- establish clear responsibilities, reporting controls and escalation paths across contributing functions;

- support supervisory responses and commitment tracking from day one;

- coordinate regulatory change with Compliance, Legal and the relevant subject-matter owners; and

- support regulatory governance through clear reporting, decision tracking and follow-through.

You will not replace the specialist accountability of Finance, the MLRO, Legal, Risk or Operations. Your role will be to make their contributions converge into a controlled, timely and inspection-ready regulatory process.

As PFS grows, you will help shape and evolve its regulatory operating model and governance arrangements.

What will your day-to-day responsibilities be?

- Maintain the regulatory-obligations inventory: keep a complete and current view of PFS’s recurring and event-driven obligations, with clear owners, deadlines, controls, approval routes and evidence requirements.

- Run the integrated regulatory calendar: coordinate contributors, dependencies and review milestones across Compliance & Risk, Finance, Legal, Operations and Technology, escalating delivery risks before deadlines are affected.

- Coordinate regulatory reporting: oversee the end-to-end reporting portfolio and directly prepare selected returns, while ensuring specialist functions retain accountability for their underlying judgements and data.

- Establish reporting controls: document and operate source-to-report lineage, reconciliations, variance analysis, maker-checker review, sign-offs, submission evidence, correction procedures and backup arrangements.

- Coordinate data-quality remediation: document reporting-data issues, assign them to the accountable function, monitor resolution and escalate overdue or recurring problems.

- Support supervisory responses and commitment tracking: maintain a reliable record of requests, responses and commitments; coordinate contributions and evidence under the direction of the ACPR relationship owner; and escalate delivery issues to PFS management.

- Coordinate regulatory change: work with Compliance, Legal and relevant subject-matter owners to translate new requirements into impact assessments, accountable owners, implementation plans and evidence.

- Support regulatory governance: prepare concise status reporting, maintain decision and action tracking, and ensure regulatory matters reach the appropriate management or governance forum.

- Improve tools and processes: define practical requirements for workflow, evidence storage, reporting production and regulatory remittance, reducing manual effort without weakening controls.

Profile we are looking for

Must-have 

- Meaningful experience in a regulated financial environment, in one or more areas such as regulatory reporting, regulatory operations, prudential reporting, compliance, risk, finance, internal control or regulatory advisory.

- Strong understanding of reporting controls and data quality, including reconciliations, source-to-report traceability, review and approval controls, exception management and auditable evidence.

- Sound regulatory judgement: ability to understand a requirement, identify its practical implications, recognise when specialist Legal or Compliance input is needed, and translate conclusions into ownership, processes and controls.

- Strong execution discipline, with a demonstrated ability to coordinate recurring deliverables, manage interdependencies and meet fixed deadlines reliably.

- Ability to work effectively across Finance, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations and Technology, while preserving clear accountability between functions.

- Ability to build structured and durable ways of working—including registers, calendars, procedures, templates and knowledge bases—in an evolving environment.

- Clear and concise written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain issues, assumptions and required decisions to senior stakeholders.

- Professional fluency in French and English.

Nice-to-have 

- Experience with ACPR reporting, supervisory interactions or the French regulatory environment.

- Experience in a payment institution, electronic-money institution, financing company, bank, regulated fintech, supervisory authority or specialist advisory firm.

- Exposure to more than one regulatory domain, such as payments, prudential reporting, statistical reporting, AML-CFT, fraud, incidents or financing activities.

- Experience coordinating regulatory change, supervisory requests, inspections or remediation commitments.

- Familiarity with regulatory-remittance tools, reporting-data lineage, workflow automation or evidence-management solutions.

- Experience building or materially improving a regulatory framework in a new entity, licensing programme or operating-model transformation.

Recruitment Process

3. Case Study with two Finance or Legal representative (1h)

title: Customer Success Manager (France)
description:
We turn every customer interaction into an opportunity. We connect conversations, customer data and payments with AI Agents so that companies can deliver personal customer journeys at scale: both online and in person.

“The entire customer journey. One platform”

What we value 

Every CM.com colleague, connects to our 4 shared values :

Drive and Lead 

You take initiative, make decisions and recognize opportunities. Making mistakes is part of moving forward.

Grow and Learn 

The growth of our colleagues and our customers is our priority. You like to experiment, learn continuously and actively share knowledge and insights with others.

Together and Care 

We work together and we believe that diverse perspectives lead to stronger outcomes. You value the social side of work, you show genuine interest and care about one another’s well-being.

Speed and Change 

By welcoming AI Agents into our organisation, we fundamentally change how work is done. You are comfortable with change and you love working in a high paced environment.

The Role 

As Customer Success Manager in our France team, you are responsible for the successful, lasting use of the CM.com platform: from onboarding onwards, and as a strategic advisor to our customers. You coordinate a smooth launch, build a strong relationship and make sure customers adopt and get value from what they bought. Customer-centric thinking is part of your DNA.

You will onboard and implement products across our platform, in particular:

- Business messaging channels (SaaS or API): WhatsApp Business, RCS for Business, Email, SMS and Voice, plus verification services (One Time Password, Mobile Identity)

- Activate : Marketing Campaigns, Marketing Automation and CXP Predictions

- Support : our customer care platform, a single stop shop solution combining AI agents built with CM Agent Builders (chat, voice, WhatsApp, email) with seamless escalation to a human agent

You see how these products work together and have the (technical) depth to advise customers on best practices that fit their needs. You focus on Enterprise organizations with a high volume of customer contact: financial services and insurers, utilities and logistics, retail, government, telecom, contact centers, IT resellers and software vendors.

You collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Account Management, fellow Customer Success Managers, Product, Development, Marketing and Tech Support.

You will 

- Support pre-sales cycles together with the Sales team, including product demonstrations

- Ensure onboarding and run for customers, from basics to complex projects

- Drive AI agents (built with CM Agent Builders) and omnichannel use cases from scoping to go-live and adoption

- Manage the customer lifecycle: business reviews, CS meetings and continuous improvement

- Deploy professional services and train customer stakeholders

- Detect revenue optimization, upsell and cross-sell opportunities and work with the Account team on renewals

- Contribute to the ongoing development of our success services and products, and look for new and better ways of servicing customers

- Support trade show preparation and attendance when needed

- Use and improve our internal tools (CRM, CSM tools) and actively use AI tools to improve your own work and share what works with the team

- 3-5+ years of experience in customer success, account management, project management or consultancy, ideally in SaaS, telecom or marketing technology, with experience in onboarding and implementing SaaS or CPaaS products

- Technical affinity: you understand APIs and can turn technical documentation into clear guidance for customers; experience with contact center software, conversational channels or AI agents is a plus

- Business savvy and a strong relationship builder: you translate customer needs into product functionality and lead customers rather than just doing what you’re asked

- Structured and proactive, with strong communication skills; fluent in English and French

- Energetic, open and curious about AI; comfortable in a changing organization

Believe you’d be a great fit for this role, even if you don’t tick every box? Reach out to our Recruitment team! We’d be happy to connect and see if we can make it work together.

What we offer 

At CM.com, we believe in empowering our people to do what they love, excel at what they do, and make a meaningful impact. As a CM.com Club Member, you'll unlock the following benefits:

- Join the club : Join our unique 3-day Global Onboarding program in our Headquarters in Breda, a deep dive into the culture of CM.com .

- Fuel your mind : We will offer you meal vouchers to ensure daily healthy lunches and snacks to keep you energized.

- Effortless commutes : We’ll cover 50% of your transport/travel costs.

- Value for work : Participate in our Sales Incentive Plan, rewarding your achievements with bonuses.

- Take your time off : Recharge with 25 vacation days

- Own your success : Become a shareholder with our Employee Share Purchase Program.

- Level up your skills : Udemy, CM Academy, and exclusive Meetups with thought leaders to ensure you're always learning and growing.

Our diverse perspectives fuel innovation and drive us forward. We welcome everyone, regardless of age, background, or beliefs.

Before you apply 

We work on-site, move fast, and expect you to bring your own thinking. Priorities shift, AI is actively changing how we work and we embrace that reality. If that sounds like a great environment to you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior IA Inference Engineer (x/f/m)
description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare! 

We are looking for a Senior Inference Engineer to join the ML Platform (TIGER) team in AI & Machine Learning .

Your mission will be to power Doctolib's AI-driven healthcare products — from Consultation Assistant to Phone Assistant and Health Companion — by owning the self-hosted LLM serving platform that keeps the most sensitive patient data within infrastructure Doctolib controls. You will build and operate the shared foundations that every AI feature team relies on: deploying, tuning, and scaling open-weight models across our GPU fleet, contributing directly to faster, safer, and more cost-efficient AI for care teams and patients across Europe.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do 

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

- Build the shared LLM serving foundations with MLOps engineers — define the serving stack, GPU capacity planning, and deployment automation for open-weight models (Gemma, Mistral, Llama, Qwen, and their fine-tuned variants) on Ray Serve / Anyscale, while shaping the evolution toward Kubernetes-based orchestration

- Own the model registry and promotion path — establish clear processes for versioning, validating, and promoting models into production, benchmark performance and output quality under realistic workloads, and maintain the curated model catalog together with the Agents Platform team

- Optimize inference performance and efficiency — operate and tune serving engines (vLLM, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT-LLM) to reduce time-to-first-token, inter-token latency, and cost per token through batching, caching, quantization, and parallelism strategies across our GPU fleet (L4 to H200)

- Own production reliability and disaster recovery — define SLOs, run load tests before launches, implement safe rollouts, rollbacks, and autoscaling, and participate in on-call and incident response

- Make serving performance and costs measurable — build Datadog dashboards, alerting, and cost reporting to track latency, GPU utilization, and inference spend, and identify opportunities to improve resource efficiency

- Keep the inference stack secure, compliant, and evolving — work with Security and Privacy on network isolation, data residency, and auditability, while continuously assessing new models, serving engines (such as SGLang), and GPU generations

Who you are 

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you: 

- Have 5+ years of software or computer engineering experience, including hands-on production experience with at least one LLM serving engine (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, TGI, or Triton) — ideally having chosen, introduced, tuned, or scaled one in production, not just run it with defaults

- Are proficient in Python and Terraform, with a solid understanding of transformer inference mechanics: prefill vs. decode, KV cache, batching strategies, and why a model is compute- or memory-bound on a given GPU

- Have strong experience running GPU workloads on Kubernetes or a managed Ray / Anyscale platform, and a performance engineering mindset — you design reproducible benchmarks, read profiler output, and back decisions with numbers

- Are comfortable owning production reliability: observability, incident response, and on-call are a natural part of the role

- Have excellent communication and collaboration skills, high agency, a pragmatic build-vs-buy approach, and are comfortable working in a scope that is still taking shape

- Are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you: 

- Have experience with distributed serving frameworks (KServe, llm-d, NVIDIA Dynamo), including disaggregated prefill/decode or KV-cache-aware routing, or with serving Mixture-of-Experts, multimodal models, or many LoRA adapters on shared base models

- Have GPU kernel experience or deep profiling skills (CUDA, Triton, Nsight), or have contributed to open-source inference projects

- Have experience in regulated environments (healthcare, finance, public sector) and with frameworks such as GDPR, HDS, ISO 27001, or SOC 2

Our stack 

- Programming languages: Python, plus comfort reading/debugging a systems language (C++, Rust, or Go)

- Cloud providers: GCP / AWS / Azure

- Serving orchestration: Ray Serve / Anyscale (GCP), with Kubernetes (GKE) + GPU scheduling as an emerging parallel target

- LLM serving engines (in production): vLLM, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT-LLM (also evaluating SGLang and other emerging engines)

- Models: Self-hosted open-weight LLMs (Gemma, Mistral, Llama, Qwen), fine-tuned in-house

- Experiment tracking & model registry: MLflow

- GenAI gateway: LiteLLM

- LLM evaluation & observability: Braintrust

- GPUs: NVIDIA L4, A10G, L40S, RTX 6000 Pro, A100 (40GB/80GB), H200

- Container / Infra as code: Docker, Terraform, Helm, Kustomize

- Observability: Datadog

We are looking for a Senior Agents Platform Engineer to join the ML Platform (TIGER) team in AI & Machine Learning .
