title: Cleanroom Equipment Technician
description:
Over ons 

De halfgeleiderindustrie vraagt om steeds krachtigere chips: meer bandbreedte, minder energieverbruik. Onze technologie levert precies dat. Wij verbinden chips met computernetwerken die enorme hoeveelheden data verwerken, met minimale vertraging. Samen veranderen we de manier waarop de wereld met elkaar verbonden is.

In Zoetermeer werkt ons grafeenteam aan de toekomst van de halfgeleiderindustrie, van onderzoek en ontwikkeling tot industrialisatie. Op het snijvlak van materiaalkunde en halfgeleidertechnologie ontwikkelt het team de processen om grafeen te produceren, te karakteriseren en te integreren. Die processen vormen de basis van onze geïntegreerde grafeenfotonica. Het team pioniert met nieuwe procestechnologie en schaalt die op tot productierijpe oplossingen. Zo wordt baanbrekend onderzoek omgezet in de bouwstenen van de chips van morgen.

De functie 

Black Semiconductor is op zoek naar een gemotiveerde Technicus (m/v/x) om ons team op locatie in Zoetermeer, Nederland, te versterken.

Je speelt een cruciale rol bij het waarborgen van de betrouwbare werking van alle technische systemen die onze cleanroomomgeving ondersteunen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor onderhouds-, storingsanalyse- en reparatiewerkzaamheden aan voorzieningen zoals luchtbehandeling, gas-, water- en elektrische systemen. Deze functie is ideaal voor een praktisch ingestelde professional met technisch inzicht die graag zelfstandig werkt, technische uitdagingen oplost en nieuwe vaardigheden ontwikkelt in een sterk gecontroleerde en innovatieve omgeving.

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden 

- Zorgdragen voor een veilige en betrouwbare werking van cleanroomvoorzieningen, waaronder HVAC, toevoer- en afvoerlucht, gas-, water- en elektrische infrastructuur.

- Uitvoeren van preventief onderhoud, storingsanalyse en reparaties aan productie en test apparatuur in de cleanroom en cleanroom systemen en inkomende nutsvoorzieningen.

- Technische problemen diagnosticeren en oplossen om stilstand tot een minimum te beperken en de operationele continuïteit te waarborgen.

- Onderhoudswerkzaamheden coördineren en uitvoeren, met inachtneming van normen en veiligheidsvoorschriften.

- Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor technische uitdagingen en proactief mogelijkheden identificeren voor systeemverbeteringen en een hogere betrouwbaarheid.

Jouw kwalificaties 

- Afgeronde beroepsopleiding in een mechanische, technische of onderhoud gerelateerde richting (bijvoorbeeld automonteur, industrieel monteur, mechatronicatechnicus of vergelijkbaar).

- Praktische ervaring met mechanische systemen en basiskennis van elektrische, pneumatische, gas- of utiliteitssystemen.

- Sterke hands-on mentaliteit met het vertrouwen om onbekende technische uitdagingen aan te pakken en nieuwe technologieën te leren.

- Vermogen om zelfstandig te werken, prioriteiten te stellen en volledige verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor toegewezen taken.

- Probleemoplossende instelling, sterke vaardigheden in storingsanalyse en bereidheid om te werken in een cleanroomomgeving met strikte kwaliteits- en veiligheidsnormen.

- Comfortabel met praktisch werk in cleanroom-, laboratorium- en facilitaire omgevingen, inclusief het gebruik van ladders om verhoogde gebieden te bereiken en het werken in beperkte ruimtes onder de cleanroom wanneer dat nodig is.

- In staat om fysiek veeleisende onderhouds- en installatiewerkzaamheden veilig uit te voeren, zoals het vervangen van HEPA-filters, het bedienen van afsluiters, het positioneren van gascilinders en het verplaatsen van zware vacuümpompen. Voor zware lasten worden geschikte hulpmiddelen en ondersteuning van collega’s ingezet.

- Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels, bij voorkeur ook in het Nederlands om te kunnen communiceren met externe partijen, management en operators.

Ervaring in de halfgeleiderindustrie is niet vereist. Je ontvangt de nodige training en ondersteuning om de apparatuur te leren kennen en je technische vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen.

Hoe succes eruitziet 

- Volledige verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de cleanroominfrastructuur , en zorgen voor een betrouwbare werking van luchtbehandeling, gas-, water-, afzuig- en elektrische systemen met minimale stilstand.

- Uitgroeien tot een vertrouwde technische expert binnen het team , door proactief problemen te signaleren, praktische oplossingen te implementeren en bij te dragen aan een veilige en efficiënte werkomgeving.

- Sterke zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel tonen , door onderhouds- en reparatiewerkzaamheden zelfstandig te beheren en effectief prioriteiten te stellen in een dynamische omgeving.

- Technische kennis en vaardigheden continu uitbreiden , snel nieuwe systemen en technologieën eigen maken en tegelijkertijd de hoge standaarden handhaven die vereist zijn binnen een cleanroomomgeving.

Onze werkcultuur 

Mensen boven processen. Bij Black Semiconductor is flexibiliteit essentieel — wij zorgen ervoor dat werk zich aanpast aan het leven, en niet andersom. We stimuleren een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé, waarin carrières betekenisvol en verrijkend zijn. Onze processen zijn mensgericht, zodat jij je kunt richten op wat echt belangrijk is.

Laten we samen groeien. Jouw potentieel staat bij ons centraal. We bieden de autonomie om blijvende impact te maken en ondersteunen jouw groei met een cultuur van continu leren. We investeren in jouw professionele én persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Jouw gezondheid en toekomst zijn belangrijk. Jouw welzijn heeft de hoogste prioriteit. Daarom bieden wij een uitgebreid arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket met uitstekende verzekeringen, een pensioenregeling en virtuele aandelenopties voor jouw mentale, fysieke en financiële gezondheid. Jouw gemoedsrust staat bij ons centraal — nu én in de toekomst.

Wij leven openheid. Samenwerking en inclusiviteit vormen de hoekstenen van onze cultuur. Wij geloven in openheid en bouwen aan vertrouwen en respect. Individualiteit is onze gezamenlijke kracht, die innovatie stimuleert en ons vooruit helpt.

Wij verbinden chips – en mensen. Wij moedigen gekwalificeerde kandidaten van iedere achtergrond aan om te solliciteren. We creëren een inclusieve en ondersteunende werkomgeving waarin samenwerking, innovatie en groei centraal staan. Sluit je aan bij ons team en maak deel uit van een organisatie die een verschil maakt in de industrie.

Kun jij jezelf zien in deze functie en binnen ons bedrijf? Laten we kennismaken.

Your responsibilities will include:

Nice to Have

title: Staff Software Engineer: Applied AI
description:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Staff Software Engineer: Applied AI

Every day, thousands of shipments cross borders, change hands, and hit unexpected problems. For decades, fixing those problems meant phone calls, emails, and humans heroically firefighting. We think that's about to change completely.

We've been building AI agents that spot trouble before it happens, reroute shipments, and keep goods moving—with our team of experts in the loop where it counts. The early results have been jaw-dropping. We're now going all in on a future where supply chains run themselves, and we're looking for the people who want to build that future with us.

This isn't a role where you join a team and pick up tickets. You'll find the highest-leverage problems, design the solutions, and ship them to operators moving freight across 112 countries. If that sounds like your idea of a good time, read on.

What You'll Do

You'll build the cutting-edge agents and AI-powered applications that make Flexport's operations smarter, faster, and increasingly autonomous. That means:

- Designing and shipping end-to-end AI agents that handle real logistics work—customs compliance, document processing, exception management, and more

- An entrepreneurial drive : you thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and don't wait to be told what to do

- An audacious appetite for impact : you're not here to maintain—you're here to change how global trade works

Nice to Have

How We Work

- Stack : Next.js, TypeScript, Postgres, Snowflake. For AI: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google AI APIs

Why This Role Is Special

- Your work is visible : This is a small, senior team reporting directly to the VP of Engineering. What you build gets noticed, and your ideas shape the direction

- Real stakes : thousands of containers, 112 countries, $19 billion of goods. Your agents will have immediate, measurable impact

- Full ownership : from problem definition to production deployment, it's yours

We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from companies like Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta and Google DeepMind. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house - hardware and software, we're explicitly not a hybrid or remote-first company - you can't build robots or walls from home, so we're onsite five days a week.

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company . You might enjoy Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage , or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like .

About the role 

Monumental are already deploying robots into the real world at scale, building beautiful, bespoke homes. Our robots are on sites across the Netherlands and the UK and will be in the US within a year. Every deployment teaches us something about our hardware; you’ll push our R&D fleet to become one ready for large-series production: you'll own taking us from tens of robots a year to hundreds, and then thousands. You'll also keep that growing fleet deployable, and making design changes yourself to improve reliability and serviceability.

Scaling a fleet means solving whatever is in the way: limited space, no clear production process, lead times we can't live with and modules that don't survive the harsh conditions of a construction site. You’ll be expected to wear many hats; we’re looking for people who are genuinely excited to lead these efforts.

Our robots are built from modules at every level of maturity, so expect to work with the hardware R&D team at early stages of development to validate R&D designs as fast as we can. In parallel, you'll be in the workshop determining how we assemble them: the processes, the fixtures, the production space itself, getting the very best out of our Amsterdam facilities.

For more context on building hardware at Monumental, read Niall’s Substack: I quit my job and moved country to make robots that will fix Europe’s housing crisis. 

What you'll do 

- Bottom line, you'll own increasing our quarterly production from 30 sets of robot systems to 100 within a year. This is a challenge. You'll be building the production capabilities at Monumental rather than inheriting them, and you'll do it alongside engineers and technicians who care a great deal about getting this right.

- Take prototypes through to production-ready modules. Find and address design flaws, validate improvements, and push these modules to production.

- Assembling modules, understand the friction slowing production, and address issues yourself along with the hardware team.

- Develop fixtures, jigs and light automation solutions to support module assembly.

- Find production processes that bring minimal value when done in-house. Work with external suppliers to outsource them, while maintaining production quality.

- Produce drawings, assembly instructions and quality checks to make sure our modules are integrated together and our robots are brought up with no errors.

What we're looking for 

- Industry experience, ideally in a VC-backed start-up, transitioning products from prototype to production

- Hands-on, analytical mindset: skilled at building assemblies, running studies, analysing data, solving production and quality issues, and collaborating with technicians to implement and validate improvements

- Proficiency in mechanical assembly (press fits, fastener selection, harness, etc.)

- Strong knowledge of GD&T and producing 3D and 2D drawings

- Experience creating structured process documentation (work instructions, SOPs, quality checklists)

- Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken

Nice-to-haves 

- BSc in Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing or Industrial Engineering, or equivalent

- Familiarity with robotics or complex electromechanical systems

- Experience with ERP tools (Odoo or similar)

Joining Monumental means being at the forefront of a movement aimed at making significant strides in the construction industry. title: IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) – Support & Infrastruktur

description:
Du möchtest dafür sorgen, dass im Arbeitsalltag technisch alles läuft? 

Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Als IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) – Support & Infrastruktur bist du eine wichtige Anlaufstelle für unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen und sorgst gemeinsam mit unserem IT-Team für einen zuverlässigen IT-Betrieb. Ob Anwendersupport, Hardware, Server oder Telefonie: Du kümmerst dich darum, dass unsere IT im Tagesgeschäft funktioniert, löst technische Probleme und entwickelst dein Know-how dabei kontinuierlich weiter. 

Dein Aufgabenbereich 

- Du bist da, wenn die Technik mal nicht mitspielt: Als erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterstützt du bei Fragen und Störungen rund um Hard- und Software und sorgst dafür, dass Probleme schnell und unkompliziert gelöst werden. 

- Ein funktionierender Arbeitsplatz beginnt bei einer zuverlässigen IT: Du richtest Arbeitsplätze, Notebooks und weitere Hardware ein, betreust unsere Endgeräte und stellst sicher, dass unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen technisch gut ausgestattet arbeiten können. 

- Auch hinter den Kulissen muss alles laufen: Gemeinsam mit unserem IT-Team betreust du unsere bestehende IT-Infrastruktur – von Servern und Netzwerken bis hin zu unserer Voice-over-IP-Telefonie – und unterstützt dabei, einen stabilen Betrieb sicherzustellen. 

- IT-Alltag bedeutet Abwechslung: Neue Mitarbeitende technisch onboarden, Berechtigungen einrichten, Hardware austauschen oder eine Störung analysieren – bei dir landen ganz unterschiedliche Themen aus unserem täglichen IT-Betrieb. 

- Nicht jedes Problem endet im 1st Level: Du analysierst technische Störungen, löst sie eigenständig, wo du kannst, und bindest bei komplexeren Fragestellungen die richtigen Kolleginnen und Kollegen oder externen Ansprechpartner ein. 

- Gute IT wird gemeinsam besser: Du dokumentierst Lösungen und wiederkehrende Fragestellungen, bringst deine Erfahrungen aus dem Tagesgeschäft ein und hilfst uns dabei, unsere IT-Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern. 

Deine Vorteile bei der VRT 

- Geld, Zusatzleistungen, Ausgleich: Faires Gehalt, Prämien, Zuschüsse, Rabatte, Gutscheinkarte, bezahlte Überstunden oder Freizeit-Ausgleich – bei der VRT stimmt das Gesamt-Paket, auch unterm Strich! 

- Gleitzeit, Vollzeit oder Teilzeit: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, von Vollzeit in Teilzeit und wieder zurück – bring alles unter einen Hut, was dir am Herzen liegt! 

- Updates, Fortbildungen: Schnittstellen zu unserem DATEV-Anwendersupport, individuelle Fortbildungen u. v. m. – wir bringen dich weiter! 

- Team-Events, Sportangebote, Betriebsausflüge, Weihnachtsfeier, Karnevalsfeier, Lauf- und Fitness-Termine, Urban Sports und EGYM Wellpass, Firmenläufe u. v. m. – wir bei der VRT sind von Natur aus sehr gesellig! 

- IT ist dein Zuhause: Du hast eine Ausbildung im IT-Bereich – zum Beispiel als Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) für Systemintegration – abgeschlossen oder bringst vergleichbare praktische Erfahrungen aus dem IT-Support oder der Systemadministration mit. 

- Du kennst den IT-Alltag: Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung im Anwendersupport und fühlst dich in Microsoft-Umgebungen sowie im Umgang mit Hard- und Software wohl. Kenntnisse rund um Netzwerke, Server oder Voice over IP sind ein Plus – aber kein Muss. 

- Probleme wecken deinen Lösungsinstinkt: Du gehst technischen Störungen gerne auf den Grund, arbeitest strukturiert und behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn mehrere Anfragen gleichzeitig auf deinem Tisch landen. 

- Service gehört für dich zur IT: Du arbeitest gerne mit Menschen zusammen, erklärst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich und hast Freude daran, Kolleginnen und Kollegen bei ihren IT-Fragen weiterzuhelfen. 

- Du möchtest dich weiterentwickeln: Du musst noch nicht alles können. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du neugierig bist, Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest und Lust hast, dein Wissen gemeinsam mit unserem IT-Team kontinuierlich auszubauen. 

Bewirb dich jetzt bei der VRT! 

Mit rund 290 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern und 20 Partnern an unseren neun Standorten (Bad Honnef, Bonn , Euskirchen, Füssen, Gemünd, Köln, Meckenheim, Rheinbach, Siegburg) arbeiten wir jeden Tag aufs Neue an interessanten Aufgabenstellungen für kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen, größere Unternehmen (MDax) sowie Existenzgründer und Privatpersonen in den Bereichen Steuerberatung, Rechtsberatung und Wirtschaftsprüfung. 

Schicke deine Bewerbung innerhalb von nur ca. 3 Minuten über unser Online-Formular zu dieser Stelle auf vrt.de/karriere.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer - B2B platform (Laravel + Nuxt/Vue)
description:
About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the US, using AI to connect 14 million students who are looking for scholarships with companies that are looking for students. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.

The Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled and innovative Senior Full-Stack Engineer to architect high-performance web applications and accelerate our development velocity across our B2B platform. You’ll play a pivotal role in bridging modern Nuxt 3/4 frontend applications—including customer management portals and embeddable widget engines—with a robust Laravel and Doctrine ORM backend API, delivering seamless experiences that connect millions of students to funding opportunities.

You will own the technical implementation of core products across our entire stack, working with PHP 8.2+, Laravel, MySQL, and Vue 3 / Nuxt 3/4 . Beyond traditional engineering, this role champions efficiency: you will deeply integrate AI-native workflows (using tools like Cursor and Google Gemini) to double shipping velocity, automate test coverage, and build intelligent LLM-driven platform features. If you are passionate about full-stack architecture, widget infrastructure, and leveraging AI to build smarter and faster, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do 

- Full Lifecycle Development: Architect, build, and ship end-to-end B2B features across the stack- from Laravel/Doctrine JSON:API endpoints to reactive Nuxt 3/4 Vue components and server routes.

- Embed & Analytics Engine: Develop and optimize high-performance embedded widget systems, Nitro server engine logic, iframe cross-origin messaging, client event-tracking SDKs, and data ingestion pipelines.

- API & Database Architecture: Design robust relational database schemas (MySQL), Doctrine entity mappings, clean migrations, performant RESTful/JSON:API contracts, and Redis caching layers.

- AI-Native Acceleration: Integrate AI coding tools (Cursor, Gemini) into daily development for rapid feature prototyping, code refactoring, test generation, and building LLM-driven product features (e.g., automated applicant evaluation).

- Third-Party Integrations *:* Integrate and maintain core third-party services and APIs, including CRM platforms, error tracking systems, payment gateways, and cloud data services

- Automated Testing & Quality: Establish comprehensive automated test coverage (PHPUnit for backend, Playwright and Vitest for E2E/components) integrated into CI/CD pipelines to guarantee zero regressions.

- Mentorship & Code Reviews: Conduct thorough, constructive code reviews and collaborate closely with product managers, QA engineers, and leadership to elevate team standards.

Required Qualifications (Must Haves)

- Experience: 4+ years of professional full-stack web development experience, with at least 1+ year actively incorporating AI coding assistants into daily engineering workflows.

- Backend Expertise (PHP & Laravel): Strong commercial experience with PHP 8+ and Laravel (clean service architecture, queues/jobs, middleware, and OAuth2/Passport authentication).

- Frontend Mastery (Vue 3 & Nuxt 3/4): Deep proficiency in modern Vue 3 (Composition API), Nuxt 3 or Nuxt 4, TypeScript, Pinia state management, and Tailwind CSS.

- Database & ORM Skills: Strong relational database modeling and query optimization in MySQL, along with solid experience using ORMs (Doctrine ORM / DBAL or deep Eloquent experience with the ability to adapt to Doctrine quickly).

- API Design & Caching: Deep understanding of RESTful / JSON:API standards, server-side validation error mapping, request formatting, and Redis performance caching.

- AI-Native Workflow: Active daily use of AI coding tools (Cursor, Gemini) as a force multiplier for coding, debugging, and test creation.

- Automated Testing: Hands-on experience writing backend test suites (PHPUnit) and frontend/E2E tests (Playwright, Vitest, or Cypress).

- DevOps & Tooling: Solid working knowledge of Git, CI/CD release pipelines, Docker containerization, and Linux/container environments.

- Async Communication & Autonomy: Exceptional written technical communication skills for authoring PRs, architectural design docs, and issue tracking; high autonomy to navigate multi-service codebases, solve complex blockers independently, and drive initiatives.

Good to Have

- Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical software engineering experience.

- Certifications *:* Advanced degree or formal certifications in Cloud Architecture, Modern Software Engineering, or AI Engineering.

- Doctrine ORM: Direct production experience with Doctrine ORM / DBAL in Laravel environments.

- Widget & SDK Systems: Experience developing embeddable web widgets, lightweight JavaScript tracking SDKs, iframe cross-origin communication, or browser fingerprinting.

- Modern Tooling: Experience with Nitro server engines, Bun runtime, PrimeVue components, or streaming data into data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery).

- Payment Gateways: Integration experience with payment processors (Stripe/Braintree) and B2B subscription billing lifecycles.

- Gemini LLM Integration: Practical experience integrating Google Gemini models (prompt engineering, structured JSON outputs, Gemini API / SDKs).

- Cloud Infrastructure (GCP): Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Kubernetes, Cloud Build).

Bonus Skills (The "X-Factor")

- Technical Leadership: Prior experience in a Tech Lead or Team Lead capacity—driving architectural decisions, coordinating delivery, and unblocking team members.

- Domain Knowledge: Background in high-growth B2B SaaS platforms, grant/applicant management systems, EdTech, recruitment/ATS tools, or conversion tracking ecosystems.

- Product-Minded Execution: Strong product ownership mindset—evaluating engineering trade-offs through the lens of user experience, conversion funnel impact, and tangible business value.

Why Join ScholarshipOwl?

- Mission-Driven Work: Build technology that helps students unlock education opportunities and reduce financial barriers.

- Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world while collaborating with a global team.

- High Impact & Ownership: You aren't just a cog in a machine; you own your domain and directly drive results.

- Unlimited PTO: We value outcomes over hours worked and trust you to manage your time.

- Computer Upgrade Budget: Up to $1,600 to invest in your ideal primary work computer.

- Workspace Upgrade Program: Up to $800 to set up your home office.

- Monthly Coworking Allowance: $200/month to rent desks or workspace passes whenever you want a change of scenery.

- Owl Shine Program: Monthly employee recognition and awards celebrating extraordinary contributions.

- Continuous Learning Culture: Dedicated support for curiosity, bold experimentation, and career growth.

- Annual Global Off-sites: Connect with your teammates in person at exciting locations around the world. 

Ready to lead and build something meaningful? 

Apply now and help us shape the future of AI-powered education.

Berlin-Oberschöneweide | Vor Ort

OBJECTS Presswerk ist ein unabhängiges Vinyl-Presswerk in Berlin-Oberschöneweide. Mit eigener Galvanik und moderner Produktion stellen wir Schallplatten für Musiklabels und Künstler aus aller Welt her.

Als Teil des internationalen Yoyaku-Netzwerks verbinden wir industrielle Fertigung mit der Musikbranche. Wir arbeiten in einem kleinen, internationalen Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Raum für Eigeninitiative.

Deine Rolle

Wir suchen eine zuverlässige und selbstständige Persönlichkeit, die unsere kaufmännischen und administrativen Abläufe im Alltag verantwortet.

Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für administrative und finanzielle Themen am Berliner Standort und arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung, unserem Produktionsteam sowie unserer externen Steuerberatung zusammen.

Unser Ziel ist einfach: Du sorgst dafür, dass die administrativen und finanziellen Abläufe zuverlässig funktionieren, wichtige Informationen verfügbar sind und offene Themen konsequent vorangebracht werden. 

Dabei geht es nicht um eine klassische Finanzleitungsposition, sondern um eine vielseitige, operative Rolle mit eigenständiger Verantwortung.

Die steuerliche Buchführung, Lohnabrechnung und Jahresabschlüsse werden weiterhin von externen Fachleuten betreut.

Deine Aufgaben

Finanzen & vorbereitende Buchhaltung 

- Eingangs- und Ausgangsrechnungen prüfen, bearbeiten und nachverfolgen

- Belege und Buchhaltungsunterlagen vollständig und strukturiert organisieren

- Zahlungsübersichten pflegen, Überweisungen vorbereiten und offene Posten überwachen

- Mit der externen Steuerberatung zusammenarbeiten und Rückfragen klären

- Einfache Finanzübersichten und regelmäßige Berichte für die Geschäftsführung erstellen

Administration & Organisation 

- Verträge, Versicherungen, Dokumente und wichtige Fristen verwalten

- Administrative Korrespondenz mit Banken, Behörden und Geschäftspartnern koordinieren

- Personalunterlagen, Abwesenheiten und Spesen organisieren

- Informationen für die externe Lohnabrechnung vorbereiten

- Das operative Team bei kaufmännischen Fragen unterstützen

Eigenverantwortung & Prozessverbesserung 

- Laufende administrative Themen selbstständig bearbeiten und nachhalten

- Unstimmigkeiten erkennen, Lösungen vorschlagen und notwendige Entscheidungen vorbereiten

- Digitale Prozesse gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung verbessern

- Mit Odoo, Excel und Google Workspace arbeiten und Informationen zentral und nachvollziehbar dokumentieren

Dein Profil

Du musst keine erfahrene Finanzleitung sein. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du organisiert, sorgfältig und verlässlich arbeitest, Verantwortung übernimmst und dich auch in neue Themen selbstständig einarbeiten kannst.

Das bringst du mit: 

- Praktische Erfahrung in der kaufmännischen Administration, im Office Management oder in der vorbereitenden Buchhaltung

- Einen sicheren Umgang mit Zahlen, Rechnungen und organisatorischen Abläufen

- Eine strukturierte, gewissenhafte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

- Gute Excel- oder Google-Sheets-Kenntnisse

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

- Eigeninitiative, Diskretion und die Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen

Von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung: 

- Erfahrung mit Odoo, DATEV oder ähnlichen Systemen

- Kenntnisse deutscher Buchhaltungs- und Verwaltungsprozesse

- Erfahrung in einem kleinen oder mittelständischen Unternehmen

- Interesse an Musik, Technik oder industrieller Produktion

Eine kaufmännische Ausbildung ist willkommen, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich. Entscheidend sind deine praktischen Fähigkeiten und deine Arbeitsweise.

- Eine unbefristete Anstellung mit 35 Stunden pro Woche oder einem vereinbarten Teilzeitmodell

- Einen abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsplatz direkt in unserem Vinyl-Presswerk

- Ein internationales Team und kurze Entscheidungswege

- Die Möglichkeit, administrative und digitale Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten

- Eine langfristige Perspektive in einem besonderen Produktions- und Musikumfeld

32.000–38.000 € brutto jährlich auf Basis von 35 Wochenstunden , abhängig von Erfahrung und Qualifikation. Bei Teilzeit erfolgt die Vergütung anteilig.

OBJECTS Presswerk GmbH
Wilhelminenhofstraße 76/77
12459 Berlin

title: Customer Integration Engineer
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Application Engineering Team(s) 

We’re seeking an exceptional Customer Integration Engineer to join our Germany-based team within the Application Engineering org, focused on localising and advancing Wayve’s autonomous driving technology for the German market. This is a unique opportunity to play a hands-on role in shaping our AV capabilities in Germany from the ground up.

🧠 Your day-to-day 

In this role, you will play a critical part in supporting our customers throughout the entire development lifecycle, from the initial integration phase to the final validation of our technology. You will ensure that customers receive responsive, high-quality technical support and work closely with both our clients and internal engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of our technology into their vehicles.

Located near our customers, you will be in a prime position to perform rapid diagnostics, identify issues in real time, and collaborate directly with customer engineering teams. This proximity allows you to maintain a holistic understanding of the system and effectively distinguish between vehicle-related issues and those specific to the Wayve AI Driver.

🧩 What you’ll be working on 

- Provide hands-on technical support to customers throughout the development and validation process

- Serve as the bridge between customer vehicle integration teams and Wayve’s internal engineering teams

- Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to our technology independently

- Escalate complex or critical issues to the appropriate internal stakeholders

- Develop deep understanding of customer systems and APIs (e.g. drive-by-wire) to effectively guide internal teams

- Maintain a system-level perspective to identify root causes, whether vehicle-based or software-related

🙌 You should apply if 

- Strong problem-solving skills and analytical thinking

- Proven ability to lead investigations into platform or vehicle issues in collaboration with internal and customer teams
Extensive hands-on experience with development vehicles

- Proficiency with diagnostic and calibration tools (e.g. CANape or similar)

- Familiarity with terminal usage and a willingness to develop basic programming skills

- Solid understanding of vehicle communication protocols (e.g. CAN, Ethernet) and automotive system architectures

- Practical experience working in an automotive environment, ideally with a track record of bringing products to production

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration with both customers and internal teams

- Willingness to travel as required

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve: 

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: 

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process: 

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

- Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

- Competency Interviews [Integration Competency, 60mins]

- Deep-dive technical interviews [Vehicle Integration, 60mins, Automotive, 60mins]

- Final interview : [Mission & Values alignment, 30mins].

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

title: Senior Quality Engineer - Checkout & Payments (m/w/d)
description:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt. 

Als Senior Quality Engineer – Checkout & Payments trägst du dazu bei, zuverlässige Zahlungsabläufe über Shopware, Shopware Payments und externe Systeme hinweg sicherzustellen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf praxisnahen Integrationstests, Testautomatisierung und Release-Validierung: Du prüfst, ob Kund:innen einen Kauf erfolgreich abschließen können, Bestell- und Zahlungsstatus korrekt sind und Fehler sowie Wiederholungsversuche sicher verarbeitet werden. 

Du wirst Teil des Bereichs Quality Operations innerhalb von Delivery Excellence und arbeitest eng mit den Teams Checkout & Payments, dem Produktmanagement und weiteren Quality Engineers zusammen. Du bringst Qualität früh in die Feature-Planung ein, überführst Produktrisiken in ausführbare Tests, untersuchst Fehler und gibst klare Empfehlungen zur Release-Bereitschaft. Die Position ist eine Senior-Engineering-Rolle ohne Führungsverantwortung. Du entwickelst das bestehende Framework für Abnahmetests und die CI-Infrastruktur weiter, statt eine separate Testorganisation aufzubauen. 

- Risikobasierte Testabdeckung definieren und umsetzen. Arbeite mit Product und Engineering zusammen, um kritische Abläufe für Händler:innen und Kund:innen, die vorhandene Testabdeckung und Lücken zu identifizieren. Stimme für jedes Entwicklungspaket einen klar abgegrenzten Testumfang ab und begleite ihn durch Umsetzung, Review und Validierung. 

- Automatisierte Tests entwickeln und pflegen. Nutze TypeScript, Playwright sowie API- und Integrationstests, um das Verhalten im Storefront, in Shopware, im Payments-Service und an den Schnittstellen zu Zahlungsanbietern zu prüfen. Wähle die passende Testebene, statt jede Prüfung in einem Browser-Test abzubilden. 

- Zahlungsergebnisse prüfen, nicht nur das UI-Verhalten. Kontrolliere Bestellerstellung, Zahlungsstatus, Beträge und Währungen. Ergänze die Testabdeckung entsprechend dem Produktrisiko um relevante Szenarien zu Stornierung, Einzug, Rückerstattung, Webhooks und Wiederherstellung. 

- Integrationsfehler gemeinsam mit Entwickler:innen bewerten. Prüfe bei Bedarf Authentifizierung, Mandantentrennung, wiederholte Anfragen, Idempotenz und asynchrone Statusänderungen. Stelle sicher, dass Fehler weder doppelte Zahlungen noch inkonsistente Bestellungen verursachen. 

- Testergebnisse für die Auslieferung nutzbar machen. Integriere und pflege Produkttests gemeinsam mit Engineering und Product Operations in der CI. Verbessere Testdaten, Wiederholbarkeit und Diagnosemöglichkeiten. Unterscheide zwischen Produktfehlern, Problemen bei Zahlungsanbietern oder Umgebungen und instabilen Tests. 

- Releases und Kompatibilität validieren. Prüfe relevante Release-Artefakte, Upgrades und unterstützte Konfigurationen im bestehenden Release-Prozess. Überführe Erkenntnisse aus Vorfällen in Regressionstests und konkrete Verbesserungen. 

- Eine klare QA-Empfehlung kommunizieren. Erläutere gegenüber Product und Engineering den geprüften Umfang, die Ergebnisse, verbleibende Risiken, Blocker und nächsten Schritte. Sprich Prioritätskonflikte frühzeitig an und begleite offene Punkte bis zu ihrer Lösung, einer vereinbarten Übergabe oder einer klaren Entscheidung. 

- Verantwortung und Wissen teilen. Prüfe Testcode, arbeite mit Kolleg:innen im Pairing und verbessere gemeinsam nutzbare Fixtures und Dokumentation. Stimme dich mit anderen Quality Engineers ab, damit die Testabdeckung von mehreren Personen gepflegt und unterstützt werden kann. 

Das bringst du mit: 

- Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Pflege automatisierter Tests für produktive Software, einschließlich API- und Integrationstests sowie End-to-End-Tests. 

- Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in TypeScript oder JavaScript und praktische Erfahrung mit Playwright oder einem vergleichbaren Framework. Du kannst sicher in einer Playwright-basierten Codebasis arbeiten. 

- Erfahrung mit CI-Pipelines, Git, Code-Reviews, reproduzierbaren Testumgebungen und der Fehlersuche mithilfe von Logs, Traces und Anwendungscode. 

- Verständnis von HTTP-APIs, Authentifizierung, asynchroner Verarbeitung und Zustandsübergängen – einschließlich der Frage, wie sich Fehler- und Wiederholungsverhalten testen lässt. 

- Die Fähigkeit, unklare Produktanforderungen in testbare Szenarien zu übersetzen, nach Risiko zu priorisieren und sinnvolle Arbeitsschritte umzusetzen – und bei Bedarf Unterstützung einzuholen. 

- Eine kooperative Haltung: Du arbeitest gern im Team, lernst neugierig von anderen und gibst dein Wissen und deine Erfahrung gern weiter. 

- Klare mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikation auf Englisch sowie Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit Entwickler:innen und Produktkolleg:innen zu Qualitätsrisiken und Release-Entscheidungen. 

Von Vorteil: 

Erfahrung mit Zahlungsanbietern, E-Commerce oder Finanztransaktionen ist hilfreich. Ebenso willkommen sind Kenntnisse in PHP/Symfony, Shopware, API-Vertragstests auf OpenAPI-Basis, containerisierten Umgebungen oder mandantenfähigen Services. Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Entwicklungs- und Testwerkzeugen ist ebenfalls willkommen, sofern die Ergebnisse eigenständig geprüft und verifiziert werden. 

Wir schätzen unterschiedliche Karrierewege und Perspektiven. Du musst nicht in jedem der genannten Bereiche Erfahrung mitbringen, um dich zu bewerben. Kenntnisse in Shopware oder PayPal sind keine Voraussetzung.

title: Senior Rust Software Engineer - Industrial Automation (all genders)
description:
About The Company 

GROPYUS is a technology-based construction company focused on building multi-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with a wide range of design options, automated offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company is able to create resilient timber housing quickly and cost-effectively. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, strengthen Europe’s innovation capacity, and play a substantial role in improving sustainability. The company delivers its multi-family houses as a complete and turnkey solution. The combination of technology, construction, robotics, and manufacturing expertise means buildings can be created in a fully digitalized end-to-end process. The building system is based on versatile wall and slab elements, making it easier to optimize land use, customize plans, and build fast with both off-site construction and on-site assembly. This system is complemented by the Building Operating System–developed in-house.

About the role

You will join the Machine Integration & Simulation team, building the software platform that powers our machines, robots, and manufacturing systems. 

Teams at GROPYUS own what they build, including architecture, testing, deployment, monitoring, and operations. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will develop software that connects digital production workflows with physical manufacturing equipment and simulation environments. 

While you will work closely with machines, robots, and industrial systems, your primary focus will be building reliable, maintainable, and observable software using modern engineering practices. 

Our team is driving the evolution towards Software Defined Manufacturing , building systems that enable simulation, integration, orchestration, and operation of our production environment at scale. Rust is the primary language of the team. 

Your area of responsibilities include: 

- Design, build, test, deploy, and operate software for machines, robots, and manufacturing systems 

- Develop machine-near applications, integration services in Rust 

- Build interfaces between production systems, simulation environments, and manufacturing equipment 

- Own software throughout its lifecycle, from implementation to production support 

- Apply modern engineering practices including code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, and observability 

- Monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve production systems 

- Collaborate with software engineers, industrial engineers, and production teams to translate manufacturing requirements into robust software solutions 

About you

Must-have skills

- 5+ experience designing and building production systems in Rust 

- Experience designing, deploying, and operating software in production environments 

- Ability to work effectively with modern AI-enabled development tooling and continuously explore new ways to improve engineering productivity 

- Solid understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, APIs, and software architecture 

- Experience with CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and release management 

- Strong incident handling and problem-solving skills including on-call shift duty 

- Ownership mindset and passion for building reliable and resilient systems 

Nice-to-have skills

- Experience with industrial robots (KUKA), manufacturing, or industrial systems 

- Experience with IIoT, OPC UA, MQTT, or similar communication protocols 

- Experience with simulation, digital twins in the automation context, or edge computing 

- Linux and database fundamentals 

- Experience with Kubernetes and Azure 

- Experience working in environments where software downtime has a direct operational impact 

What We Offer 

- An unlimited contract with 30 vacation days. 

- Flexible, hybrid work: You can work from home or come into the office on the schedule that works best for you. Feel like traveling and working from another location? No problem. Tune into meetings and work from abroad for up to 40 days per year. In addition, flex hours allow you to prioritize important moments in your day. 

- Attractive perks and benefits : We offer a company pension scheme, language courses (English/German), and employee discounts with selected sustainable brands. Furthermore, our external partners in mental health support you in strengthening your mental health through anonymous private/group sessions. 

- Virtual Shares Program : Participate in the success of GROPYUS through our Virtual Share Program. 

- Ownership : You can truly make your mark with your work and contributions – on all our organizational levels. Find your solutions, drive and test them. 

- The chance to be part of something big : Our mission is to rethink an entire industry. Join us in reinventing construction and fostering sustainable, affordable living. 

- A diverse and enriching work environment : Become a valued member of a wonderfully diverse team of individuals from over 50 countries. At GROPYUS we value inclusion above all, ensuring that everyone feels they belong – no matter their background. In this way, our differences become strengths that help us grow as a team. 

Join us on our mission to design buildings as continuously evolving products to create the most exciting and affordable experience for all. We build for people and conserve the resources of our planet.

We can't wait to get to know you. 
For more information, visit our website .

title: Founders Associate Intern (Ops & Marketing)
description:
Mercura ( YC W25 ) helps the companies that build the real world move at software speed, automating the back-office work that runs the $12 trillion industry behind every hospital, school, and power plant. We started with one of their biggest bottlenecks - turning messy technical requests into accurate quotes - and eightfolded our revenue in 12 months . With a team of 16, we're now targeting $10M by the end of 2026 as well as our expansion into the US.

About the role

We’re looking for a Founder's Associate Intern (Marketing & Ops) to help make Mercura one of the most visible and compelling B2B AI companies in Europe.

You will take real ownership of how Mercura shows up externally — to customers, candidates and the broader ecosystem. You’ll work closely with the founders and team to turn ideas, company developments and customer insights into content, campaigns, events and new growth initiatives.

This is not an internship where you execute a predefined marketing calendar. We want someone who comes up with ideas, launches them quickly, measures what works and doubles down.

If you want to learn how to build a company, enjoy creating things from scratch and care deeply about results, this is an opportunity to own a meaningful part of Mercura from day one.

What you will be working on

- Company & Founder Marketing: Own and grow Mercura's company and founder LinkedIn presence. Turn what happens inside Mercura into content that reaches prospective customers, exceptional candidates and the wider industry.

- Growth Marketing: Develop and test new ways to generate awareness, inbound demand and talent. Come up with experiments, launch them quickly and measure whether they actually move the numbers.

- SEO, AI Visibility & Website: Help grow Mercura's organic presence across Google and AI search. Work with experienced external experts on SEO, AI visibility, website structure, conversion and design — and turn their recommendations into execution.

- Events: Build memorable events for both customers and talent — from recruiting events and community formats to intimate dinners with CEOs and strategic prospects. Own everything from the initial idea and guest list to invitations and execution.

- Brand & Content: Create landing pages, customer stories, campaigns, event concepts and other assets that make Mercura stand out and explain why what we are building matters.

- New Initiatives: Spot opportunities we haven't thought of yet. If you believe a campaign, partnership, event or completely different idea could create meaningful impact, you will have the freedom to make it happen.

What we’re looking for

Skills & Experience

- You have already gained hands-on marketing experience — for example at a startup, through an internship, your own project, student initiative or company.

- You can write exceptionally well and understand what makes people stop, read and take action.

- You have a strong instinct for content, positioning and what makes a company or person interesting.

- You combine creativity with commercial thinking. You care about reach, qualified leads, great applicants and actual outcomes , not just producing content.

- You are comfortable using AI tools and learn new tools extremely quickly.

- You take full ownership. If something needs to happen, you figure out how to make it happen rather than waiting for instructions.

- Your German is C2/native-level. This is a hard requirement. You are also a strong professional communicator in English.

Personality & Commitment

- You’re entrepreneurial, ambitious and highly proactive.

- You have strong drive and hold yourself to a high standard.

- You enjoy starting with a blank page and turning an idea into something real.

- You are creative, but equally comfortable with execution and the unglamorous details required to make something successful.

- You are highly organized and can run several initiatives simultaneously without losing speed.

- You care about results and naturally ask: Did this actually work? How can we make it better? 

- You want to work in person in Munich and thrive in an environment with significantly higher intensity and ownership than a typical 9–5 internship.

Availability

- You are available for a minimum 4-month full-time internship .

- Ideally, you are in the final semester of your Bachelor's or Master's degree , or have recently graduated.

- We are explicitly looking for people who could imagine staying at Mercura afterwards. If there is a strong mutual fit, there is an opportunity to transition into a full-time role .

Why Mercura

- Learn how to build a company: You’ll work close to the founders and see how decisions are made across growth, product, sales, hiring and company building — while owning projects yourself.

- Real ownership: You won’t just support marketing. You will own initiatives end-to-end and have the freedom to propose and build things that don't exist yet.

- An unusually steep learning curve: You’ll work across content, growth, brand, events, SEO, AI visibility and operations rather than spending months on one narrow internship project.

- Exceptional people around you: Work alongside experienced operators, ex-founders, engineers and top graduates from companies and universities such as Google, Bain, MIT, TUM, Harvard, CDTM and Cambridge.

- Build something with real-world impact: Mercura brings modern AI into industries that still rely heavily on emails, PDFs, phone calls and manual ERP processes.

- Tools without bureaucracy: Get access to the AI, marketing and productivity tools you need to do great work, as well as expert support where it helps you move faster.

- The everyday: Free team dinners, UrbanSportsClub membership, team workouts and support relocating to Munich.

About the process

Step 1: Intro Call 
A short conversation to get to know each other and tell you more about Mercura and the role.

Step 2: Practical Marketing Case 
A practical exercise around a real Mercura marketing challenge. We care much more about how you think, create and execute than theoretical marketing knowledge.

Step 3: Offer 
If there is a strong mutual fit, we'll make you an offer.

About the Founders 

We are Lukas, Stefan & Sean , the co-founders of Mercura. 

We share a deep commitment to excellence and the discipline to pursue what others might consider impossible. 

Two of us come from non-academic families, and we all know what it means to create our own paths and overcome barriers. This experience shapes our belief in equal opportunity and fuels our dedication to social mobility.

Lukas (left) is responsible for business development at Mercura. With his background as a Data Scientist at Allianz and at Google in Silicon Valley, he brings extensive expertise in data and AI. 
Lukas’ family has been active in the construction industry for over 100 years, giving him a deep understanding and passion for the sector's specific needs.

Sean (middle) is responsible for technical development at Mercura. As a top 0.01% physicist, Sean earned a Silver medal for Germany at the International Physics Olympiad (IPhO), began researching with the Max Planck Institute at the age of 16, and has since published at leading machine learning conferences. 

Stefan (right) leads product development at Mercura. Previously, he worked in management consulting at Bain & Company, where he helped manufacturers improve their operations. 
Stefan leverages his research experience at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and Harvard Business School to develop innovative solutions for the industry.

At Mercura, we believe that the best ideas emerge when people from different backgrounds collaborate together. We hire based on ability, mindset, and values, and we live by one simple rule: the best idea wins.

Beyond Mercura, we actively support initiatives that promote diversity and gender equity and commit a portion of our personal income each year to organizations expanding opportunity for others.

title: Director of Go-to-Market Engineering
description:
About Us 

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem .

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role 

We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering .

Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it.

You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations , lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter.

This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace.

The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV.

What You'll Do 

Own the strategy and the stack 

- Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.

- Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.

- Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.

- Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.

Build, hands-on 

- Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.

- Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.

- Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.

- Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.

Automate across SDR, AE, and AM 

- Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.

- Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.

- Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.

- Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.

Bridge commercial and technical 

- Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.

- Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.

- Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.

Build the team 

- Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.

- Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely.

- Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure.

What Will Make You Successful 

Experience 

- Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS

- Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team

- Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.

Technical craft 

- Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.

- Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.

- Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.

- Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.

- Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly.

Commercial instinct 

- You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.

- You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer.

- You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have 

- Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.

- Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy.

- Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America.

Why This Role 

GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. This is the chance to own it properly, the stack, the architecture, the build, and the commercial outcome across a $300M+ revenue business with 800 people in the field, a genuine appetite for automation, and the budget and executive backing to move fast.

You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible.

If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here.

AI at Perk 
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work 

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

What You Bring

- You're hands-on with APIs, webhooks and automation tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier or Clay; Python or TypeScript and SQL are a strong plus.

- You know ad platform and CRM data: audiences, conversion tracking and the limits of attribution.

Über Scento

Scento ist Europas größte Website für Parfum-Abfüllungen. Das 2024 gegründete Unternehmen hat seinen Hauptsitz in Paris an der Place Vendôme und ein zweites Büro in Berlin. Scento bietet mehr als 1.000 originale Designer- und Nischendüfte aus einem Portfolio von 200 Parfumhäusern als Abfüllungen an: Fläschchen mit 2 ml, 5 ml und 8 ml sowie bei den meisten Düften eine 30-ml-Flasche. Mit Parfumproben von Nischen- und Designerdüften lässt sich ein Duft entdecken, bevor man sich für einen ganzen Flakon entscheidet. Jedes Parfum ist ein Original von autorisierten europäischen Händlern, und jede Flasche durchläuft vor dem Abfüllen eine 12-Punkte-Eingangsprüfung in Scentos ISO-zertifizierter Einrichtung.

Scento beliefert Kundinnen und Kunden in 27 europäischen Märkten und versendet in 26 EU-Länder. Scentos Jahresumsatz liegt 2026 bei mehr als 30 Millionen Euro, online und offline zusammen. Auf Scento.com war der monatliche Absatz von Abfüllungen im September 2026 3,2-mal so hoch wie im Januar 2026. Nach eigenen Angaben verkauft Scento mehr als 3 Millionen Parfum-Abfüllungen pro Jahr, etwa eine alle 10 Sekunden. Im November 2025 kündigte Scento an, über drei Jahre 25 Millionen Euro in die Entdeckung von Parfum in Europa zu investieren.

Deine Rolle

Scento verkauft Parfumproben und Abfüllungen an Kundinnen und Kunden in 27 europäischen Märkten, und fast jede Entscheidung hängt an Zahlen: Wie viel Marketingbudget lohnt sich, welche Düfte gehen aus, welche Kohorten kommen wieder. Als Head of Data & Analytics baust du die Grundlage, auf der diese Entscheidungen fallen.

Du verantwortest das Datenfundament von Warehouse und Pipelines bis zu Kennzahlen und Dashboards, entwickelst Modelle für Attribution, LTV und Marge und prognostizierst die Nachfrage gemeinsam mit Operations und Einkauf. Erfolg heißt: Jedes Team arbeitet selbstständig mit Zahlen, denen alle vertrauen.

Deine Aufgaben

- Du verantwortest Scentos Daten: Warehouse, Pipelines, Metrikdefinitionen und Dashboards.
- Du baust Attributions-, Kohorten-, LTV- und Margenmodelle, die Marketingausgaben steuern.
- Du prognostizierst die Nachfrage nach Parfums und Decants gemeinsam mit Operations und Einkauf.
- Du sorgst dafür, dass jedes Team verlässliche Zahlen selbst abrufen und verstehen kann.
- Du misst die echte Wirkung von Marketing mit Inkrementalitätstests und klaren Experimentdesigns.
- Du baust die Data-Funktion auf und führst sie mit hohem Anspruch an Qualität und Tempo.
Dein Profil

- Mindestens 8 Jahre in Analytics oder Data Science, davon mindestens 3 Jahre Führung einer Data-Funktion im E-Commerce oder Consumer-Tech.
- Exzellentes SQL und Statistik; Erfahrung mit modernen Data Stacks und Produktanalytik.

Was wir bieten

- Ein Gehalt am oberen Ende des Marktes plus ein jährlicher Leistungsbonus.
- Remote-freundlich innerhalb der EU, mit Büros in Paris (Place Vendôme) und Berlin.
- Ein persönliches Lernbudget von 2.500 € pro Jahr für Kurse, Konferenzen und Bücher.
- Ein großzügiges monatliches Parfum-Budget, um den gesamten Katalog zu entdecken.

title: Engineering Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Join the team rewriting the rules in private markets. 

Moonfare delivers what few others can: the highly sought-after funds and hidden-gem investments that go beyond what most private banks offer. Every opportunity is subjected to a ruthless vetting process; the bar is unforgivingly high. The result? Institutional-quality portfolios for investors who demand more.

Our team combines finance veterans with talent from tech, consulting, law and industries you’d never expect. Headquartered in Berlin, we operate from eight offices across Europe, the US and Asia.

If you're ready to build what's next in private markets, let's talk.

Engineering Manager (m/f/d) 

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a meaningful part of our engineering organisation. You will be leading one or more product engineering teams alongside the DevOps and infrastructure engineers, who own the foundations everything else is built on – our cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, architecture and observability. Across these teams, you'll own their health, growth and delivery, and you'll be accountable both for the products they ship and for the reliability, security and scalability of the systems beneath them.

We're also at the start of a deliberate change in how we build, with a greater focus on AI enablement. We're early in this, and we want a manager who's excited to help lead it – rethinking how the team works, what good looks like, and where human judgement matters most when agents do more of the building. What sits underneath all of this is consistency: working in financial services means the bar for security, reliability and correctness is high, and the people who build well here are the ones who take that seriously without losing pace.

You will: 

- Lead, support and grow your engineers across product and platform – running thoughtful 1-to-1s, setting clear expectations, and helping people develop toward the careers they want.

- Own delivery across your teams. Where you lead product teams, partner closely with Product and Design to shape a realistic roadmap and create the conditions to ship it well; where you lead platform and infrastructure, set the priorities that keep the whole organisation moving.

- Own the technical direction of our infrastructure and architecture – cloud, networking, data, deployment, and the patterns other teams build on.

- Hold a high bar for engineering quality, and balance new platform work against the infrastructure and architectural debt that any scaling company accumulates.

- Help lead our move toward agentic engineering — setting how the team uses AI coding tools well, building the workflows and guardrails for delegating work to agents, and keeping quality, security and review standards high as more of the implementation is automated.

- Hire well, and partner with other engineering managers and senior engineers to raise the standard of how the whole organisation builds, runs and secures software.

The Next Moonfarian: 

- Experience managing software engineers — you've led at least one team, owned its delivery and growth, and you know how to develop people as well as systems. Experience leading more than one team, or a mix of product and platform engineers, is a strong plus.

- A strong engineering background in infrastructure, platform or backend systems, with the depth to set architectural direction and be respected by senior engineers.

- Deep, hands–on experience with cloud infrastructure — AWS in particular — and modern infrastructure practice: infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform), containers and orchestration, CI/CD, and observability.

- A coaching instinct: you take satisfaction in other people's growth and success, not only your own output.

- Clear communication, and the judgement to know when to dig into detail and when to step back and trust your team. You’re able to collaborate confidently with both technical and non–technical stakeholders.

- Comfort with ambiguity and change. We're scaling and evolving, and the role will too.

- Hands–on experience with modern AI coding tools – for example Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar agentic assistants. You use them in your own work, have a considered view on where they help and where they don't, and want to bring a team along with you as the way we build changes.

title: People Advisor
description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

About the role 

You're the local face of People at Legora: bringing local expertise, judgement and a strong understanding of employment practices to support employees and managers through a range of people matters. You will provide local advisory support, run local casework from start to finish, fill process and policy gaps, and make sure the employee experience in your market is accurate, timely and well handled. This is a hands-on, operational role and a strong launchpad for your next step. You'll be close enough to the business to understand how each function really works, trusted to make real judgment calls on the ground, and sharp enough to know when something needs a specialist instead. Sitting within People Operations, you will act as an escalation for our People Operations Specialists, providing guidance and resolving matters that require local interpretation, judgement or a more tailored approach

You'll partner closely with Employee Relations & Compliance, who own our jurisdictional frameworks, create consistent standards, and provide specialist expertise for complex, contested or legally sensitive matters. You'll also work alongside our People Business Partners, sharing local insights and supporting the effective delivery of people initiatives and organisational changes within your local market.

What you'll own 

- Provide practical advice to employees, managers and People Operations colleagues on local employment practices, policies and people matters that require interpretation or judgement.

- 

- Running local cases from start to finish within the scope of your certification, including absence management, ongoing performance concerns and restructuring conversations, with each one properly scoped, documented and closed

- Handling intake for leave, accommodation and absence requests, resolving what's routine and recognizing what needs to go further

- Building out local process and policy, and ensuring people programs effectively land in your market.

- Identify opportunities to improve local processes, employee experiences and ways of working, collaborating with other People teams to implement improvements.

- Applying your market's jurisdiction playbook accurately and consistently, and flagging where it doesn't fit local reality

- Recognizing the moment a matter becomes formal, contested or legally sensitive, and handing it off the same day with everything the next person needs to pick it up seamlessly

- Keeping your certification and calibration current so your casework meets the same standard as every other market

- Work closely with People Business Partners and Employee Relations & Compliance, sharing local trends, recurring issues and emerging risks to inform broader people decisions and improvements.

What success looks like 

- Employees and managers get fast, consistent, local support without having to wait on anyone

- Every case you run is well documented and would stand up to close scrutiny

- Handoffs are clean and immediate, and nothing formal or legally sensitive stays with you longer than it should

- Patterns you spot locally, such as a recurring issue or a risk building in one team, are raised early with both Employee Relations & Compliance and the relevant People Partner, before they become bigger problems

- You're a trusted, visible presence in your market: the person people choose to go to, not a channel they're told to use

Who you are 

- Experience in an HR, People Operations or HR generalist role, ideally with some exposure to employee relations casework

- A good understanding of local employment practices, employee relations and HR policies, with the ability to apply these in real-world situations.

- Able to stay neutral and steady under pressure, including with senior stakeholders

- Sound judgment on when to act and when to escalate; you'd rather flag early than guess

- Organized and detail-oriented, with documentation clear enough that someone else could pick it up cold

- Motivated by where this role can lead, with a genuine interest in growing

- Comfortable working within a defined playbook while bringing your own judgment to how it's applied

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer 

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
