Kundenbetreuer (m/w/d) | Berlin 

Du begleitest unsere Kund:innen nach der Vertragsunterschrift bis zur Bauphase als zentrale Ansprechperson. Dabei sorgst du für eine transparente und verlässliche Kundenreise und beeinflusst maßgeblich die Kundenzufriedenheit.

- Erfahrung in Kundenbetreuung, Projektkoordination oder Key Account Management ist von Vorteil.

- Kenntnisse in Photovoltaik, Wärmepumpen, Elektrotechnik oder Großhandel sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

- Eine attraktive Entwicklungsperspektive. Bei entsprechender Performance ist eine Vergütung über dem Marktniveau möglich. Ein hoher variabler Anteil ist an die Durchreifung deiner Kunden geknüpft und liegt damit maßgeblich in deiner Hand.

- Die Chance, Deutschlands erstes grünes Unicorn aktiv mitzugestalten und die solare Energiewende voranzutreiben.

- Führung auf Augenhöhe und eine Team-Struktur, die auch beim Arbeiten Spaß macht

title: Product Engineer / Builder
description:
Why this role exists

Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel.

Tacto is building the intelligence layer between bits and atoms, connecting the digital world of engineering with the physical world of manufacturing. It’s how AI gets into the real economy.

More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto. We’re the category leader in DACH, backed by Sequoia and Index, and we’re just getting started.

What you'll do

Find the problems worth solving, then solve them end to end. Talk to customers, build across the whole stack, and ship to production. Turn what AI can do today into features that procurement and engineering teams use every day. You’re done when it drives revenue, not when it’s merged. Don’t wait for a PRD.

What we mean by Builder

Because of AI, we only hire Builders. No specialized roles.

A Builder takes a messy, unclear problem and owns it from start to finish. That goes for business problems, not just customer problems. You decide what’s worth doing, make the case for it, test the risky parts early, and see it through until it pays off. When something works, you share it so everyone gets better.

We care about outcomes, not code quality for its own sake. What makes this fun is the loop from idea to reality, and AI just made that loop 10x shorter. There’s no room here for “my job is to solve interesting technical problems.”

How we build - The Tacto Engineer

Builder is the what. The Tacto Engineer is the how. It’s our engineering practice and the bar we hold each other to.
Wear the customer’s shoes. Ship fast, finish fully. Sweat the details. Get 1% better every week. No lone wolves. Use AI as leverage, not a crutch.
Read the full version at en.tacto.ai/engineering . If it reads like the way you already work, you’ll fit in here.

Who we're looking for

Hungry, creative, AI pilled engineers at every level of seniority who care more about the result than the craft.

- You have your own ideas and act on them, whether that’s something you started, a side project, or a feature nobody asked for that turned out to matter.

- You’ve shipped real production software in a modern product team. Experience with B2B SaaS or data products is a plus.

- You work in Cursor, Claude, Codex and agents every day, and you’ve built something with them that wouldn’t exist otherwise.

- You go deep in modern Python (FastAPI, async, SQL) or TypeScript/React/Next.js, and you’re happy to work anywhere in the stack.

- You’ve built AI features into a product, or you’re obsessively learning how.

- You want to be in a room full of people who are fired up about what they’re building.

Stack

Python, FastAPI, Postgres, and ClickHouse on the backend. React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, and Storybook on the frontend. GitHub, Linear, and Figma for everything around it. For AI, whatever ships fastest.

How we work

We’re in our Munich office four days a week, with 100+ people building together every day. We measure outcomes, not hours. Trust is high and feedback is direct.
Competitive salary and meaningful equity. 26 + 4 vacation days, Wellpass fitness membership, JobRad bike leasing, company pension plan, and a childcare (Kita) subsidy.

Our Background 

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters 

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI. 

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer 

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

- Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

- Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

- Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

- Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

- Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

- Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer (m/w/d) – Azure & AWS
description:
Senior Cloud Security Engineer (m/w/d) – Azure & AWS

AJAT GmbH · Köln · Vollzeit · Festanstellung · Vor Ort 

!!!!! DEUTSCH MINDESTENS C1 !!! 

Gestalte sichere Cloud-Umgebungen mit uns

Du hast Azure- und AWS-Umgebungen selbst abgesichert, setzt Zero-Trust-Prinzipien praktisch um und arbeitest sicher mit Microsoft Intune und PowerShell? Du möchtest technische Verantwortung übernehmen und dein Wissen in ein Team einbringen?

Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

AJAT ist ein IT-Unternehmen aus Köln mit Schwerpunkten in IT-Services, System Engineering und Cybersecurity. Für unsere Kundenprojekte suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die Sicherheitsanforderungen versteht, technisch umsetzt und Ergebnisse nachvollziehbar dokumentiert.

Deine Aufgaben

- Azure und AWS absichern: Du analysierst bestehende Cloud-Umgebungen, erkennst Sicherheitsrisiken und setzt geeignete Maßnahmen für Identitäten, Berechtigungen, Netzwerke, Workloads und Daten um.

- Identitäten und privilegierte Zugriffe schützen: Du entwickelst nachvollziehbare Berechtigungskonzepte und setzt sie beispielsweise mit Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management sowie AWS IAM und Rollen um.

- Zero Trust praktisch umsetzen: Du verbindest die Prüfung von Identitäten und Gerätezuständen mit minimal erforderlichen Berechtigungen und klar definierten Zugriffsregeln.

- Mit PowerShell automatisieren: Du entwickelst wartbare Skripte für Prüfungen, Konfigurationen und wiederkehrende Aufgaben – mit sicherer Authentifizierung, Fehlerbehandlung und nachvollziehbarer Protokollierung.

- Sicherheitsbefunde bearbeiten: Du bewertest Fehlkonfigurationen und Auffälligkeiten, priorisierst Maßnahmen und überprüfst deren Wirksamkeit.

- Mit Kunden und Team zusammenarbeiten: Du erklärst technische Entscheidungen verständlich, stimmst Änderungen ab und erstellst Dokumentationen, mit denen andere zuverlässig weiterarbeiten können.

- Eine abgeschlossene IT-Berufsausbildung, beispielsweise als Fachinformatiker/in für Systemintegration, sowie mindestens acht Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung .

title: Client Enablement & Coaching Lead (F/H/X)
description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt.

Key Responsibilities: what you'll do 

- Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement: 

- Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme.

- Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

- Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

- Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

- Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations.

Project Management: 

- Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised.

- Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

- Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

Mentorship & Coaching: 

- Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

- Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies.

Analytical & Problem-Solving: 

- Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

- Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

- Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence: 

- Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

- Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration.

- Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

Driving Organisational Change: 

- Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach.

- Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success.

Skills: what you'll have 

- Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

- Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

- Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions.

- Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience.

- Fluent English & French is a prerequisite 

Experience 

- Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level.

- Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively.

- Change management using agile methodologies.

- Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. 

Other Requirements: 

- Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs.

- Ability to work across multiple clients and markets, quickly adapting to varying client needs and environments/languages.

- Highly driven to ‘make things happen’. Growth mindset demonstrated through all your work. Ability to speak persuasively and inspire energy, motivating both internal teams and external stakeholders including Direct Reports.

- Comfortable navigating between operations and technical conversations, bridging gaps between business needs and technical solutions.

- Expertise in driving programme ownership, from inception through to sustainable execution, ensuring clients are equipped to lead post-migration.

title: Sales & Partner Manager for Spain & Portugal - Gastronomy (m/w/d)
description:
Every day, owners, waitstaff and chefs pour their hearts into crafting dining experiences. Yet they are expected to keep up in an always-on world with relentless technological change.

We build solutions for them to keep up – and yes, with AI. But not for the sake of it.

What you sell 

Assistent.ai is the AI Suite for Guest Communication, purpose-built for hospitality teams. It answers and converts calls to reservations, orders or tasks – on live data, connected knowledge, and on brand.

We are looking for a Sales & Partner Manager for Spain and Portugal.

- Location: Remote in Germany, with regular travel to Spain and Portugal

- Start: As soon as possible

- Employment: Full-time, or part-time from 50% with a path to full-time

How we sell 

We actively listen, understand and work out solutions. We do not push where there is no problem to solve. We build long term, trustworthy relationships. We value lifetime value over shortsighted gains.

Hit apply if you're humble to learn, ambitious to win, and have a weakness for Iberian food and culture.

Tasks

Open Spain and Portugal. Win restaurants. Build partners. 

You're our first person for Spain and Portugal. No team to hide behind, no playbook to follow. You write it.

You win restaurants: on the phone, on video calls and in person.

You win partners: reservation systems that make real-time automation possible, and distributors who already reach the restaurants we want.

You get restaurants on board, make sure they're up and running, and help them grow with Assistent.ai.

You are our customers' voice inside the company.

It's that simple. And that hard.

Requirements

- You have agency: you see what's missing and get things done.

- You win trust before you win deals.

- Comfort navigating ambiguity and untangling legacy logic to build modern foundations.

- Drive consistency: Establish semantic layer definitions for your domain so analysts and PMs can self-serve accurate metrics without custom workarounds.

Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. The Senior Technical Advisor, Data Use and Decision Science, focuses on bridging the gap between complex epidemiological and contextual data and strategic public health action. The Senior Technical Advisor, Data Use and Decision Science, collaborates with HQ-based staff and in-country embedded teams on data analytics innovations and delivery. Responsibilities include: 

Data Use for Decision Science 

- Support the implementation of epidemic intelligence activities that inform decision-making, including developing innovative data use products (e.g., enhanced outbreak situation report, periodic epidemiological bulletins, executive dashboards) and implementation of automated production pipelines. 

- Collaborate closely with in-country counterparts and across teams to map existing systems, data, and decision-making needs, in order to identify implementation priorities for Collaborative Surveillance and support the development of a future surveillance architecture.

- Provide technical oversight and methodologies to evaluate the impact of the Collaborative Surveillance initiatives. 

Strategic Innovation 

- Lead consultative work to investigate and develop use cases for surveillance innovations, including wastewater surveillance, multiplex sero-surveillance, genomic surveillance, and sample registration systems. 

- Collaborate with a multidisciplinary epidemic intelligence team to pioneer innovations in data use for decision-making, including the application of artificial intelligence, novel contextual data, and advanced analytical methods to forecast risks and outbreaks. 

- Synthesize multi-country operational learnings and technical innovations into strategic dissemination products for the global public health community. 

Qualifcations

- Master’s degree or higher in a relevant field (e.g., public health, epidemiology, informatics, statistics). A PhD in a relevant field is a plus. 

Experience : 

- At least 10 years of experience in infectious disease surveillance and analytics, public health emergency management, or equivalent experience 

- Demonstrated experience designing, producing, and implementing end-to-end public health information products (e.g., epidemiological bulletins, outbreak situation reports) with the ability to translate complex data into decision-ready outputs and ensure sustainable handover through clear documentation and SOPs 

- Demonstrated experience in designing and delivering comprehensive capacity-building training programs for public health professionals, bridging technical skills with actionable, real-world decision-making. 

Skills & abilities:

Rubrik’s Sales organisation is a united group of elite cross-functional sales professionals that help companies & government entities achieve resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. We offer continuous professional growth and opportunity through our world-class sales enablement program. Our One Rubrik selling approach provides all the resources you need to exceed your goals, maximize your earnings potential, and take your career to the next level. All this while doing something truly purposeful, protecting the world's data.

Large Enterprise Account Executive 

As a Large Enterprise Account Executive, you will have ownership of all elements of bookings growth in new and existing accounts across the UK region. We are seeking a relentless self-starter who is hyper-focused on acquiring new logos by discovering and developing new opportunities, managing pipeline, and executing account strategies, while also encouraging existing customer expansion. The AE must drive pipeline generation daily while working with Sales Engineers, Sales Development, Channel Development, and Rubrik Channel Partners to exceed sales quotas. 

What You'll Do: 

- Define and execute sales plans for the assigned territory to meet and exceed quota through prospecting, qualifying, managing, and closing sales opportunities.

- Develop and manage sales pipeline to move a large number of strategic transactions through the sales process.

- Identify and close new opportunities for growth working with a mix of Enterprise/Strat accounts.

- Present Rubrik, Inc. solutions within complex data centre design environments.

- Co-sell and strategise with partners, distributors, and VAR’s to enable rapid growth

- Provide Rubrik, Inc. management with feedback about the local market opportunity and identification of new business opportunities and channel partnerships.

Experience You’ll Need: 

- 5+ years Tech sales experience (selling either IT Infrastructure, Security or SaaS)

- Consistent track record landing net "new logos"

- Strong track record of performance with consistent overachievement of quotas.

- Understanding and experience working with channel

- Highly driven, goal oriented "get it done" attitude.

- Experience selling a complex solution.

Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation

Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes. 

Linkedin | X (formerly Twitter) | Instagram | Rubrik.com

At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.

Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.

Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:

- 
Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.

- 
Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.

title: Commercial Specialist
description:
Powering Great Work 

We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists:

🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business

🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time

🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country

As our next Account Executive, you'll help bring more trades onto Checkatrade across different regions and categories. It's a new business role: you find high-potential trade businesses and guide them from the first conversation to a signed deal. You'll sit in our Strategic Growth team, at the heart of how we grow the trade network that homeowners rely on.

The job, unfiltered: 

- Win new trade businesses by finding high-potential small and medium trades, building proposals that make sense for them and negotiating terms.

- Hand each new trade over smoothly to our vetting team, so the start of their Checkatrade journey goes well.

- Spot opportunities in the market, using data and insights to see where Checkatrade is strong and where we can grow.

- Work with Account Management, Vetting, Product and Operations to find the regions and categories that would benefit most from Checkatrade.

- Learn our product suite inside out, so every business case is tailored to the prospect in front of you.

- Own the outbound sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through to proposals, negotiation and closing.

The fit: 

- Solid experience in commercial or new business sales, ideally in similar markets, with a strong focus on outbound acquisition.

- A track record of finding new clients, building tailored proposals and hitting revenue targets.

- The knack for building strong relationships with tradespeople, and working closely with colleagues across teams.

- Confidence juggling multiple priorities and improving how things get done.

- Experience building customer relationships, whether through digital outreach or face-to-face conversations.

- Tenacity and resilience. This is a test-and-learn environment where persistence matters.

Nice to have: familiarity with CRM systems (Salesforce) and outbound tools, and an understanding of AI-powered optimisation tools.

(Don't self-select out because you don't tick every box. We'd rather meet you.) 

What you get 

💰 Competitive salary, annual bonus & equity scheme

🩺 Health, wellbeing and learning support

🚲 Gym membership, Smart Tech Scheme, Cycle Scheme

🎂 Birthday/special day leave, buy & sell holiday scheme

❤️ 1 week's paid charity leave, and more

How this goes 

- Screening call with one of our Talent Acquisition Partners

- 1st stage interview with our Head of Sales SMB

- 2nd stage interview with our Head of Sales SMB and Sales Operations Manager

- 3rd stage interview with our VP of Sales

Not this one? Stay close anyway. Join the Talent Community and we'll ping you the second something better fits.

About us

We’re Checkatrade – the UK’s leading platform for finding a tradesperson. With more than 50,000 trades listed and over 6 million reviews, we help homeowners get jobs done right and help tradespeople grow their business.

We’re growing fast, with big plans to become the go-to brand for home improvements. If you care about great work, take pride in the details, and want to make an impact, you’ll fit right in.

title: Talent Lead
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The Opportunity 

The Talent Lead – Operations & Business at Relay will play a critical role in shaping and driving hiring strategies for our non-tech organisation. You’ll quickly establish yourself as the go-to TA partner for hiring managers in the org: consulting on best practices, sharing insights and reports, and continuously improving our talent acquisition function. You’ll help us make the right hiring decisions, bringing in top talent who are also a strong Relay fit.

Who Will Thrive in this role? 

- You own end-to-end hiring: you can run the full lifecycle from sourcing and outreach through to offer, while keeping quality and pace high.

- You’re a trusted partner to senior stakeholders: you build strong relationships with Business and Ops Leadership and People, align on priorities, and help translate plans into hiring action.

- You’re operationally excellent: you create sharp JDs and scorecards, keep pipelines clean in Ashby, coordinate smoothly across hiring managers/agencies, and produce high-quality candidate packs/interview kits.

- You leverage systems and tools to scale impact: you use the ATS expertly and you’re curious and proactive about new tooling (sourcing tools, automation, AI) that improves productivity and quality of hire.

- You use data to drive decisions: you track and act on key TA metrics (sourcing activity, time-to-fill, time-in-stage, offer acceptance, candidate/HM satisfaction) and keep stakeholders clearly informed.

- You improve the machine, not just run it: you spot bottlenecks, propose fixes, and implement changes that improve speed, quality, and candidate experience.

Must-Haves 

- Proven track record as a Senior Recruiter or Talent Acquisition Lead..

- Background in hypergrowth startups or scale-ups.

- Structured, clear communicator with strong stakeholder management.

- Data-driven mindset, using metrics to prioritise, iterate and improve outcomes.

Compensation & Benefits & Workplace 

- Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups , with annual top-ups to share Relay’s success.

- Private health & dental coverage , so comprehensive you’d need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it.

- 25 days of holidays 

- Enhanced parental leave .

- Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.

- Hardware of your choice .

- Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more).

Fast and Focused Hiring Process 

- Talent Acquisition Interview - 45 min 

- Hiring Manager Interview - 60 min 

- Case Study - 75 min 

- Decision and offer within 48 hours ; our process mirrors our pace of work.

Who Thrives at Relay? 

- Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

- Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

- 1% Better Every Day : You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

- All In, All the Time : You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

- People-Powered Greatness : You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

- Grow the Whole Pie : You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Operations Manager - West Midlands Sort Centre
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The Opportunity 

You will report to the Site Manager/Head of Site and will run shifts at one of our Hybrid Sort Centres (HSCs), leading 50–100+ operatives through high-volume, time-pressured sortation where minutes matter and small deviations cascade into missed deadlines. Each of our HSCs handle over 40 million parcels annually, with our largest site measuring more than 300,000 sq ft.

You will also be accountable for whether the site is measurably better in a month than it is today for each of our key metrics. You are on the floor for your shift, every shift. This is not a project role with occasional site visits and it is not a desk job, the forward work happens along with running the operation.

Who will thrive in this role 

- Deliver shift plan end to end people deployment, throughput, quality standards, and health & safety compliance

- Lead, develop, and performance-manage a frontline team of 50–100+ operatives

- Build the mechanisms that hold the operation together. Build controls, cadences, metrics, SOPs, change management and own their adoption, not only their design

- Plan ahead for future shifts; labour, training, and the risks you can see coming before they land

- Own the end-of-shift handover; what happened, what is at risk, what the next shift needs to know

- Stay decisive through volume peaks, outages, and labour gaps. Triage, solve the problem at hand quickly, contain the impact, restore flow

- Present and write clearly whether briefs, escalations, handovers or post-incident reviews. Decisions here get made based off what you wrote

- Implement changes into a live operation such as introducing robotics, launching new sortation tech or onboarding new clients. We are changing the operations constantly which means you’ll roll change out mid flight and bring your team along the journey.

Who you are 

- Scaled something from zero : a site, a market, a process or a program.

- Managed a physical operation : quick commerce, grocery, e-commerce fulfillment, last mile, 3PL, food production, airport ground handling, rail. Anywhere with a hard cut off and people on the floor.

- Communicate in both directions and have strong people management skills : you can brief 80 operatives at shift start and take a problem to senior leadership the same day.

- Built a mechanism that held : a control, a cadence, a metric, a document standard. Something you authored that changed how frontline teams worked.

- Own numbers rather than report them : you can name a metric you created or redefined, explain why the previous one was wrong, and say what changed afterwards.

- Understand frontline work : one of these must be true: you have personally led frontline teams; you have worked embedded in and around a frontline population day to day, without the reporting line; or you have been accountable for outcomes delivered by frontline people you did not employ.

You do not need to have worked in parcels, fulfilment, or sortation. Several of our most talented people had not.

Backgrounds that translate well 

- Program Manager in a logistics or e-commerce business

- Operations Excellence and Continuous Improvement

- Strategy & Operations

- Transformation manager

- Launch and Expansion Manager

- Regional operations manager

We have hired well from corporate operations, from central operations inside large UK retailers and carriers, and from quick commerce and marketplace operators. Consulting backgrounds work where you implemented, not only recommended; we are keen to understand what you who actually rolled it out.

Hiring process 

Our hiring process is fast.

- Initial screen (15 min)

- Hiring Manager conversation (90 min) - 45 min onsite interview immediately followed by a 45 min site tour where you shadow an existing shift manager

- Final interview (45 min). Decision and offer within 48 hours

Who Thrives at Relay? 

- Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

- Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

- 1% Better Every Day : You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

- All In, All the Time : You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

- People-Powered Greatness : You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

- Grow the Whole Pie : You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm 

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Opportunity

Deepgram is expanding into EMEA, and we're seeking a GM, Sales to own the region — building and leading the Enterprise and commercial segments of our Account Executive team, establishing Deepgram's European home in London, and driving growth across the region.

This role is both strategic and hands-on. You'll work with sales leadership to continue optimizing the systems, playbooks, and culture that scale ARR growth, while developing a high-performing team that converts opportunities into long-lasting customers. A core part of your mission is building Deepgram's next generation of sales talent through world-class training, coaching, and structured career development.

You'll also be more than a revenue leader. As our senior-most voice in EMEA, you'll bring what you learn in the field back into the company and shape what we build — regional product-market fit, roadmap priorities, and the technical requirements European enterprises hold us to.

You'll partner closely with Marketing, Sales Leadership, RevOps, Customer Success, and Product to align pipeline strategy and leverage modern AI tools to boost productivity, personalization, and team efficiency. Equal parts operator, coach, and builder, you'll combine data-driven rigor with creativity to shape how Deepgram grows its customer base and its sales talent.

What You'll Do

- Scale the Region: Own the EMEA number. Build and execute a strategic roadmap to drive hyper-growth in ARR, from initial land to enterprise-wide expansion.

- Open London: Stand up Deepgram's London office as our EMEA hub — and treat it as a commercial asset, not just real estate. It will host customer and developer events, executive briefings, partner sessions, and the team you build.

- "Challenge & Lead": Recruit and mentor a high-performance team of Account Executives. Manage Customer Success, Marketing, and Forward Deployed Engineers in a dotted-line structure. You will instill a culture of "Challenger" selling — teaching AEs how to disrupt legacy incumbents and lead with technical ROI.

- Shape the Product: Act as the voice of EMEA inside Deepgram. Translate field signal — deal losses, evaluation criteria, data residency and compliance requirements, language and accent coverage — into specific, prioritized input that changes what we build and when.

- Build the Ecosystem: Identify and sign strategic regional partners, GSIs, and local resellers to act as a force multiplier for Deepgram's direct sales efforts.

- Operational Excellence: Implement rigorous forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and territory management across multiple countries, languages, and buying cultures. You will bridge the gap between London and our US HQ.

- C-Suite Influence: Act as the primary executive sponsor for major regional accounts, navigating complex procurement cycles and technical AI evaluations.

You'll Love This Role If You

- Thrive on building and scaling high-performing teams that consistently beat targets.

- Want to build something from the ground up — including the office, the team, and the regional playbook.

- Value working with tenured, high-caliber leaders who prioritize clarity, accountability, collaboration, and execution.

- Enjoy blending data-driven sales operations with creative, human-centered leadership.

- Are energized by developing AEs and building a culture of growth and continuous learning.

- Believe in the power of AI to transform productivity, and are eager to harness cutting-edge tools to optimize performance.

- Are passionate about Deepgram's mission to redefine what's possible with speech technology.

It's Important to Us That You Have

- Experience: 12+ years in B2B SaaS sales, with 5+ years in a senior leadership role (Director/VP) covering EMEA — including the UK and at least one of DACH, the Nordics, France, or Southern Europe.

- The "Deepgram DNA": A deep fascination with AI, LLMs, and API-first products. You should be comfortable discussing technical architecture as easily as you discuss revenue targets.

- Product Influence: You've done more than sell — you've changed what your company built. You can point to specific roadmap decisions, features, or product bets that happened because of how you brought the market back to Product and Engineering.

- Proven Growth: A track record of scaling a regional business from early traction to high-scale maturity ($10M+ ARR growth experience preferred).

- Partnership Prowess: Demonstrable experience building channel programs that significantly contribute to the total revenue mix.

- High ASP Focus: Expertise in value-based selling to increase Average Selling Price and win rates in a competitive technical landscape.

- Operational Rigor: Deep familiarity with modern sales stacks (Salesforce, Gong, Clari, etc.) and a commitment to data-driven decision-making.

- Education: Bachelor's degree required; MBA or technical degree is a plus.

title: Sr Software Engineer, Ads Auctions & Marketplace Optimization
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV 

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What does the team work on? 

Roku is the No. 1 TV streaming platform in the US, Canada and Mexico, with more than 100 million active accounts. Every ad impression across that platform has to be cleared and priced in real time — that is what the Ads Auctions and Marketplace Optimization team does. We build the auction mechanics, the pricing and pacing logic, and the low-latency systems that run them, balancing outcomes for advertisers, publishers, viewers, and Roku on every request. We are growing the team in Cambridge, which is becoming its largest hub, alongside colleagues in Amsterdam, Austin, San Jose, Ukraine and Uruguay — so you would be shaping how the UK side of this team works rather than inheriting it.

What is the role? 

You will build the systems that apply mathematical and algorithmic rigour to optimise across multiple objectives, deciding which ads get served, in which placements, and when. The work spans auction mechanics, optimisation, the output of predictive ML models, and the real-time infrastructure underneath, mostly in Java on the JVM. It is hands-on and senior in scope: expect to move between whiteboard-level design and production code in the same week, and to own problems from framing through rollout. You will work directly with the hiring manager and a small group of senior engineers, in codebases shared with other ads engineers, on problems where your decisions are visible in revenue. You will optimise for second-order effects in a marketplace where participants react to each other, and to us, in real time. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic about solving these kinds of problems.

How will I use AI at Roku? 

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.

We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.

What are the responsibilities of the role? 

- Design and build components of Roku's real-time ad auction and marketplace systems

- Own the multi-objective optimisation at the core of the auction, balancing what advertisers, publishers, viewers, and Roku each want from the same impression

- Own development work end to end, from framing the problem through production rollout

- Build and operate JVM services where latency and reliability are product requirements, not stretch goals

- Use probability, statistics and experimentation to test changes before and after launch

- Work with AI tooling as a normal part of how you design, build, test and review

- Explain technical trade-offs clearly to engineering and cross-functional partners

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku? 

- Around six or more years building production software, with strong systems judgement

- Production experience in Java or another JVM language, or depth in a comparable statically typed language such as C#, C++ or Go, and the appetite to ramp on Java

- Comfort designing and operating distributed systems at scale and low latency

- A solid grounding in maths, algorithms, probability and statistics as applied to real systems

- Demonstrated AI and agentic-tooling fluency, as described above

- Ad tech, auctions or marketplace experience is preferred, and we move quickly for candidates who have it

- Comparable experience on mathematically rigorous or optimisation-heavy problems in another domain is an acceptable alternative

description:
LOCATION: CALMSDEN, CIRENCESTER, UK. LIMITED FIELD TRAVEL AS REQUIRED | 5 DAYS ONSITE

THE LAST FRONTIER 

ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist.

Our solution is autonomy.

We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.

Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk.

THE ROLE 

ARD is growing and we’re looking for an Assembly and Test Technician to help us build and test our ruggedized hardware - from field-ready energy and battery systems to the autonomous platforms we deploy in the Arctic. Right now, our biggest constraint isn’t design. It’s the time it takes to assemble and test what we’ve designed.

Reporting to our Senior Test Engineer , you’ll join our engineering team, working alongside our mechanical and electrical engineers and across our main hardware workstreams. You’ll take hands-on ownership of assembly and testing, helping with the practical implementation and testing of engineering designs. Within your first 3 months, you’ll have helped to take assembly and test off the critical path on our key projects, and helped put in place the documentation and test processes that let us build and test consistently, unit after unit.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES 

- Assemble mechanical and electrical sub-assemblies, harnesses, PCBAs, and complete units to drawings and build instructions, so they’re ready for test on schedule.

- Run test phases on assemblies and finished units and record the results accurately, so issues are found and fixed before hardware reaches the field.

title: Corporate Account Executive - Public Sector
description:

As Corporate Account Executive, Public Sector, you will own new-logo acquisition across a defined vertical and account set in the UK, Ireland and South Africa. title: Data Analyst (Strategic Projects)
description:

4. Work With Senior Leadership

- Own analytics for high-impact projects end-to-end.

What We’re Looking For 

Must-Have Skills 

- 2-3 years of hands-on experience using Python in a professional setting.

- Highly numerate with strong analytical reasoning 

- Ability to independently structure analysis, build prototypes, and deliver insights.

- Experience communicating data-driven recommendations to non-technical business stakeholders .

Nice-to-Haves 

- STEM Degree

- Experience with dbt or modern data stacks.

- Familiarity with LLMs, APIs, or interest in building AI automation.

- Exposure to product, strategy, or operations environments.

- Thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

- Comfortable wearing multiple hats Analyst , Data Scientist , AI Engineer , PM .

- Highly motivated, entrepreneurial mindset, and excited by building the strongest operating model in fintech.

Why Join 

- Work on high-visibility, high-impact projects that directly shape the future of Lendable’s operations.

- Build automation and analytics used daily by hundreds of agents and thousands of customers.

- Collaborate with a small, sharp, and ambitious team that moves fast.

- Real ownership: if you build it, you’ll see it shipped and scaled.

Interview process

Screening Call + Python Questions

Live Technical Python Interview

Final interviews with 2 senior leaders 

Life at Lendable

- Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

- Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

Number one on the FT1000, number one on the Sifted 100. From £1m to over £100m in under three years, with a small, talent-dense team and an electric culture with day one founder intensity. Now we're aiming for £1bn in the next three.

The next chapter is harder and more interesting.

We are moving from one market to many, from e-commerce to a technology platform, and from curating wellbeing to defining it. We are a health company, so we think we should act like one.

At its fullest expression, Healf redefines what wellbeing means for tens of millions of people.

We're looking for a generalist Talent Partner to bring firepower to an AI-first talent team indexing heavily on talent density, candidate experience and hiring velocity.

Where you'll make an impact

title: Lead Data Scientist
description:
Why Faculty? 

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here .

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the Team 

Bringing medicine to patients is complex, expensive and high-risk. Faculty’s Life Science’s team is concentrated on building AI solutions which optimise the research and commercialisation of life-changing therapies.

We partner with major pharma firms, academic research centres and regulators to design and deliver solutions which address critical healthcare challenges, and help to democratise health for all.

About the role 

As a Lead Data Scientist, you'll take on a pivotal, entrepreneurial role, functioning as the technical expert who thrives on complexity and commercial impact. You will be responsible for setting the technical direction and ensuring the high-quality, scalable delivery of our most challenging, high-impact projects.

This position combines deep expertise in machine learning with strategic oversight to define project roadmaps, manage technical risk, and architect reliable solutions. Your focus will be on driving innovation, mentoring cross-functional teams, and actively shaping both our technical standards and long-term customer relationships.

What you'll be doing: 

- Setting the technical direction for complex, business-critical projects and expertly balancing trade-offs between speed, innovation, and reliability.

- Designing and implementing reliable, production-grade technical solutions, ensuring comprehensive documentation of architectures and specifications.

- Defining project problems, developing clear roadmaps, and overseeing end-to-end delivery across multi-disciplinary workstreams.

- Leading technical scoping and feasibility studies for high-value sales opportunities and strategic customer engagements.

- Managing relationships and communications with technical stakeholders, fostering trust and aligning technical solutions with shared long-term commercial goals.

- Driving the adoption of best practices, shared resources, and robust technical processes across the wider Data Science craft.

- Mentoring and developing other data scientists and team members, actively contributing to the growth and technical excellence of the organisation.

Who we're looking for: 

- You have proven project management expertise, capable of dividing complex, ill-defined problems into actionable, clearly defined workstreams with timelines you can defend.

- You possess strong customer leadership skills, able to act as a trusted technical advisor and drive long-term strategic relationships with demanding clients.

- You bring depth of expertise in at least one machine learning domain and strong technical breadth across the entire data science landscape.

- You are a skilled technical leader, proficient in mentoring individuals, managing teams (including other managers), and rolling out impactful tools and workflows.

- You are adept at managing ill-defined, high-risk tasks, consistently delivering innovative and practical outcomes under commercial pressure.

- You excel at cross-functional collaboration, effectively aligning technical strategy with Engineering, Commercial, and Infrastructure teams.

- You have experience extending technical oversight to business unit-level initiatives, using your vision to influence and contribute to organisational success.

The Interview Process 

- Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

- Introduction to the team (30 minutes)

- Take Home Technical Assessment

- Technical Interview (90 minutes)

- Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos 

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. 

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

description:

📅 Début : ASAP
⏳ Durée : 6 mois
💰 Gratification de stage : conformément au minimum conventionnel en vigueur.

Lengow, expert des solutions e-commerce intelligentes 

Lengow est un acteur de référence des solutions e-commerce intelligentes, qui accompagne les marques et les distributeurs dans leur croissance rentable sur les canaux digitaux.

Grâce à ses solutions performantes de gestion de flux produits, de veille tarifaire internationale et d'analyse de données, Lengow propose une suite complète d'outils SaaS permettant aux e-commerçants d'améliorer la visibilité de leurs produits en ligne, de renforcer leur compétitivité grâce à des stratégies de prix éclairées, de développer leurs ventes sur les marketplaces et de suivre la présence de leur marque auprès des distributeurs.

Depuis 2009, Lengow accompagne la croissance digitale de plus de 3 600 clients, sur des milliers de canaux marketing et de vente, dans plus de 60 pays.

Votre rôle au sein de la Legal Team 

Dans le cadre de nos activités, nous recherchons un.e stagiaire Juriste en Droit du Numérique & Protection des Données Personnelles pour rejoindre notre Legal Team.

Directement rattaché.e à la Head of Legal, vous participerez activement aux projets juridiques de l'entreprise, avec une attention particulière portée à la conformité RGPD, aux évolutions réglementaires du secteur numérique et aux enjeux liés à l'intelligence artificielle.

Vous aurez également l'opportunité de collaborer avec différentes équipes internes (Product, Tech, Sales, Marketing, HR, etc.) et de développer une approche pratique et opérationnelle du droit.

Vos missions 

1. Protection des données personnelles & conformité RGPD

- Participer au suivi et à l'amélioration de la conformité de Lengow en matière de protection des données personnelles.
- Contribuer à la mise à jour du registre des activités de traitement des données personnelles, en collaboration avec les différentes équipes internes.
- Participer à la revue et à la mise à jour de la documentation relative à la protection des données (politiques de confidentialité, DPA, procédures internes, etc.).
- Accompagner la Legal Team dans l'analyse de questions relatives au RGPD et à la protection des données dans le cadre des projets de l'entreprise.
- Contribuer à la sensibilisation des équipes internes aux enjeux de protection des données, notamment à travers la préparation et l'animation de courtes formations sur les notions fondamentales du RGPD et les bonnes pratiques à adopter au quotidien.
2. Droit du numérique & Intelligence Artificielle

- Participer à l'analyse des enjeux juridiques liés aux nouvelles technologies, aux solutions SaaS et à l'intelligence artificielle.
- Contribuer au suivi des évolutions réglementaires européennes, notamment du Règlement européen sur l'intelligence artificielle (AI Act), et à l'évaluation de leurs impacts potentiels sur les activités de Lengow.
- Participer aux réflexions et projets internes relatifs à l'utilisation de l'intelligence artificielle et à la mise en place de bonnes pratiques.
3. Contrats commerciaux & accompagnement des équipes

- Participer à la rédaction et à la revue de contrats commerciaux en français et en anglais (contrats SaaS, accords de confidentialité, contrats fournisseurs, accords de partenariat, etc.).
- Contribuer à l'analyse des clauses contractuelles, notamment celles relatives à la protection des données, à la confidentialité et à la responsabilité.
- Accompagner la Head of Legal dans le traitement des demandes juridiques des équipes opérationnelles.
- Participer à la mise à jour des modèles contractuels et des documents juridiques internes.
4. Veille juridique & projets transverses

- Assurer une veille juridique et réglementaire sur les évolutions en matière de protection des données personnelles, de droit du numérique et d'intelligence artificielle.
- Réaliser des recherches juridiques et rédiger des synthèses claires et accessibles pour les équipes internes.
- Contribuer à des projets transverses visant à améliorer les processus, les outils et la documentation juridique de Lengow.
Requirements 

Le profil que nous recherchons

- Vous préparez un Master 2 en droit du numérique ou, droit des nouvelles technologies, droit des données personnelles ou droit des affaires, avec un intérêt marqué pour les enjeux numériques ou vous êtes en école d'avocats.
- Vous disposez de bonnes connaissances du RGPD et des principes fondamentaux de la protection des données personnelles.
- Vous portez un intérêt particulier aux évolutions réglementaires liées à l'intelligence artificielle, notamment à l'AI Act.
- Vous possédez de bonnes bases en droit des contrats.
- Vous avez un bon niveau d'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
- Vous êtes rigoureux.se, curieux.se, autonome et proactif.ve, avec de bonnes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse.Vous faites preuve de pédagogie pour rendre les sujets juridiques accessibles à des interlocuteurs non juristes et appréciez le travail en équipe.
Notre processus de recrutement

- Un premier échange téléphonique avec notre Head of Legal pour faire connaissance et échanger sur votre parcours et vos motivations.
- Un entretien pour approfondir les échanges, vous présenter les missions et mieux comprendre vos attentes.
- Bienvenue chez Lengow ! Si nos attentes sont alignées, nous passons à la signature de votre convention de stage.

Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

- Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.

3. Iterate for Impact 

- Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.

- Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.

- Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.

- Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.

- Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.

- Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement 

- Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.

- Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.

- Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.

- Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

title: Mobile Engineer - React Native
description:
🧡 About Alma 

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers. Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt. As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers. With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

👐 About the team 

The Consumer Tribe builds the Alma app for consumers. To tackle more topics and accelerate the development of the consumer experience, the current Consumer squad is splitting into two dedicated squads: Alma Wallet and Consumer Engagement.

Alma Wallet builds the payment experience of the app. With the Alma card, consumers can pay with Alma anywhere, not only at our partner merchants. In the app, they can manage their payments using Apple Pay, Google Pay or local payment methods. By taking Alma beyond our merchant network, the Alma card is one of the company's key strategic bets.

Consumer Engagement drives consumer activation, engagement and long-term retention by helping people get more value from Alma. The team builds experiences that make it easier for consumers to discover partner merchants, benefit from loyalty and cashback rewards, and manage their account independently.

In 2027, the focus is on turning Alma into a more engaging, everyday consumer experience by strengthening loyalty, increasing repeat usage and making Consumer Engagement a key driver of Alma's long-term growth.

This is a new position created as the consumer app organization splits into two squads to tackle more topics. You will join one of these squads and work closely with its Engineering Manager, Product Manager, Designer and back-end engineers. You will report to Gautier Labarre , Engineering Manager .

This position is a permanent contract (CDI), open to full remote from Metropolitan France. 

💼 About the job 

- Build and ship meaningful consumer experiences: Develop and release new features in the Alma app from design to production, working closely with Product, Design and back-end engineers.

- Make payments simple and secure: Integrate payment SDKs and native mobile capabilities such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, card management, biometrics and secure storage.

- Raise the quality bar of the app: Keep the application fast, reliable and maintainable through automated testing, monitoring, code reviews and continuous performance improvements.

- Help the team learn and move forward: Contribute to technical decisions, challenge product and back-end implementation when needed, and improve the team’s architecture, tooling and release processes.

🧰 You will work with 

- Mobile: Expo / EAS, Expo Router, React Native, React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Redux Toolkit, react-hook-form, Zod, Reanimated, Unistyles, MMKV, Nitro modules.

- Tests: Jest, Testing Library, Maestro. Payments: Adyen, Stripe, Checkout.com SDKs.

- Observability: Datadog, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, OpenFeature.

- Back-end: Python, FastAPI. Tools: GitHub, Linear, Notion, Figma, Crowdin, Claude.

🧩 About you 

To succeed in this job 

- You have 3+ years of experience building mobile applications with React Native and TypeScript , with experience releasing apps on both the App Store and Google Play.

- You have a strong understanding of the React Native ecosystem, including Expo, navigation, state management and data fetching.

- You care deeply about software quality and have experience with testing, code reviews, monitoring and mobile performance.

- You are fluent in English and comfortable working in a cross-functional, international environment.

And it will be nice if you also 

- Have worked on payment products, fintech products or other security-sensitive applications.

- Have experience contributing to a consumer application used at scale.

- Are comfortable challenging product or back-end implementation when it does not provide the best user or technical outcome.

- Have experience with web development in addition to mobile development.

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience. 

🧘 What's in it for you 

If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on:

- Work on products at the heart of Alma's strategy, including the Alma card, new payment methods in the app and our loyalty programme.

- Solve real mobile fintech challenges involving payment SDKs, Apple Pay, Google Pay, biometrics and secure storage.

- Use a modern mobile stack based on Expo 57, React Native’s New Architecture, React 19, TypeScript 7, Reanimated 4 and Nitro modules.

🤑 Compensation & benefits 

- Competitive salary based on 12 months

- Profit-sharing and employee savings plan

- Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma including family package

- Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma

- Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and Classpass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities

- Maternity/paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.

- Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD): €544.80/year (excluding full-remote contracts)

- Meal vouchers: €10/day, 50% covered by Alma

- Mental health: free access to MindDay platform

- Paid time off: 25 days/year (+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)

- Access to our Learning & Development Platform

- 2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer

🎯 Interview Process 

- Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member to understand your path, motivation and present you the role.

- Video call with your future manager to deep dive into the role, the team, your profile and answer all your questions.

- Live testing session with members of the Mobile Engineering team to assess your practical knowledge and approach to mobile development.

- Coffee Chat with members of the squad you would join , with the panel adapted to Alma Wallet or Consumer Engagement.

🌍 Diversity & Inclusion 

At Alma, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and makes our community stronger. We are committed to building a workplace where every person feels seen, respected, and empowered to do their best work whatever their gender, background, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability or lived experience. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all walks of life, and all employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.
