- Research Strategic Accounts: Identify high-value targets by researching key organizations, industries, and executive stakeholders.

- Initiate High-Impact Outreach: Open doors with senior decision-makers using personalized outreach across email, phone, and LinkedIn.

- Build Qualified Pipeline: Drive consistent growth momentum through disciplined prospecting, rigorous follow-up, and account mapping.

- Run Consultative Discovery: Uncover merchants' technical and business challenges to align Checkout.com ’s solutions with their goals.

- Partner on Live Deals: Work alongside Sales Representatives to support opportunities through to deal execution.

- Leverage AI & Modern Tech: Use CRM, intent data, and approved AI tools to streamline research, refine outreach, and work smarter.

Who We’re Looking For 

We welcome applications from recent graduates and professionals with 1–3 years of experience looking to change careers. Regardless of your background, we are looking for the following core skills to set you up for success:

- Driven & Goal-Oriented: You set high personal standards, work hard, and stay motivated when tackling challenging commercial goals.

- Resilient & Adaptable: You bounce back quickly from rejection, view obstacles as practice, and maintain consistent output.

- Relational & Engaging: You genuinely enjoy starting conversations, asking sharp questions, and building trust with diverse stakeholders.

- Track Record of Achievement: You demonstrate drive and ownership through professional, academic, athletic, or entrepreneurial success.

- Commercial & Tech Curiosity: You are eager to learn complex fintech products and use AI and sales tools to work smarter.

- Coachability & Clear Communication: You listen well, articulate ideas clearly, and actively apply feedback to improve performance.

What You’ll Get Out of It 

A 2-year structured programme that ensures you have a successful career in sales. A clear progression pathway built around key pillars:

- Fintech & Enterprise Sales Mastery: Build deep expertise in global payments, digital commerce, and complex deal execution alongside experienced Account Executives.

- AI-Native Commercial Skills: Master modern sales tools, intent data, and AI to automate routine tasks and focus on high-impact prospecting.

- Coaching & Leadership Growth: Receive 1:1 mentorship from sales leaders, earn certifications, and take on senior BDR responsibilities, from mentoring peers to working on live deals through pricing and signing

- Direct Career Acceleration: Graduate with a tight-knit global network and a direct pathway into Account Executive, Account Management, or Commercial Strategy roles.

Want to Stand Out? 

When we review your CV, ensure you show us why you're great for this role. Ensure and share something you’ve built, led or achieved, whether that’s hitting a target, launching a side project, or leading a team effort.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) 

- Who should apply? Recent graduates, early-career professionals (1–3 years experience), and career changers with strong commercial drive.

- When does the programme start? We have start dates in March and September 2027.

- What is the application deadline? Apply early for the best chance of being reviewed. We will close once we receive a sufficient number of applications.

- Where are the roles located? We have roles in London, New York, Barcelona, Amsterdam, Riyadh, Dubai, and Shanghai.

- Do I need a second language? Fluent English is required. Specific local language proficiency may be required depending on the hiring region.

Additional Information 

Bring all of you to work 

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com 

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

title: Senior Quality Engineer - Checkout & Payments (m/w/d)
description:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt. 

Als Senior Quality Engineer – Checkout & Payments trägst du dazu bei, zuverlässige Zahlungsabläufe über Shopware, Shopware Payments und externe Systeme hinweg sicherzustellen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf praxisnahen Integrationstests, Testautomatisierung und Release-Validierung: Du prüfst, ob Kund:innen einen Kauf erfolgreich abschließen können, Bestell- und Zahlungsstatus korrekt sind und Fehler sowie Wiederholungsversuche sicher verarbeitet werden. 

Du wirst Teil des Bereichs Quality Operations innerhalb von Delivery Excellence und arbeitest eng mit den Teams Checkout & Payments, dem Produktmanagement und weiteren Quality Engineers zusammen. Du bringst Qualität früh in die Feature-Planung ein, überführst Produktrisiken in ausführbare Tests, untersuchst Fehler und gibst klare Empfehlungen zur Release-Bereitschaft. Die Position ist eine Senior-Engineering-Rolle ohne Führungsverantwortung. Du entwickelst das bestehende Framework für Abnahmetests und die CI-Infrastruktur weiter, statt eine separate Testorganisation aufzubauen. 

- Risikobasierte Testabdeckung definieren und umsetzen. Arbeite mit Product und Engineering zusammen, um kritische Abläufe für Händler:innen und Kund:innen, die vorhandene Testabdeckung und Lücken zu identifizieren. Stimme für jedes Entwicklungspaket einen klar abgegrenzten Testumfang ab und begleite ihn durch Umsetzung, Review und Validierung. 

- Automatisierte Tests entwickeln und pflegen. Nutze TypeScript, Playwright sowie API- und Integrationstests, um das Verhalten im Storefront, in Shopware, im Payments-Service und an den Schnittstellen zu Zahlungsanbietern zu prüfen. Wähle die passende Testebene, statt jede Prüfung in einem Browser-Test abzubilden. 

- Zahlungsergebnisse prüfen, nicht nur das UI-Verhalten. Kontrolliere Bestellerstellung, Zahlungsstatus, Beträge und Währungen. Ergänze die Testabdeckung entsprechend dem Produktrisiko um relevante Szenarien zu Stornierung, Einzug, Rückerstattung, Webhooks und Wiederherstellung. 

- Integrationsfehler gemeinsam mit Entwickler:innen bewerten. Prüfe bei Bedarf Authentifizierung, Mandantentrennung, wiederholte Anfragen, Idempotenz und asynchrone Statusänderungen. Stelle sicher, dass Fehler weder doppelte Zahlungen noch inkonsistente Bestellungen verursachen. 

- Testergebnisse für die Auslieferung nutzbar machen. Integriere und pflege Produkttests gemeinsam mit Engineering und Product Operations in der CI. Verbessere Testdaten, Wiederholbarkeit und Diagnosemöglichkeiten. Unterscheide zwischen Produktfehlern, Problemen bei Zahlungsanbietern oder Umgebungen und instabilen Tests. 

- Releases und Kompatibilität validieren. Prüfe relevante Release-Artefakte, Upgrades und unterstützte Konfigurationen im bestehenden Release-Prozess. Überführe Erkenntnisse aus Vorfällen in Regressionstests und konkrete Verbesserungen. 

- Eine klare QA-Empfehlung kommunizieren. Erläutere gegenüber Product und Engineering den geprüften Umfang, die Ergebnisse, verbleibende Risiken, Blocker und nächsten Schritte. Sprich Prioritätskonflikte frühzeitig an und begleite offene Punkte bis zu ihrer Lösung, einer vereinbarten Übergabe oder einer klaren Entscheidung. 

- Verantwortung und Wissen teilen. Prüfe Testcode, arbeite mit Kolleg:innen im Pairing und verbessere gemeinsam nutzbare Fixtures und Dokumentation. Stimme dich mit anderen Quality Engineers ab, damit die Testabdeckung von mehreren Personen gepflegt und unterstützt werden kann. 

Das bringst du mit: 

- Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Pflege automatisierter Tests für produktive Software, einschließlich API- und Integrationstests sowie End-to-End-Tests. 

- Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in TypeScript oder JavaScript und praktische Erfahrung mit Playwright oder einem vergleichbaren Framework. Du kannst sicher in einer Playwright-basierten Codebasis arbeiten. 

- Erfahrung mit CI-Pipelines, Git, Code-Reviews, reproduzierbaren Testumgebungen und der Fehlersuche mithilfe von Logs, Traces und Anwendungscode. 

- Verständnis von HTTP-APIs, Authentifizierung, asynchroner Verarbeitung und Zustandsübergängen – einschließlich der Frage, wie sich Fehler- und Wiederholungsverhalten testen lässt. 

- Die Fähigkeit, unklare Produktanforderungen in testbare Szenarien zu übersetzen, nach Risiko zu priorisieren und sinnvolle Arbeitsschritte umzusetzen – und bei Bedarf Unterstützung einzuholen. 

- Eine kooperative Haltung: Du arbeitest gern im Team, lernst neugierig von anderen und gibst dein Wissen und deine Erfahrung gern weiter. 

- Klare mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikation auf Englisch sowie Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit Entwickler:innen und Produktkolleg:innen zu Qualitätsrisiken und Release-Entscheidungen. 

Von Vorteil: 

Erfahrung mit Zahlungsanbietern, E-Commerce oder Finanztransaktionen ist hilfreich. Ebenso willkommen sind Kenntnisse in PHP/Symfony, Shopware, API-Vertragstests auf OpenAPI-Basis, containerisierten Umgebungen oder mandantenfähigen Services. Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Entwicklungs- und Testwerkzeugen ist ebenfalls willkommen, sofern die Ergebnisse eigenständig geprüft und verifiziert werden. 

Wir schätzen unterschiedliche Karrierewege und Perspektiven. Du musst nicht in jedem der genannten Bereiche Erfahrung mitbringen, um dich zu bewerben. Kenntnisse in Shopware oder PayPal sind keine Voraussetzung.

title: Senior Rust Software Engineer - Industrial Automation (all genders)
description:
About The Company 

GROPYUS is a technology-based construction company focused on building multi-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with a wide range of design options, automated offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company is able to create resilient timber housing quickly and cost-effectively. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, strengthen Europe’s innovation capacity, and play a substantial role in improving sustainability. The company delivers its multi-family houses as a complete and turnkey solution. The combination of technology, construction, robotics, and manufacturing expertise means buildings can be created in a fully digitalized end-to-end process. The building system is based on versatile wall and slab elements, making it easier to optimize land use, customize plans, and build fast with both off-site construction and on-site assembly. This system is complemented by the Building Operating System–developed in-house.

About the role

You will join the Machine Integration & Simulation team, building the software platform that powers our machines, robots, and manufacturing systems. 

Teams at GROPYUS own what they build, including architecture, testing, deployment, monitoring, and operations. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will develop software that connects digital production workflows with physical manufacturing equipment and simulation environments. 

While you will work closely with machines, robots, and industrial systems, your primary focus will be building reliable, maintainable, and observable software using modern engineering practices. 

Our team is driving the evolution towards Software Defined Manufacturing , building systems that enable simulation, integration, orchestration, and operation of our production environment at scale. Rust is the primary language of the team. 

Your area of responsibilities include: 

- Design, build, test, deploy, and operate software for machines, robots, and manufacturing systems 

- Develop machine-near applications, integration services in Rust 

- Build interfaces between production systems, simulation environments, and manufacturing equipment 

- Own software throughout its lifecycle, from implementation to production support 

- Apply modern engineering practices including code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, and observability 

- Monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve production systems 

- Collaborate with software engineers, industrial engineers, and production teams to translate manufacturing requirements into robust software solutions 

About you

Must-have skills

- 5+ experience designing and building production systems in Rust 

- Experience designing, deploying, and operating software in production environments 

- Ability to work effectively with modern AI-enabled development tooling and continuously explore new ways to improve engineering productivity 

- Solid understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, APIs, and software architecture 

- Experience with CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and release management 

- Strong incident handling and problem-solving skills including on-call shift duty 

- Ownership mindset and passion for building reliable and resilient systems 

Nice-to-have skills

- Experience with industrial robots (KUKA), manufacturing, or industrial systems 

- Experience with IIoT, OPC UA, MQTT, or similar communication protocols 

- Experience with simulation, digital twins in the automation context, or edge computing 

- Linux and database fundamentals 

- Experience with Kubernetes and Azure 

- Experience working in environments where software downtime has a direct operational impact 

What We Offer 

- An unlimited contract with 30 vacation days. 

- Flexible, hybrid work: You can work from home or come into the office on the schedule that works best for you. Feel like traveling and working from another location? No problem. Tune into meetings and work from abroad for up to 40 days per year. In addition, flex hours allow you to prioritize important moments in your day. 

- Attractive perks and benefits : We offer a company pension scheme, language courses (English/German), and employee discounts with selected sustainable brands. Furthermore, our external partners in mental health support you in strengthening your mental health through anonymous private/group sessions. 

- Virtual Shares Program : Participate in the success of GROPYUS through our Virtual Share Program. 

- Ownership : You can truly make your mark with your work and contributions – on all our organizational levels. Find your solutions, drive and test them. 

- The chance to be part of something big : Our mission is to rethink an entire industry. Join us in reinventing construction and fostering sustainable, affordable living. 

- A diverse and enriching work environment : Become a valued member of a wonderfully diverse team of individuals from over 50 countries. At GROPYUS we value inclusion above all, ensuring that everyone feels they belong – no matter their background. In this way, our differences become strengths that help us grow as a team. 

Join us on our mission to design buildings as continuously evolving products to create the most exciting and affordable experience for all. We build for people and conserve the resources of our planet.

We can't wait to get to know you. 
For more information, visit our website .

title: Founders Associate Intern (Ops & Marketing)
description:
Mercura ( YC W25 ) helps the companies that build the real world move at software speed, automating the back-office work that runs the $12 trillion industry behind every hospital, school, and power plant. We started with one of their biggest bottlenecks - turning messy technical requests into accurate quotes - and eightfolded our revenue in 12 months . With a team of 16, we're now targeting $10M by the end of 2026 as well as our expansion into the US.

About the role

We’re looking for a Founder's Associate Intern (Marketing & Ops) to help make Mercura one of the most visible and compelling B2B AI companies in Europe.

You will take real ownership of how Mercura shows up externally — to customers, candidates and the broader ecosystem. You’ll work closely with the founders and team to turn ideas, company developments and customer insights into content, campaigns, events and new growth initiatives.

This is not an internship where you execute a predefined marketing calendar. We want someone who comes up with ideas, launches them quickly, measures what works and doubles down.

If you want to learn how to build a company, enjoy creating things from scratch and care deeply about results, this is an opportunity to own a meaningful part of Mercura from day one.

What you will be working on

- Company & Founder Marketing: Own and grow Mercura's company and founder LinkedIn presence. Turn what happens inside Mercura into content that reaches prospective customers, exceptional candidates and the wider industry.

- Growth Marketing: Develop and test new ways to generate awareness, inbound demand and talent. Come up with experiments, launch them quickly and measure whether they actually move the numbers.

- SEO, AI Visibility & Website: Help grow Mercura's organic presence across Google and AI search. Work with experienced external experts on SEO, AI visibility, website structure, conversion and design — and turn their recommendations into execution.

- Events: Build memorable events for both customers and talent — from recruiting events and community formats to intimate dinners with CEOs and strategic prospects. Own everything from the initial idea and guest list to invitations and execution.

- Brand & Content: Create landing pages, customer stories, campaigns, event concepts and other assets that make Mercura stand out and explain why what we are building matters.

- New Initiatives: Spot opportunities we haven't thought of yet. If you believe a campaign, partnership, event or completely different idea could create meaningful impact, you will have the freedom to make it happen.

What we’re looking for

Skills & Experience

- You have already gained hands-on marketing experience — for example at a startup, through an internship, your own project, student initiative or company.

- You can write exceptionally well and understand what makes people stop, read and take action.

- You have a strong instinct for content, positioning and what makes a company or person interesting.

- You combine creativity with commercial thinking. You care about reach, qualified leads, great applicants and actual outcomes , not just producing content.

- You are comfortable using AI tools and learn new tools extremely quickly.

- You take full ownership. If something needs to happen, you figure out how to make it happen rather than waiting for instructions.

- Your German is C2/native-level. This is a hard requirement. You are also a strong professional communicator in English.

Personality & Commitment

- You’re entrepreneurial, ambitious and highly proactive.

- You have strong drive and hold yourself to a high standard.

- You enjoy starting with a blank page and turning an idea into something real.

- You are creative, but equally comfortable with execution and the unglamorous details required to make something successful.

- You are highly organized and can run several initiatives simultaneously without losing speed.

- You care about results and naturally ask: Did this actually work? How can we make it better? 

- You want to work in person in Munich and thrive in an environment with significantly higher intensity and ownership than a typical 9–5 internship.

Availability

- You are available for a minimum 4-month full-time internship .

- Ideally, you are in the final semester of your Bachelor's or Master's degree , or have recently graduated.

- We are explicitly looking for people who could imagine staying at Mercura afterwards. If there is a strong mutual fit, there is an opportunity to transition into a full-time role .

Why Mercura

- Learn how to build a company: You’ll work close to the founders and see how decisions are made across growth, product, sales, hiring and company building — while owning projects yourself.

- Real ownership: You won’t just support marketing. You will own initiatives end-to-end and have the freedom to propose and build things that don't exist yet.

- An unusually steep learning curve: You’ll work across content, growth, brand, events, SEO, AI visibility and operations rather than spending months on one narrow internship project.

- Exceptional people around you: Work alongside experienced operators, ex-founders, engineers and top graduates from companies and universities such as Google, Bain, MIT, TUM, Harvard, CDTM and Cambridge.

- Build something with real-world impact: Mercura brings modern AI into industries that still rely heavily on emails, PDFs, phone calls and manual ERP processes.

- Tools without bureaucracy: Get access to the AI, marketing and productivity tools you need to do great work, as well as expert support where it helps you move faster.

- The everyday: Free team dinners, UrbanSportsClub membership, team workouts and support relocating to Munich.

About the process

Step 1: Intro Call 
A short conversation to get to know each other and tell you more about Mercura and the role.

Step 2: Practical Marketing Case 
A practical exercise around a real Mercura marketing challenge. We care much more about how you think, create and execute than theoretical marketing knowledge.

Step 3: Offer 
If there is a strong mutual fit, we'll make you an offer.

About the Founders 

We are Lukas, Stefan & Sean , the co-founders of Mercura. 

We share a deep commitment to excellence and the discipline to pursue what others might consider impossible. 

Two of us come from non-academic families, and we all know what it means to create our own paths and overcome barriers. This experience shapes our belief in equal opportunity and fuels our dedication to social mobility.

Lukas (left) is responsible for business development at Mercura. With his background as a Data Scientist at Allianz and at Google in Silicon Valley, he brings extensive expertise in data and AI. 
Lukas’ family has been active in the construction industry for over 100 years, giving him a deep understanding and passion for the sector's specific needs.

Sean (middle) is responsible for technical development at Mercura. As a top 0.01% physicist, Sean earned a Silver medal for Germany at the International Physics Olympiad (IPhO), began researching with the Max Planck Institute at the age of 16, and has since published at leading machine learning conferences. 

Stefan (right) leads product development at Mercura. Previously, he worked in management consulting at Bain & Company, where he helped manufacturers improve their operations. 
Stefan leverages his research experience at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and Harvard Business School to develop innovative solutions for the industry.

At Mercura, we believe that the best ideas emerge when people from different backgrounds collaborate together. We hire based on ability, mindset, and values, and we live by one simple rule: the best idea wins.

Beyond Mercura, we actively support initiatives that promote diversity and gender equity and commit a portion of our personal income each year to organizations expanding opportunity for others.

title: Director of Go-to-Market Engineering
description:
About Us 

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem .

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role 

We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering .

Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it.

You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations , lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter.

This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace.

The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV.

What You'll Do 

Own the strategy and the stack 

- Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.

- Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.

- Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.

- Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.

Build, hands-on 

- Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.

- Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.

- Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.

- Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.

Automate across SDR, AE, and AM 

- Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.

- Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.

- Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.

- Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.

Bridge commercial and technical 

- Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.

- Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.

- Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.

Build the team 

- Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.

- Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely.

- Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure.

What Will Make You Successful 

Experience 

- Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS

- Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team

- Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.

Technical craft 

- Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.

- Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.

- Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.

- Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.

- Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly.

Commercial instinct 

- You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.

- You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer.

- You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have 

- Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.

- Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy.

- Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America.

Why This Role 

GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. This is the chance to own it properly, the stack, the architecture, the build, and the commercial outcome across a $300M+ revenue business with 800 people in the field, a genuine appetite for automation, and the budget and executive backing to move fast.

You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible.

If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here.

AI at Perk 
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work 

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

description:
Join the team rewriting the rules in private markets. 

Moonfare delivers what few others can: the highly sought-after funds and hidden-gem investments that go beyond what most private banks offer. Every opportunity is subjected to a ruthless vetting process; the bar is unforgivingly high. The result? Institutional-quality portfolios for investors who demand more.

Our team combines finance veterans with talent from tech, consulting, law and industries you’d never expect. Headquartered in Berlin, we operate from eight offices across Europe, the US and Asia.

If you're ready to build what's next in private markets, let's talk.

Engineering Manager (m/f/d) 

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a meaningful part of our engineering organisation. You will be leading one or more product engineering teams alongside the DevOps and infrastructure engineers, who own the foundations everything else is built on – our cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, architecture and observability. Across these teams, you'll own their health, growth and delivery, and you'll be accountable both for the products they ship and for the reliability, security and scalability of the systems beneath them.

We're also at the start of a deliberate change in how we build, with a greater focus on AI enablement. We're early in this, and we want a manager who's excited to help lead it – rethinking how the team works, what good looks like, and where human judgement matters most when agents do more of the building. What sits underneath all of this is consistency: working in financial services means the bar for security, reliability and correctness is high, and the people who build well here are the ones who take that seriously without losing pace.

You will: 

- Lead, support and grow your engineers across product and platform – running thoughtful 1-to-1s, setting clear expectations, and helping people develop toward the careers they want.

- Own delivery across your teams. Where you lead product teams, partner closely with Product and Design to shape a realistic roadmap and create the conditions to ship it well; where you lead platform and infrastructure, set the priorities that keep the whole organisation moving.

- Own the technical direction of our infrastructure and architecture – cloud, networking, data, deployment, and the patterns other teams build on.

- Hold a high bar for engineering quality, and balance new platform work against the infrastructure and architectural debt that any scaling company accumulates.

- Help lead our move toward agentic engineering — setting how the team uses AI coding tools well, building the workflows and guardrails for delegating work to agents, and keeping quality, security and review standards high as more of the implementation is automated.

- Hire well, and partner with other engineering managers and senior engineers to raise the standard of how the whole organisation builds, runs and secures software.

The Next Moonfarian: 

- Experience managing software engineers — you've led at least one team, owned its delivery and growth, and you know how to develop people as well as systems. Experience leading more than one team, or a mix of product and platform engineers, is a strong plus.

- A strong engineering background in infrastructure, platform or backend systems, with the depth to set architectural direction and be respected by senior engineers.

- Deep, hands–on experience with cloud infrastructure — AWS in particular — and modern infrastructure practice: infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform), containers and orchestration, CI/CD, and observability.

- A coaching instinct: you take satisfaction in other people's growth and success, not only your own output.

- Clear communication, and the judgement to know when to dig into detail and when to step back and trust your team. You’re able to collaborate confidently with both technical and non–technical stakeholders.

- Comfort with ambiguity and change. We're scaling and evolving, and the role will too.

- Hands–on experience with modern AI coding tools – for example Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar agentic assistants. You use them in your own work, have a considered view on where they help and where they don't, and want to bring a team along with you as the way we build changes.

- Familiarity with modern web and cloud development. Our stack is built around TypeScript, Node.js and React on AWS – direct experience is welcome, but we care more about strong fundamentals and the ability to learn.

title: People Advisor
description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

About the role 

You're the local face of People at Legora: bringing local expertise, judgement and a strong understanding of employment practices to support employees and managers through a range of people matters. You will provide local advisory support, run local casework from start to finish, fill process and policy gaps, and make sure the employee experience in your market is accurate, timely and well handled. This is a hands-on, operational role and a strong launchpad for your next step. You'll be close enough to the business to understand how each function really works, trusted to make real judgment calls on the ground, and sharp enough to know when something needs a specialist instead. Sitting within People Operations, you will act as an escalation for our People Operations Specialists, providing guidance and resolving matters that require local interpretation, judgement or a more tailored approach

You'll partner closely with Employee Relations & Compliance, who own our jurisdictional frameworks, create consistent standards, and provide specialist expertise for complex, contested or legally sensitive matters. You'll also work alongside our People Business Partners, sharing local insights and supporting the effective delivery of people initiatives and organisational changes within your local market.

What you'll own 

- Provide practical advice to employees, managers and People Operations colleagues on local employment practices, policies and people matters that require interpretation or judgement.

- 

- Running local cases from start to finish within the scope of your certification, including absence management, ongoing performance concerns and restructuring conversations, with each one properly scoped, documented and closed

- Handling intake for leave, accommodation and absence requests, resolving what's routine and recognizing what needs to go further

- Building out local process and policy, and ensuring people programs effectively land in your market.

- Identify opportunities to improve local processes, employee experiences and ways of working, collaborating with other People teams to implement improvements.

- Applying your market's jurisdiction playbook accurately and consistently, and flagging where it doesn't fit local reality

- Recognizing the moment a matter becomes formal, contested or legally sensitive, and handing it off the same day with everything the next person needs to pick it up seamlessly

- Keeping your certification and calibration current so your casework meets the same standard as every other market

- Work closely with People Business Partners and Employee Relations & Compliance, sharing local trends, recurring issues and emerging risks to inform broader people decisions and improvements.

What success looks like 

- Employees and managers get fast, consistent, local support without having to wait on anyone

- Every case you run is well documented and would stand up to close scrutiny

- Handoffs are clean and immediate, and nothing formal or legally sensitive stays with you longer than it should

- Patterns you spot locally, such as a recurring issue or a risk building in one team, are raised early with both Employee Relations & Compliance and the relevant People Partner, before they become bigger problems

- You're a trusted, visible presence in your market: the person people choose to go to, not a channel they're told to use

Who you are 

- Experience in an HR, People Operations or HR generalist role, ideally with some exposure to employee relations casework

- A good understanding of local employment practices, employee relations and HR policies, with the ability to apply these in real-world situations.

- Able to stay neutral and steady under pressure, including with senior stakeholders

- Sound judgment on when to act and when to escalate; you'd rather flag early than guess

- Organized and detail-oriented, with documentation clear enough that someone else could pick it up cold

- Motivated by where this role can lead, with a genuine interest in growing

- Comfortable working within a defined playbook while bringing your own judgment to how it's applied

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer 

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Product Engineer / Builder
description:
Why this role exists

Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel.

Tacto is building the intelligence layer between bits and atoms, connecting the digital world of engineering with the physical world of manufacturing. It’s how AI gets into the real economy.

More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto. We’re the category leader in DACH, backed by Sequoia and Index, and we’re just getting started.

What you'll do

Find the problems worth solving, then solve them end to end. Talk to customers, build across the whole stack, and ship to production. Turn what AI can do today into features that procurement and engineering teams use every day. You’re done when it drives revenue, not when it’s merged. Don’t wait for a PRD.

What we mean by Builder

Because of AI, we only hire Builders. No specialized roles.

A Builder takes a messy, unclear problem and owns it from start to finish. That goes for business problems, not just customer problems. You decide what’s worth doing, make the case for it, test the risky parts early, and see it through until it pays off. When something works, you share it so everyone gets better.

We care about outcomes, not code quality for its own sake. What makes this fun is the loop from idea to reality, and AI just made that loop 10x shorter. There’s no room here for “my job is to solve interesting technical problems.”

How we build - The Tacto Engineer

Builder is the what. The Tacto Engineer is the how. It’s our engineering practice and the bar we hold each other to.
Wear the customer’s shoes. Ship fast, finish fully. Sweat the details. Get 1% better every week. No lone wolves. Use AI as leverage, not a crutch.
Read the full version at en.tacto.ai/engineering . If it reads like the way you already work, you’ll fit in here.

Who we're looking for

Hungry, creative, AI pilled engineers at every level of seniority who care more about the result than the craft.

- You have your own ideas and act on them, whether that’s something you started, a side project, or a feature nobody asked for that turned out to matter.

- You’ve shipped real production software in a modern product team. Experience with B2B SaaS or data products is a plus.

- You work in Cursor, Claude, Codex and agents every day, and you’ve built something with them that wouldn’t exist otherwise.

- You go deep in modern Python (FastAPI, async, SQL) or TypeScript/React/Next.js, and you’re happy to work anywhere in the stack.

- You’ve built AI features into a product, or you’re obsessively learning how.

- You want to be in a room full of people who are fired up about what they’re building.

Stack

Python, FastAPI, Postgres, and ClickHouse on the backend. React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, and Storybook on the frontend. GitHub, Linear, and Figma for everything around it. For AI, whatever ships fastest.

How we work

We’re in our Munich office four days a week, with 100+ people building together every day. We measure outcomes, not hours. Trust is high and feedback is direct.
Competitive salary and meaningful equity. 26 + 4 vacation days, Wellpass fitness membership, JobRad bike leasing, company pension plan, and a childcare (Kita) subsidy.

Our Background 

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters 

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI. 

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer 

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

- Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

- Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

- Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

- Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

- Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

- Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer (m/w/d) – Azure & AWS
description:
Senior Cloud Security Engineer (m/w/d) – Azure & AWS

AJAT GmbH · Köln · Vollzeit · Festanstellung · Vor Ort 

!!!!! DEUTSCH MINDESTENS C1 !!! 

Gestalte sichere Cloud-Umgebungen mit uns

Du hast Azure- und AWS-Umgebungen selbst abgesichert, setzt Zero-Trust-Prinzipien praktisch um und arbeitest sicher mit Microsoft Intune und PowerShell? Du möchtest technische Verantwortung übernehmen und dein Wissen in ein Team einbringen?

Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

AJAT ist ein IT-Unternehmen aus Köln mit Schwerpunkten in IT-Services, System Engineering und Cybersecurity. Für unsere Kundenprojekte suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die Sicherheitsanforderungen versteht, technisch umsetzt und Ergebnisse nachvollziehbar dokumentiert.

Deine Aufgaben

- Azure und AWS absichern: Du analysierst bestehende Cloud-Umgebungen, erkennst Sicherheitsrisiken und setzt geeignete Maßnahmen für Identitäten, Berechtigungen, Netzwerke, Workloads und Daten um.

- Identitäten und privilegierte Zugriffe schützen: Du entwickelst nachvollziehbare Berechtigungskonzepte und setzt sie beispielsweise mit Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management sowie AWS IAM und Rollen um.

- Zero Trust praktisch umsetzen: Du verbindest die Prüfung von Identitäten und Gerätezuständen mit minimal erforderlichen Berechtigungen und klar definierten Zugriffsregeln.

- Sicherheitsbefunde bearbeiten: Du bewertest Fehlkonfigurationen und Auffälligkeiten, priorisierst Maßnahmen und überprüfst deren Wirksamkeit.

- Mit Kunden und Team zusammenarbeiten: Du erklärst technische Entscheidungen verständlich, stimmst Änderungen ab und erstellst Dokumentationen, mit denen andere zuverlässig weiterarbeiten können.

Du erfüllst einen der folgenden beiden Wege:

- Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, IT-Sicherheit oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung sowie mehr als fünf Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung .

- Eine abgeschlossene IT-Berufsausbildung, beispielsweise als Fachinformatiker/in für Systemintegration, sowie mindestens acht Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung .

- Sehr gute, praktisch nachgewiesene Kenntnisse in Azure und AWS. Du hast produktive Umgebungen selbst betreut und abgesichert und kannst deinen eigenen Beitrag anhand konkreter Projekte erläutern.

description:
At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. Dragos is hiring an Associate Principal Incident Responder in Germany to lead OT incident response and strengthen customer IR maturity across Europe. Ideal for practitioners who are equally strong executing investigations and advising on strategy.

Qualifications : 

- Must be a German resident. 

- Fluent in German with a working proficiency in English . 

- 8+ years of hands-on incident response and digital forensics experience, with lead-level scope and depth in at least two of network, hardware (controllers/instrumentation), memory, or disk forensics. Methodology mastery matters more than tool specialization.

- Proven ability to lead end-to-end investigations, correlating events across data types to uncover threats, hunt malicious activity, and coordinate communications during incidents.

- Experience in ICS/OT cybersecurity, including industrial architecture, threat landscapes, vulnerabilities, and frameworks and standards.

- Experience in industrial environments (asset owner, operator, integrator, or consultant), with the ability to advise at both technical and enterprise-strategy levels.

- Consulting or advisory experience, translating technical depth into strategic guidance, with excellent written and verbal communication, including customer-facing documentation, playbooks, executive briefings, and calm leadership during high-pressure incidents.

- Familiarity with the European and German OT regulatory context: NIS2, IT-SiG 2.0, BSI KRITIS, IEC 62443, and NIST CSF. 

- Willingness to travel up to 40% (domestic and international) to support customer engagements.

title: Client Enablement & Coaching Lead (F/H/X)
description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt.

Key Responsibilities: what you'll do 

- Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement: 

- Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme.

- Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

- Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

- Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

- Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations.

Project Management: 

- Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised.

- Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

- Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

Mentorship & Coaching: 

- Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

- Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies.

Analytical & Problem-Solving: 

- Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

- Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

- Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence: 

- Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

- Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration.

- Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

Driving Organisational Change: 

- Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach.

- Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success.

Skills: what you'll have 

- Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

- Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

- Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions.

- Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience.

- Fluent English & French is a prerequisite 

Experience 

- Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level.

- Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively.

- Change management using agile methodologies.

- Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. 

Other Requirements: 

- Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs.

- Ability to work across multiple clients and markets, quickly adapting to varying client needs and environments/languages.

- Highly driven to ‘make things happen’. Growth mindset demonstrated through all your work. Ability to speak persuasively and inspire energy, motivating both internal teams and external stakeholders including Direct Reports.

- Comfortable navigating between operations and technical conversations, bridging gaps between business needs and technical solutions.

- Expertise in driving programme ownership, from inception through to sustainable execution, ensuring clients are equipped to lead post-migration.

title: Sales & Partner Manager for Spain & Portugal - Gastronomy (m/w/d)
description:
Every day, owners, waitstaff and chefs pour their hearts into crafting dining experiences. Yet they are expected to keep up in an always-on world with relentless technological change.

We build solutions for them to keep up – and yes, with AI. But not for the sake of it.

What you sell 

Assistent.ai is the AI Suite for Guest Communication, purpose-built for hospitality teams. It answers and converts calls to reservations, orders or tasks – on live data, connected knowledge, and on brand.

We are looking for a Sales & Partner Manager for Spain and Portugal.

- Location: Remote in Germany, with regular travel to Spain and Portugal

- Start: As soon as possible

- Employment: Full-time, or part-time from 50% with a path to full-time

How we sell 

We actively listen, understand and work out solutions. We do not push where there is no problem to solve. We build long term, trustworthy relationships. We value lifetime value over shortsighted gains.

Hit apply if you're humble to learn, ambitious to win, and have a weakness for Iberian food and culture.

Tasks

Open Spain and Portugal. Win restaurants. Build partners. 

You're our first person for Spain and Portugal. No team to hide behind, no playbook to follow. You write it.

You win restaurants: on the phone, on video calls and in person.

You win partners: reservation systems that make real-time automation possible, and distributors who already reach the restaurants we want.

You get restaurants on board, make sure they're up and running, and help them grow with Assistent.ai.

You are our customers' voice inside the company.

It's that simple. And that hard.

Requirements

- You have agency: you see what's missing and get things done.

- You win trust before you win deals.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, Flex - combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings - all while helping companies switch to renewable energy.

We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast - the market window is open and we intend to own it.

About trawa 

trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future.

We're looking for a (Senior) Associate – Energy Markets & Business Development (Railway Power & PPAs) to own an important part of our energy value chain. You'll report directly to our Energy Operations Manager with close collaboration with the COO and Trading Team. You'll shape the product that makes European industry competitive again - and you'll do it at pace. This role is based in Berlin. trawa is an "office first" company, which means you will work from the office typically five days per week.

The Team 

You'll join our Energy Operations team, which owns the energy side of our business - from sourcing and portfolio management to making sure our customers' energy products work in practice. You'll work hand in hand with our Trading Team as well as with Sales, Pricing, Product and Tech. You start without direct reports, but with a clear mandate: build and grow the business areas you own.

What you'll do 

As (Senior) Associate – Energy Markets & Business Development, you combine a strong analytical mind with business building:

Build our railway power business: A significant share of our customers comes from the railway power (Bahnstrom) segment. You take ownership of this segment from a trading and energy perspective - you understand its specific market setup, improve how we forecast, source, price and supply railway power, and make us the go-to partner for these customers. You dig into how we currently predict our railway customers' energy demand and find ways to make these forecasts more accurate. You also build partnerships with IT service providers from the railway industry and with infrastructure operators.

Lead international railway expansion: You drive the expansion of our railway power offering into further European countries - you analyse market structures, regulation and commercial potential, and contribute your findings into a concrete go-to-market plan.

Expand our long-term product offering: Our customers buy long-term products from us, such as PPAs and Future/Forwards products. You develop our offering so we can provide more and better-fitting products to our customers.

Architect of the long-term trading process: You centralise and streamline the end-to-end process from pricing and offer creation to actual trade execution across Sales, Pricing, Trading and Operations - making it faster, more robust and scalable, and ultimately enabling a better product for our customers.

Bridge between trading and business: You work closely with our quant trading and data science team and turn their models and insights into processes and systems that work across teams and markets - so that pricing, risk and market insights reliably translate into better decisions and products for our customers.

Who we are looking for 

Strong quantitative skills: You think analytically, feel at home with numbers and data and can confidently challenge quantitative results - without having to be a quant or developer yourself. Ideally, you have a degree in a quantitative or business field (e.g. economics, engineering, industrial engineering, business administration).

Business acumen & venture mindset: You think commercially, enjoy building new business areas from scratch and prioritise by impact.

Interest in energy markets & trading: You are fascinated by how energy markets work - from wholesale and forward markets to PPAs, hedging and pricing - and want to dive deep into them. First exposure to these topics is a strong plus.

Hungry & ambitious: You want to grow fast, take on responsibility early and set high standards for yourself. You don't wait for instructions - you find answers, push topics forward and enjoy a steep learning curve.

High ownership & structured execution: You drive topics end-to-end, align stakeholders across departments and turn ideas into scalable processes with tangible business impact.

Communication: You speak German at native level and very good English, and you translate confidently between commercial, quantitative and operational perspectives.

90 Day Goals

After 6 Weeks (Onboarding): 

- You have understood trawa's business, product and energy value chain in detail and got to know all relevant internal and external stakeholders.

- You understand our railway power customers, their contracts, how we currently forecast their energy demand and how we source, price and supply their energy.

- You have mapped our current long-term trading process - from pricing and offer creation to trade execution - and identified the key pain points.

Month 3 (Ramp-Up): 

- You are the go-to person for trading and energy questions in the railway power segment, have implemented first improvements and developed a concept for improving our demand forecasts for railway customers.

- You have delivered a first assessment of potential expansion markets for railway power, including a recommendation on which country to tackle first, and have identified and approached first potential partners among railway IT service providers and infrastructure operators.

- You have designed a target process for our long-term trading, started its implementation and proposed first additions to our long-term product offering.

What Will Help You Succeed 

- Work experience in a high-paced environment, e.g. a start-up, scale-up or consulting.

- Experience in energy markets - especially in energy trading, origination or pricing - or in financial trading markets.

- Knowledge of the German energy market and/or the railway power (16.7 Hz traction power) market.

- An affinity for AI-powered tools and automation to make processes faster and smarter.

Why us? 

Impact: European SMEs spend between €150k and €10M per year on electricity — most are overpaying and locked into outdated procurement. Your product will directly change how thousands of companies buy, manage, and use energy. The impact is measurable, the market is massive, and the timing is now.

The Role: You build business areas at the intersection of trading, energy and venture development - with direct impact on our revenue, our product offering and our expansion across Europe.

Responsibility & Support: You own real business areas from day one - backed by our Energy Operations Manager, the COO and an experienced Trading Team who help you ramp up quickly and grow into the role.

Ownership: We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level.

Learning & Growth: We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You'll have opportunities for mentorship, learning, and career progression.

Diversity and Inclusion: We're an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences, and perspectives. At trawa, we're family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We're committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Package & Benefits: We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic, cross-cultural environment and is passionate about driving growth through collaboration. This role is part of our Central Finance Team at saas.group. 

What is saas.group? 

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 400+ colleagues spanning 45 countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 24 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.

Profile Overview 

We are looking for a hands-on, detail-oriented Managing Director to lead SaaS.group GmbH, our German legal entity based in Schönefeld . In this role, you will serve as the registered Managing Director on-site, exercising real decision-making authority, managing office administration, and overseeing day-to-day accounting operations . You will serve as the local face of the company for authorities, banks, auditors, and external service providers while working in close alignment with our Central Legal, Accounting, and Finance teams . 

This is a unique opportunity for an experienced finance or office management professional based in the Berlin/Brandenburg region looking to step up into an official corporate leadership role within an international, fast-growing software group . 

Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:

- Seamlessly transition into the registered Managing Director role for SaaS.group GmbH and establish effective on-site operational processes in Schönefeld . 

- Assume complete oversight of local bookkeeping (payables, receivables, document management) and streamline month-end close workflows . 

- Build strong working relationships with our external tax advisors, auditors, banks, and internal group accounting/legal functions . 

- Ensure full compliance with all corporate-law requirements, commercial register obligations, and internal rules of procedure . 

Your responsibilities 

- Manage SaaS.group GmbH on-site in Schönefeld, taking full ownership of approvals, contract execution, and payment authorizations within defined rules of procedure . 

- Run and oversee day-to-day bookkeeping, including accounts payable/receivable, document organization, and preparation of month-end closing activities . 

- Collaborate closely with tax advisors and auditors on VAT filings, annual financial statements, and audit processes . 

- Maintain strict compliance with German corporate-law obligations, including commercial register filings, transparency register updates, and shareholder resolutions . 

- Lead office management and operational setup in Schönefeld, managing incoming mail, vendor/service provider contracts, archiving, and filing systems . 

- Act as the primary local point of contact for the German tax office (Finanzamt), financial institutions, local authorities, and insurers . 

What You bring to the table 

- Vocational training in a commercial field (e.g., Tax Clerk / Steuerfachangestellte/r, Certified Accountant / Bilanzbuchhalter/in, Office Management) or equivalent practical experience . 

- Multi-year background in accounting, financial administration, or senior office management . 

- Strong proficiency with DATEV (or comparable accounting software) as well as modern digital tools (MS Office / Google Workspace) . 

- Fluency in German and good working proficiency in English to collaborate effectively across our international group . 

- Willingness to assume corporate liability and responsibility as a registered Managing Director (leadership experience is a plus, but not required) . 

- Residence in the Berlin/Brandenburg region with the requirement for regular, physical presence at our Schönefeld office . 

What's in it for You
