title: Growth Associate (Intern)
description:
Who we are 

Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 4 billion minutes worldwide.

Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR.

What you will do 

Melotech is scaling fast, and organic reach is one of the engines behind it. As Growth Associate (Intern), you help run that engine end to end: the creators, the formats, the trends and the numbers behind them. This is an organic growth role first, measured on how much reach every hour and every euro brings back. You work directly with our founders, our Growth Manager, product and data team.

Today that means a steady stream of new products that each deserve a shot at going viral across TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Your first job is to build the machine behind that: find the creators and communities that move culture, turn what works into repeatable playbooks, and run more experiments in a week than most teams run in a quarter.

On a typical day, your tasks may include:

- Creator network: finding, briefing and paying creators and pages at scale, from small accounts with loyal audiences to the ones that set trends, and keeping the ones that deliver

- Seeding: getting our products into the formats and communities where they can travel, at the right moment and in the right volume

- Trend spotting: catching formats and memes early and moving on them within days, not weeks

- Experiments: running many cheap tests every week, with clear rules for what wins and what gets killed, and turning the winners into playbooks the team can repeat

- New channels: finding places where attention is still cheap, from fan pages and communities to platforms nobody on the team is using yet

- Organic and paid together: working with our Growth Manager so organic winners get scaled with paid, and what paid learns feeds back into organic

- Measurement: knowing which number answers which question, for example what saves and shares tell you that views do not, and what each view really costs

- Tooling: building the trackers, scripts and automations you need, with platform data and AI tools as your daily coworkers

Who you are 

We're looking for a student or recent graduate who lives on the platforms and wants to learn how to make content travel.

Typically, your profile will look like this:

- Platform fluency: you know TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts well and can explain why a post performs

- Hands-on experience: you have grown an account, a page or a side project, or supported a startup or brand on social

- Creator marketing: you enjoy working with creators and have a feel for content that looks native

- Creativity: you bring fresh ideas and test them in a structured way

- Analytical: you are comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets; SQL, Python or AI tools are a plus

- Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment

- A big plus: you are a creator yourself, or have run pages with a real following

- Academics: pursuing or recently graduated with a degree at a top-tier university, with an outstanding academic record: grades, scholarships or awards to show for it

What makes this exciting 

You own a lever the whole company feels. Every breakout you engineer shows up directly in how fast we can grow, at a fraction of what paid reach would cost. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate.

We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together.

What the process will look like 

We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP.

Once you begin our process, you can progress from start to offer within a week, depending on how quickly you can move through each stage:

- Initial interview: 30-minute introductory call, getting to know you

- Case interview: 90-minute case discussion, present and debate your skills

- Founder interview: 90-minute interview with our CEO, going deep on all topics

- Offer, contract signing and onboarding

Note: As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role.

About Wayflyer 

Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.

Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.

You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.

The challenge 

There are thousands of businesses globally growing fast and hitting the same wall - they need capital, and traditional lenders are too slow, too rigid, or simply not interested. We've already deployed over $6bn to growing businesses like these. The opportunity in front of us is significant, and we need people who can capitalise on it.

What you'll actually do 

You'll own the full sales cycle from sourcing your own leads to closing deals with some of the most exciting consumer brands in Germany. You'll run in-depth discovery calls using MEDDPICC, work closely with our underwriting team to move fast without cutting corners, and negotiate deals that genuinely work for both sides. You'll have a dedicated BDR alongside you, but you won't wait around for a full pipeline to land in your lap. The best AEs here source relentlessly, close confidently, and treat their customers like business partners, not transactions. Top performers are hitting ~200% of target. That's not a boast. It's a signal of what’s possible.

What this role could turn into 

Account Executives at Wayflyer tend to grow in one of two directions - first on the ground in one of our emerging verticals, or into team leadership as we scale. We're continuing to launch new products and verticals, which means the people who perform here will have real options. We'd rather promote from within than hire from outside, and our track record reflects that.

Who thrives here 
You've worked a full sales cycle before, and you didn't just hit your number; you understood exactly why you hit it and what to do differently when you didn't. You source your own pipeline without being asked, and you don't wait for perfect conditions to start. You're energised by ambiguity, not paralysed by it. You push deals forward when others would wait for a signal. When a sceptical founder pushes back, you lean in. You've been told "no" and come back with a better question. You care about eCommerce and small business growth, not as a line on a cover letter, but as a genuine reason you want this job.

We hire for range 
Full sales cycle experience across a range of deal values (think: $10K to 100K) in SaaS or FinTech, ideally with time spent as an outbound BDR/SDR. You know what it takes to build a pipeline from scratch, not just work it. A consistent track record of exceeding targets matters more than tenure. Resilience shows up in your history: you've had a bad quarter, figured out why, and bounced back stronger. MEDDPICC familiarity is required, and you'll need to speak German fluently. Startup or scale-up experience helps; the pace here is real, the playbook is still being written, and we need people who see that as an opportunity, not a risk.

Location and working policy 

📍 Berlin, hybrid (3-4 days per week in the office)

The good stuff 

25 days off, plus public holidays. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Wayflyer Limited will process your personal data for the purpose of evaluating your suitability for the role. Such processing is based on the need to take steps prior to entering into a potential employment agreement. To learn more about how we handle your personal data, you can contact our privacy team at https://wayflyer.com/privacy-notice .

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Product Designer.

About the role 

We are building the world's leading software platform for running critical and highly-automated decisions. Our customers use our product to catch fraudsters, prevent money laundering, and expand access to credit for small businesses, among many other use cases. Taktile is making millions of such decisions across the globe every day.

We do this through a powerful suite of tools that combine ML/AI with heuristics and logic, flexible data integrations, and an overlay of data analytics. We see a high degree of usability as a key differentiator and have been investing in a world-class UI/UX from day one. To help us deliver our vision, we are seeking talented and experienced Senior Product Designers.

As a Senior Product Designer, you will be responsible for translating highly technical and complex problems into clean and understandable solutions. You will be the voice of user experience and design standards in a cross-functional setting, and responsible for the end-to-end design process for your team. You’ll join a diverse design team and work closely with engineers, marketing and sales to create products that make it easy for our users to make smarter and safer decisions at scale.

*Please not that this role is not open to full remote and is Berlin or London based only 

What You'll Do 

- Independently lead all design efforts for a cross functional team within Taktile.

- Apply design thinking to complex technical problems

- Continuously learn from user research and be the voice of our customers in product development

- Conduct competitive analysis of existing products in the marketplace to identify opportunities for improvement

- Connect business strategies, available technologies, and design solutions to deliver great experiences that impact our users and our business goals

- Actively validate and iterate to ensure our product concepts are aligned with the business needs and stakeholder expectations

- Collaborate closely with engineers and ensure that designs are implemented effectively in code

- Contribute to and work with our Design System

- Collaborate with other designers to create a coherent user experience across Taktile’s product

Required Experience 

- 5+ years of experience in Product Design, ideally with B2B SaaS, fintech, or similarly complex technical domains.

- Proven experience leading design for a product area or cross-functional team.

- Strong systems thinking and ability to design complex workflows and data-heavy interfaces

- Ability to translate complex technical and business requirements into clear, scalable user experiences.

- Experience driving discovery and shaping problem definitions with Product and Engineering

- Excellent communication skills

Ideal, But Not Required 

- Experience designing agentic interfaces and interest in AI-powered products

- Strong technical understanding that allows you to engage in discussions with the Engineering Team

- Experience in working in a fast-paced start-up/scale-up environment

- An interest in fintech and financial services

Our Offer 

- Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

- Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

- Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

- Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.

- Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

- Receive a new Apple MacBook Pro, as well as meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance 

- We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply

- We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears

About Us 
Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com 

About Your Employment. Taktile operates through regional entities worldwide. Depending on the location of this role, your employment or engagement will be with Taktile LLC (US), Taktile GmbH (Germany), Taktile Ltd (UK), or Taktile SRL (Romania). The applicable entity will be confirmed during the offer process. 

Your Privacy . Taktile (“we” or “us”) is the controller of the personal data you provide during this 

application process. We collect and process your name, contact details, resume/CV, work history, education, and any other information you submit or that we obtain from publicly available sources or references. 

How we use your data : We process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy, communicate with you about the recruitment process, comply with legal obligations (such as right-to-work verification), and, with your consent, to consider you for future opportunities. 

Legal basis (EU/UK applicants): We rely on (i) pre-contractual steps at your request (GDPR/UK GDPR Art.6(1)(b)), (ii) legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c)), and (iii) our legitimate interest in evaluating candidates (Art.6(1)(f)).

Your rights: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your personal data, to data portability, and to withdraw consent. 

Automated decision-making: We use automated tools to assist in screening applications. No hiring decision is made solely by automated means without human review. 

International transfers: Your data may be transferred to and processed in the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, or Romania. Where required, transfers are protected by Standard Contractual Clauses or other approved mechanisms.

title: (Senior) Integration Specialist
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 

The opportunity 

BLP creates value the moment it is connected to our customers' ERP systems. As an Integration Specialist, you onboard our customers on our integrations and ensure connectivity between BLP and their ERP system. You assess and challenge change requests and specify them for our Integration Engineers. Your work directly drives customer go-lives and revenue. Integration Engineers build, Project Managers lead the project, you make the integration work.

What you'll do 

- Onboard customers on our ERP integrations: analyze their IT landscape, engage the right stakeholders, advise on best practices, install and configure our ERP integrations.

- Assess and challenge change requests and turn them into a clear, implementable specification for our Integration Engineers.

- Advise customers during self-onboarding.

- Collaborate with the Integration Engineers to continuously improve our integrations and streamline the onboarding experience.

- Flag major development needs and blockers early, and make clear recommendations.

- Support Project Managers on technical feasibility, effort and sequencing, through first go-live.

What you bring 

- 2+ years in technical consulting, enterprise integration or technical product work.

- Experience working in a customer-facing role.

- A solid grasp of ERP landscapes, interfaces and master data, and how data actually moves between them.

- Deep understanding of at least one ERP system (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, Infor, Abas), both from a functional and integration perspective.

- Familiarity with common integration formats (CSV, XML, JSON) and transports (REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP).

- Fluent German and English, spoken and written.

Nice to have 

- Understanding of purchase-to-pay (P2P) and order-to-cash (O2C) processes, including the related finance and accounting workflows.

- Experience writing specifications that engineers can build from without a translation layer.

- Comfortable reading production code, with the help of AI tools, to understand integration behavior and answer customer questions.

Why BLP 

- Real impact: successfully connecting a customer's ERP system decides whether a customer goes live.

- A fast-growing, global AI company providing the ideal environment to learn and grow fast.

- Clear handoffs: Integration Engineers build and own the product code, Project Managers own the plan, and you own the implementation.

- At least one month of onboarding at our Zurich headquarters.

- Employee ownership through our stock option program.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 

Location 

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission 

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Senior Project Manager , you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.

At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical.

You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.

We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.

Your Career Path in Project Management 

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

- Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management. 

- Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs. 

- Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities 

- Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

- Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

- Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

- Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

- Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

- Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

- Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager 

- Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

- Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

- Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.

- Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.

- Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For 

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

- Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.

- Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.

- Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem.

- Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it.

- Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits.

- Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder.

What You Bring 

- 5+ years of experience delivering complex projects: management consulting, enterprise software implementation, or large-scale transformation delivery.

- Proven track record running multi-country or multi-entity programs with senior client stakeholders, and steering a committee that includes client executives.

- Experience leading a delivery team rather than only a plan.

- Strong analytical and communication skills. You can translate a business need into something a technical team can act on.

- Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

- Bonus points for ERP implementation experience, finance or supply chain processes, or AI-driven SaaS.

Benefits 

- High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

- Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

- Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

- Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

- Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

- Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

- Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

- Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers .

title: People and Business Operations Specialist
description:
Über Mindpeak 

Mindpeak ist ein KI-Unternehmen aus Hamburg mit einer klaren Mission: Krebsdiagnosen genauer, effizienter und personalisierter zu machen.

Wir entwickeln Deep-Learning-Lösungen für die computergestützte Pathologie, die KI direkt in die klinische Praxis bringen. Unsere Technologie wird bereits in mehr als 25 Ländern in der Routinediagnostik eingesetzt und unterstützt führende Pharma- und Biotech-Unternehmen bei der Entwicklung neuer Krebstherapien.

Rund 50 Menschen aus Technologie, Medizin und Wissenschaft arbeiten bei uns gemeinsam an diesem Ziel.

Über die Rolle 

Bei Mindpeak arbeiten wir daran, mit KI die Krebsdiagnostik zu verbessern. Damit sie sich auf ihre Arbeit konzentrieren können, braucht es im Hintergrund jemanden, der dafür sorgt, dass unsere People Operations funktionieren.

Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. 

Als People & Business Operations Specialist bist du das operative Rückgrat unserer People- und Business Operations. Du sorgst dafür, dass neue Kolleg:innen einen guten Start haben, Mitarbeiterdaten stimmen, die Payroll vorbereitet ist, Rechnungen und administrative Finanzprozesse zuverlässig bearbeitet werden, Dokumente rechtzeitig vorliegen, Trainings im Blick bleiben und unsere Mitarbeitenden bei administrativen und organisatorischen Fragen schnell Unterstützung bekommen.

Deine Aufgaben 

- HR-Administration & Personio: Du hältst Mitarbeiterdaten, Abwesenheiten, Arbeitszeitmodelle und Dokumente aktuell und sorgst für eine verlässliche Datenbasis.

- On- & Offboarding: Du koordinierst die administrativen Schritte rund um Ein- und Austritte, von Google-Accounts und Hardware bis zu Zugängen und Rückgaben, und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Ablauf.

- Payroll & Finance Administration: Du bereitest die monatliche Payroll vor, bearbeitest Rückerstattungen für Mitarbeitende und unterstützt unsere Finanzadministration, insbesondere bei der vorbereitenden Buchhaltung, Rechnungsbearbeitung und Verwaltung von Firmenkreditkarten.

- Business Operations & Prozesskoordination : Du verwaltest administrative Vertragsfristen, hältst Firmenversicherungen aktuell, koordinierst externe Dienstleister und sorgst dafür, dass wiederkehrende administrative Prozesse strukturiert und zuverlässig ablaufen.

- HR-Dokumente: Du kümmerst dich um Bescheinigungen, Zeugnisse und weitere administrative Unterlagen.

- Vertragsadministration: Du bereitest Arbeitsverträge, Vertragsänderungen und Nachträge auf Basis unserer Vorlagen vor und steuerst den Unterschriftenprozess.

- Sozialversicherung & Benefits: Du betreust administrative Themen rund um Sozialversicherung, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Benefits und koordinierst dich mit unseren externen Partnern.

- Compliance, Trainings & Arbeitssicherheit: Du administrierst unser Learning Management System, steuerst Pflichttrainings sowie jährliche Unterweisungen zum Arbeits- und Brandschutz und dokumentierst Trainingsnachweise so, dass sie in Audits (z. B. ISO) belastbar sind.

- HR-Reporting: Du erstellst Auswertungen zu Themen wie Headcount, Abwesenheiten oder Trainings.

- People-Prozesse: Du unterstützt organisatorisch bei Feedback-Zyklen und anderen wiederkehrenden People-Prozessen und kümmerst dich um Teamrituale wie Geburtstage, Jubiläen und Abschiede.

- Mitarbeitenden-Support: Du bist eine verlässliche Anlaufstelle für administrative HR-Fragen und sorgst dafür, dass Anliegen nicht liegen bleiben.

Was wir suchen 

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn du:

- eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mitbringst,

- bereits praktische Erfahrung in Business oder HR-Administration, People Operations oder Personalwesen gesammelt hast,

- strukturiert, sorgfältig und eigenständig arbeitest und Verantwortung für deine Themen übernimmst,

- vertraulich und sorgfältig mit sensiblen Personaldaten umgehst,

- auch bei vielen parallelen Aufgaben den Überblick behältst und Dinge zuverlässig zu Ende bringst,

- gerne organisierst und Freude daran hast, wenn Prozesse reibungslos funktionieren,

- serviceorientiert bist und gerne dafür sorgst, dass andere gut arbeiten können,

- sicher mit digitalen Tools arbeitest – Erfahrung mit Personio ist ein Plus,

- idealerweise schon in einem regulierten Umfeld gearbeitet hast, z. B. in MedTech oder einem ISO-zertifizierten Unternehmen (kein Muss),

Gute People und Business Operations fallen manchmal erst auf, wenn sie nicht funktionieren. Für uns sind sie deshalb kein Nebenthema, sondern eine wichtige Grundlage für ein gut funktionierendes Unternehmen.

In dieser Rolle hast du direkten Einfluss auf den Arbeitsalltag unseres gesamten Teams. Du schaffst Struktur, Verlässlichkeit und einen guten Service für unsere Mitarbeitenden – und gibst anderen damit den Rücken frei, sich auf ihre eigentliche Arbeit zu konzentrieren.

description:

As the Director – European Government Operations, based in Munich/ Berlin, Germany, you will lead Rocket Lab's government affairs strategy across Germany and the broader European region. You will play a critical role in advancing Rocket Lab's business objectives by shaping policy environments, building strategic government relationships, and ensuring alignment between Government Affairs and Business Development. In this role, you will work at the intersection of aerospace innovation, national security, and European public-sector engagement. To be successful, you must be results‑oriented, proactive, politically astute, and deeply comfortable operating in complex, fast‑moving environments. Join a driven team of pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO 

- Build and lead Rocket Lab's in‑house European Government Operations function, delivering the same level of strategic support and government engagement the company receives in the U.S. market

- Develop and lead Rocket Lab's government affairs strategy in Germany and across Europe, ensuring alignment with corporate priorities and business development objectives

- Build and maintain high‑impact relationships with key German federal stakeholders, including the Bundestag, DLR, Ministry of Defense, and relevant regulatory and executive agencies

- Establish and grow Rocket Lab's presence with government entities and innovation ecosystems in Munich and other strategic European hubs

- Partner closely with the Business Development team to support market expansion, customer engagement, and pursuit of government‑funded programs

- Shape and influence policy discussions related to space, defense, launch, and emerging technologies, ensuring Rocket Lab's interests are represented and understood

- Provide strategic guidance on political, regulatory, and industrial‑policy developments across Europe, identifying opportunities and risks for business

- Represent Rocket Lab in industry associations, working groups, and public‑sector forums to strengthen the company's visibility and credibility

- Drive measurable business outcomes through targeted government engagement not only monitoring policy trends but actively shaping them

- Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on European political dynamics, defense priorities, and government procurement pathways

- 12+ years of experience in government affairs, public policy, defense, aerospace, or related strategic roles within Germany or Europe

- Professional fluency in German and English

- Demonstrated success building and managing relationships with senior government officials, policymakers, and public‑sector institutions

- Proven ability to drive business‑aligned outcomes through government engagement, not solely policy monitoring

- Strong understanding of European political structures, defense priorities, and government procurement processes

- Ability to operate autonomously, set strategy, and execute in a fast‑paced, high‑growth environment

- Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder‑management skills

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE 

- Background in space, aerospace, defense, or dual‑use technology sectors

- Experience working with or within institutions such as DLR, MOD, Bundestag committees, EU defense bodies, or national innovation agencies

- Prior roles in business development, defense industrial policy, or public‑sector consulting

- Experience working in Munich's government, defense, or technology ecosystem

- Familiarity with NATO, EU defense initiatives, and cross‑border industrial‑cooperation frameworks

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas .

WHAT TO EXPECT 

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. title: Product Manager, Homepage
description:
About Wolt 

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

What You'll Be Doing 

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

- Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.

- Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.

- Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.

- Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

What You'll Need to Thrive 

Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

- Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.

- You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.

- You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.

- You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.

- You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.

- You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.

- You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).

- You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. 

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: DSP Engineer - Werkstudent
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good. 

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

This is a hands-on opportunity to apply what you're learning about signal processing to a real product that keeps people and critical infrastructure safe. As a Working Student on our RF Engineering team in Kassel, you'll work alongside experienced DSP engineers — prototyping algorithms, analyzing real RF captures, and building the tooling that helps us detect and classify drones in the wild. You'll grow your practical DSP and software skills on real-world data, with mentorship and room to take ownership of meaningful pieces of work.

What You'll Do

Work Location: This role is based out of our Kassel office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.
Reports to: Team Lead

- Help prototype, implement, and test DSP algorithms in Python and C++.

- Analyze recorded RF / I/Q captures and help characterize drone and controller signals.

- Build and improve scripts and tooling for signal analysis, data handling, and visualization.

- Run experiments and document results to support detection and classification work.

What You Bring

- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

- Coursework or project experience in DSP fundamentals (e.g., sampling, filtering, FFT/spectral analysis, modulation).

- Programming experience in Python and/or C++.

- Genuine curiosity about RF / wireless and signal processing, and an eagerness to learn on real data.

- Good communication skills in English; German is a plus.

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes 

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions. 

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment. 

We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at Axon Privacy Web Form . For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice. 

Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment. 

We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. title: Senior Test Automation Engineer
description:
About Keyfactor 

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor! 

Title: Senior Test Automation Engineer

Location: Aachen, Germany (Hybrid work model)

Job Function: Engineering 

Employment Type: Full-Time

Industry: Computer Network & Security

About the position 

The Senior Test Automation Engineer is responsible for developing and maintaining automated test scripts for critical product features. This role involves leading automation efforts, troubleshooting test failures, and optimizing test coverage.

RESPONSIBILITIES 

- Develop and maintain automated test scripts for critical product features. 

- Lead automation efforts for specific projects, ensuring efficient and effective test coverage. 

- Troubleshoot and resolve issues with automated test scripts and frameworks. 

- Collaborate with development and QA teams to integrate automated testing into the development process. 

- Monitor and report on the performance of automated tests and recommend improvements. 

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of automation processes and tools. 

- Mentor junior automation engineers in best practices and tools. 

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS 

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent experience. 

- Strong experience in test automation or software development with a focus on testing. 

- Strategic thinking, exceptional problem-solving abilities, high-level proficiency in relevant tools and technologies.

- Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, experience with scripting languages, and problem-solving abilities.

- Ability to lead complex projects, drive strategic initiatives, and influence decision-making.

- Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, mentor junior engineers, and optimize automation processes.

- Extensive knowledge of industry trends, company strategy, and cross-functional processes.

- Understanding of scripting languages, test automation frameworks, and CI/CD integration. #LI-NA1 

Compensation 

Salary will be commensurate with experience.  

Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits 

We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas.  

Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special:   

- Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.

- Comprehensive benefit coverage globally.

- Paid Parental Leave is available to new parents. Structure varies based on regional/government requirements. In regions where government-paid leave doesn’t exist, like in the U.S., the company offers generous paid parental leave, along with comprehensive adoption and fertility support. 

- Competitive time off globally.

- Dedicated employee-focused ambassadors via Key Contributors & Culture Committees. 

- DIVERSE Commitment, a call to action for a more inclusive and diverse future in business, society, and technology. 

- The Keyfactor Alliance Program to support DEIB efforts. 

- Wellbeing resources, wellness allowance, mindfulness app free membership, Wellness Wednesdays. 

- Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off.

- Monthly Talent development and Cross Functional meetings to support professional development. 

- Regular All Hands meetings – followed by group gatherings. 

Our Core Values 

Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:  

Trust is paramount.    

We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.   

Customers are core.    

We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own.   

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates.    

The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.   

We deliver with agility .     

We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals.   

United by respect .     

Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities.   

Teams make “it” happen.    

Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one.   

Keyfactor is a proud equal opportunity employer including but not limited to veterans and individuals with disabilities.

title: Senior RFP & Bid Manager, EMEA
description:
About Keyfactor 

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor! 

Title : Senior RFP & Bid Manager, EMEA 

Location : Stockholm, Sweden; Aachen, Germany; Barcelona or Madrid, Spain; United Kingdom

Experience : Senior

Job Function : Revenue Operations

Employment Type : Full-Time

Industry : Computer and Network Security 

About the position 

The Senior RFP & Bid Manager, EMEA is responsible for establishing, managing, and continuously improving the RFP, RFI, and tender response management framework across Keyfactor's EMEA sales organization. Operating as a specialized individual contributor, the role owns the operational processes, governance standards, tools, and knowledge management practices required to support effective and consistent bid responses.

The position coordinates the end-to-end RFP response process, working closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, and other relevant departments to obtain required inputs, manage timelines and dependencies, and facilitate accurate, complete, and timely submissions. The role applies specialized knowledge of bid management practices and procurement procedures to identify operational risks, recommend appropriate response approaches, and drive improvements in process effectiveness and efficiency. 

As part of a newly established function, the role develops scalable operating practices and documentation to support the continued development of RFP management capabilities within EMEA and potential future adoption in other regions.

This position can be based out of our offices in following locations and we have a hybrid work model: Stockholm (Sweden), Barcelona or Madrid (Spain), Aachen, Germany or United Kingdom. 

Responsibilities 

- Own and continuously improve the EMEA RFP and bid management operating framework , establishing standardized intake procedures, response workflows, submission controls, and governance practices to ensure consistent and effective execution across the region.

- Coordinate the end-to-end execution of complex RFP, RFI, and tender responses , working closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and other relevant functions to obtain required inputs, manage timelines and dependencies, and ensure timely, accurate, and complete submissions.

- Develop and continuously improve bid management methodologies and standards , identifying operational inefficiencies, evaluating improvement opportunities, and implementing solutions to enhance response quality, turnaround time, and cross-functional effectiveness.

- Apply specialized knowledge of public and private tender procedures , assessing procedural requirements, identifying submission risks, and providing guidance to internal stakeholders on appropriate response processes while escalating matters requiring legal, compliance, or commercial decisions to the relevant functions.

- Establish and govern a centralized RFP content and knowledge management framework , including the administration of Loopio and approved supporting tools, ensuring content accuracy, consistency, currency, and appropriate validation by relevant subject-matter experts.

- Facilitate effective cross-functional collaboration throughout the bid response process , coordinating contributions from Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product Management, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Professional Services, and ensuring that dependencies, responsibilities, and escalation requirements are clearly communicated.

- Exercise independent professional judgment in managing RFP response activities , determining when approved content can be used, identifying requirements for additional specialist input, and escalating complex or sensitive matters to the appropriate accountable stakeholders.

- Coordinate the review and validation of technical, security, service-related, and contractual information included in bid responses , ensuring that product capabilities, roadmap statements, security representations, implementation commitments, and service deliverables are reviewed and approved by the relevant authorized functions prior to submission.

- Serve as the primary operational point of contact for customer procurement representatives and external bid management partners , coordinating procedural clarifications, submission requirements, joint-bid activities, and response logistics while involving Sales and other relevant stakeholders in substantive customer discussions.

- Develop and maintain RFP management performance reporting , monitoring submission volumes, turnaround times, response quality, content effectiveness, and relevant bid outcomes, analyzing operational trends, and recommending process improvements to Revenue Operations and Sales leadership.

- Provide specialized functional guidance to internal stakeholders on bid management practices , supporting the consistent application of established workflows, tender procedures, governance standards, and RFP management tools across the EMEA sales organization.

- Develop and maintain scalable bid management documentation and implementation playbooks , establishing repeatable methodologies and operating practices that support the ongoing development of the EMEA function and potential future adoption in other regions.

Minimum Qualifications, Education, and Skills 

Minimum Education 

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Minimum Knowledge & Job Experience 

- Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in RFP management, proposal management, bid management, or a closely related function, preferably within B2B software or technology environments.

- Demonstrated experience coordinating complex RFPs, RFIs, and tenders involving multiple internal functions and external stakeholders.

- Proven experience establishing, improving, or governing structured bid response processes, including standardized workflows, content management practices, and operational procedures.

- Strong working knowledge of public and private procurement processes, including open, restricted, negotiated, and competitive dialogue procedures.

- Experience identifying procedural and operational risks and coordinating their resolution with relevant internal subject-matter experts.

title: Senior Specialist / Manager, AI Safety Data and Evaluation Program
description:
Your Impact at LILA 

We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems.

High-quality safety depends on the right expertise, consistent and repeatable workflows and high levels of interpretability. At Lila Sciences, you will turn scientific risk questions into well-run expert-data and evaluation programs to build this evidence-base.

You will bring a strong working understanding of AI safety and scientific misuse risks to connect internal risk mapping and threat modeling with expertise across Lila and external specialists. Your primary responsibilities will be program execution and data quality: organizing contributors, running red-teaming and evaluation campaigns, and ensuring their outputs meet agreed standards. You will also be responsible for gathering targeted high-impact feedback from partners in the AI Safety community on our different aspects of our approach to Safety. You will work closely with scientists who frame the research questions and interpret their significance, while creating the operational conditions for their expertise to have an impact. Ultimately, you will play a key role in generating the evidence that informs safety decisions made by senior leadership at Lila.

What You'll Be Building 

- Translate agreed scientific briefs into executable plans covering tasks, contributor needs, instructions, milestones, quality standards and delivery expectations.

- Source and coordinate external experts with scientific colleagues, and organize access to relevant expertise within Lila.

- Manage contributor onboarding, task assignment, training and support so specialists can contribute effectively and consistently.

- Run expert-data collection, annotation, red-teaming and evaluation programs, tracking progress and resolving delivery problems.

- Establish quality controls covering completeness, consistency, provenance and adherence to rubrics; coordinate calibration, review, disagreement resolution and rework with scientific owners.

- Maintain clear records, versioned guidance and usable datasets, and improve workflows based on quality findings and researcher feedback.

- Identify questions that require scientific judgment and bring them to the appropriate specialists, ensuring decisions are reflected in program materials and subsequent work.

What You'll Need to Succeed 

- Experience delivering expert-data, research-operations, evaluation or similarly demanding programs involving specialist contributors.

- A substantial working understanding of AI safety, including how threat models, capability evaluations, red teaming and safeguards inform one another. You should be able to interpret a safety research brief, recognize its assumptions and the consequences of data-quality failures, and identify when a question needs scientific escalation.

- Evidence of applying this safety understanding in research, evaluation or expert-data work, including how it shaped the scoping, execution or review of a program.

- Strong operational judgment and the ability to manage dependencies, changing requirements and several parallel workstreams.

- A track record of setting measurable quality standards, detecting recurring problems and improving the processes that produce data.

- Clear communication, careful documentation and the ability to build effective relationships with researchers, experts and vendors.

- Sufficient technical and scientific fluency to understand research briefs, clarify ambiguity and work productively with subject-matter experts.

Bonus Points For 

- Experience contributing to scientific study design, assessing scientific validity or developing evaluation rubrics.

- Deeper scientific expertise or research experience in biology, chemistry or materials science.

- Data analysis, scripting, annotation platforms or tools for tracking research workflows and data provenance.

Compensation 

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

$88,000 — $144,000 USD

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

title: Sr Software Engineer, Ads Auctions & Marketplace Optimization
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV 

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What does the team work on? 

Roku is the No. 1 TV streaming platform in the US, Canada and Mexico, with more than 100 million active accounts. Every ad impression across that platform has to be cleared and priced in real time — that is what the Ads Auctions and Marketplace Optimization team does. We build the auction mechanics, the pricing and pacing logic, and the low-latency systems that run them, balancing outcomes for advertisers, publishers, viewers, and Roku on every request. We are growing the team in Cambridge, which is becoming its largest hub, alongside colleagues in Amsterdam, Austin, San Jose, Ukraine and Uruguay — so you would be shaping how the UK side of this team works rather than inheriting it.

What is the role? 

You will build the systems that apply mathematical and algorithmic rigour to optimise across multiple objectives, deciding which ads get served, in which placements, and when. The work spans auction mechanics, optimisation, the output of predictive ML models, and the real-time infrastructure underneath, mostly in Java on the JVM. It is hands-on and senior in scope: expect to move between whiteboard-level design and production code in the same week, and to own problems from framing through rollout. You will work directly with the hiring manager and a small group of senior engineers, in codebases shared with other ads engineers, on problems where your decisions are visible in revenue. You will optimise for second-order effects in a marketplace where participants react to each other, and to us, in real time. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic about solving these kinds of problems.

How will I use AI at Roku? 

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.

We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.

What are the responsibilities of the role? 

- Design and build components of Roku's real-time ad auction and marketplace systems

- Own the multi-objective optimisation at the core of the auction, balancing what advertisers, publishers, viewers, and Roku each want from the same impression

- Own development work end to end, from framing the problem through production rollout

- Build and operate JVM services where latency and reliability are product requirements, not stretch goals

- Use probability, statistics and experimentation to test changes before and after launch

- Work with AI tooling as a normal part of how you design, build, test and review

- Explain technical trade-offs clearly to engineering and cross-functional partners

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku? 

- Around six or more years building production software, with strong systems judgement

- Production experience in Java or another JVM language, or depth in a comparable statically typed language such as C#, C++ or Go, and the appetite to ramp on Java

- Comfort designing and operating distributed systems at scale and low latency

- A solid grounding in maths, algorithms, probability and statistics as applied to real systems

- Demonstrated AI and agentic-tooling fluency, as described above

- Ad tech, auctions or marketplace experience is preferred, and we move quickly for candidates who have it

- Comparable experience on mathematically rigorous or optimisation-heavy problems in another domain is an acceptable alternative

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits? 

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. Accommodations 

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to 

What should I know about Roku's culture? 

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

title: Assembly and Test Technician
description:
LOCATION: CALMSDEN, CIRENCESTER, UK. LIMITED FIELD TRAVEL AS REQUIRED | 5 DAYS ONSITE

THE LAST FRONTIER 

ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist.

Our solution is autonomy.

We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.

Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk.

THE ROLE 

ARD is growing and we’re looking for an Assembly and Test Technician to help us build and test our ruggedized hardware - from field-ready energy and battery systems to the autonomous platforms we deploy in the Arctic. Right now, our biggest constraint isn’t design. It’s the time it takes to assemble and test what we’ve designed.

Reporting to our Senior Test Engineer , you’ll join our engineering team, working alongside our mechanical and electrical engineers and across our main hardware workstreams. You’ll take hands-on ownership of assembly and testing, helping with the practical implementation and testing of engineering designs. Within your first 3 months, you’ll have helped to take assembly and test off the critical path on our key projects, and helped put in place the documentation and test processes that let us build and test consistently, unit after unit.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES 

- Assemble mechanical and electrical sub-assemblies, harnesses, PCBAs, and complete units to drawings and build instructions, so they’re ready for test on schedule.

- Run test phases on assemblies and finished units and record the results accurately, so issues are found and fixed before hardware reaches the field.

- Help set up repeatable test processes, from test plans and rigs to how results are captured, working closely with our Senior Test Engineer.

- Write and maintain build instructions, test procedures and records, raising the standard of our engineering documentation as we scale.

- Spot and report problems found during build and test, giving engineers the detail they need to debug and improve the next design revision.

REQUIREMENTS 

About You 

You’re a practical, hands-on technician who takes pride in building things properly and getting the details right. You’re methodical, you like a clear process, and you’d rather write something down than rely on memory. You might come from a technician role in engineering, manufacturing or a test lab, an engineering apprenticeship, the armed forces, or a mechanical or electrical engineering degree with plenty of hands-on build experience.

* Please note: this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship *

Essential 

- An engineering qualification (such as an HNC/HND, apprenticeship or degree in mechanical or electrical engineering), or equivalent hands-on experience.

- Hands-on experience assembling mechanical or electrical hardware in a workshop, lab or production setting.

- Experience with basic soldering equipment

- Ability to work from engineering drawings, schematics and written build instructions.

- Experience running tests on hardware and recording the results accurately.

- Confident using common workshop tools and electrical test equipment, such as multimeters and bench power supplies.

- Comfortable owning your own tasks with guidance from the engineering team, and raising problems early when a build or test doesn’t go to plan.

Desirable 

- Experience writing or improving build instructions, test procedures or other technical documentation.

- Experience with electrical assembly such as wiring looms, crimping or soldering, or working with battery systems.

- Experience building hardware in small batches or repeat runs, rather than one-off prototypes.

- Experience with surface-mount PCB assembly

Future Security Clearance Requirements 

- As our business scales into the defence and security sectors, the responsibilities of this role are expected to evolve to include projects requiring UK Security Check (SC) clearance .

- While an active clearance is not required to apply or start in this role, candidates must be willing and eligible to undergo UK Government security vetting in the future should project requirements dictate it.

- To meet the standard eligibility criteria for UK standard SC vetting, you must typically have resided in the UK for the past 5 continuous years , hold a valid passport, and be capable of passing comprehensive background, financial, and criminal record checks.

Why ARD 

The mission - The Arctic is the fastest-changing region on Earth. You'll build the intelligence layer that helps understand and steward it — an early-warning system for the planet's coldest edge.

Early stage, real influence - ARD is at an exciting early stage. You'll join while our products, team and culture are still taking shape, and your ideas will directly influence where we go next.

Ownership and accountability - We give people real responsibility from day one. You'll own your work end to end, be trusted to make decisions, and be accountable for delivering results that ship and get used.

A small but growing team - You'll work closely with experienced colleagues across science, software and hardware, with no layers in between. As we grow, you'll help build the team and the ways of working that come next.

WHAT WE OFFER 

- Competitive compensation

- Private Health Insurance from Day 1

- Dental & Vision

- Equity - meaningful options as an early employee at an early-stage company

- Real field exposure - travel to Arctic sites and Outposts when needed

- Mission-driven culture - focus on impact, not hours logged

ARD is an equal opportunities employer. We hire on merit, based on skills, experience and potential, and welcome applications from everyone regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. We know great candidates sometimes hold back unless they tick every box, so if this role excites you but your experience doesn’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you, especially if you bring a background or perspective that is under-represented in science and engineering.

If you need any adjustments during the application or interview process, please don't hesitate to let us know at
