The Role: 

We're looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial Sales Director to take our Scout and Ranger platforms to data buyers across EMEA and APAC: hedge funds, asset managers, private equity firms and the fast-growing world of AI. This is a pure new business role, and you'll own your territory end to end, from spotting the opportunity through to signing the deal.

Partnering directly with our Chief Revenue Officer, you'll play an important part in refining how we approach the EMEA and APAC data buyer markets, identifying opportunities for growth, developing repeatable sales practices, and laying the foundations for an expanded European sales team.

You'll be the face of Neudata in front of some of the most sophisticated investors in the market, running story-led demonstrations, guiding hands-on trials alongside our research analysts, and building relationships with the people who decide how their firms use external data.

We encourage applications from high-performing Sales Reps looking to take on greater ownership and responsibility in a fast-growing organisation. There is potential for the successful candidate to take on a leadership role over time. 

Your Key Responsibilities: 

- Own the EMEA and Asia-Pacific territory of institutional investor prospects, driving new business through proactive outreach, travelling to meet prospects in-person, and lead generation campaigns across email and socials

- Run the full sales cycle: leading discovery and qualification calls, delivering value-based, story-led demonstrations of Scout and Ranger, then negotiating commercial terms and closing in line with quota

Title : Senior RFP & Bid Manager, EMEA

About the position 

The Senior RFP & Bid Manager, EMEA is responsible for establishing, managing, and continuously improving the RFP, RFI, and tender response management framework across Keyfactor's EMEA sales organization. The position coordinates the end-to-end RFP response process, working closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, and other relevant departments to obtain required inputs, manage timelines and dependencies, and facilitate accurate, complete, and timely submissions. The role applies specialized knowledge of bid management practices and procurement procedures to identify operational risks, recommend appropriate response approaches, and drive improvements in process effectiveness and efficiency. 

As part of a newly established function, the role develops scalable operating practices and documentation to support the continued development of RFP management capabilities within EMEA and potential future adoption in other regions.

This position can be based out of our offices in following locations and we have a hybrid work model: Stockholm (Sweden), Barcelona or Madrid (Spain), Aachen, Germany or United Kingdom.

- Develop and continuously improve bid management methodologies and standards , identifying operational inefficiencies, evaluating improvement opportunities, and implementing solutions to enhance response quality, turnaround time, and cross-functional effectiveness.

description:

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 million de TPE/PME et plus de 8000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ? 

L’un des atouts majeurs de Pennylane aujourd’hui est son réseau de partenaires revendeurs.

Le Partner marketing specialist a un rôle essentiel dans le développement de notre écosystème partenaires en pilotant notre stratégie marketing via nos partenaires revendeurs (intégrateurs). Il a pour objectif de générer des leads qualifiés et de renforcer notre position de leader dans la gestion financière.
En collaboration étroite avec notre équipe partenariat et les partner account managers, ce rôle implique la conception et le déploiement de campagnes de co-marketing innovantes. L'objectif est de créer des synergies durables qui alimentent notre croissance tout en maximisant la visibilité de notre proposition de valeur unique.
Le succès de cette mission repose sur une approche méthodique combinant la génération d'opportunités commerciales, le développement de relations partenaires privilégiées et l'exécution de campagnes marketing à fort impact mesurable.

Missions

- Gérer les relations avec les équipes marketing des partenaires, en assurant une communication efficace et en identifiant de nouvelles opportunités de collaboration.

- Élaborer et gérer des campagnes de co-marketing, y compris des webinaires, des événements, des contenus partagés, etc.

- Suivre et analyser les performances des campagnes pour optimiser les stratégies et assurer un retour sur investissement positif.

- Collaborer avec les équipes internes (partenariats, marketing, sales, product marketing) pour aligner les initiatives marketing avec les objectifs commerciaux de Pennylane.

- Former et accompagner les partenaires sur les supports marketing disponibles

Profil recherché

- Une première expérience en marketing BtoB SaaS avec animation de partenaires

- Communication en interne et en externe

- Maitrise des outils marketing

- Bonne gestion de projet

- Maitrise de l’anglais professionnel

- Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles

- Capacité à travailler en équipe

- Autonomie

- Proactivité

- Sens de l’organisation

- Formation supérieure en marketing et/ou commerce, niveau Bac +5

- Expérience demandée : 3 ans

- Connaissance du monde des partenariats revendeurs et logiciels

- Use case et debriefing avec Maxime, CMO, & Anne-Sophie, Team Lead Partner Marketing - Remote

- Team fit avec l’équipe - Présentiel ou Remote

- Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

- Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

- Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

title: Senior ML Engineer | Kimchi (Inference Stack Optimization)
description:
Why Kimchi?

Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. We started inside CAST AI helping companies run LLMs on their own Kubernetes clusters; today we run our own coding harness on any model you pick, and we run the models underneath it ourselves.

Kimchi Inference 

One API line and a customer's existing client just works: DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Nemotron served serverless from our own GPU fleet (OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, pay per token, spend visible per user, team, and key). When control matters, the same models run on the customer's own cluster instead. Behind that one line sits the machinery you'll own: SGLang and vLLM engines, B300 nodes, a shared cluster filesystem that holds every checkpoint exactly once, KV caches riding coding traffic with heavy prefix reuse, and the benchmark harness that gates every change we ship.

About the role

Throughput. Latency. Cold starts. Cost per token.

Responsibilities

title: Ingénieur R&D Conception d'équipements d’essais (H/F)
description:
Ingénieur R&D Conception d'équipements d’essais (H/F) 

À propos de notre client 

Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux.

Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE.

Le poste 

Pour accélérer ses projets de développement, notre client recrute un(e) Ingénieur(e) R&D en conception d'équipements d'essais. Vous prendrez en charge la conception, la mise au point et la validation de cellules d'essais haute température et haute pression, un sujet stratégique pour l'entreprise et ses clients.

Rattaché(e) à la direction des opérations, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe qui conçoit aujourd'hui les équipements et dépose les brevets de l'entreprise.

Répartition indicative du temps : environ 70 à 80 % conception et développement, 20 à 30 % laboratoire (montage et validation de vos équipements).

Dans une structure à taille humaine, vous suivrez vos développements de la conception jusqu'aux tests, avant leur transfert à l'équipe de production.

Vos missions 

Conception et développement d'équipements d’essais

- Concevoir de nouvelles cellules et de nouveaux dispositifs d'essais, notamment pour des conditions de haute température et de haute pression.
- Résoudre les problématiques techniques associées : instrumentation et capteurs, étanchéité, tenue en température et en pression.
- Consulter les fournisseurs et sous-traitants, et suivre la fabrication des pièces.
- Améliorer les équipements existants, notamment leur ergonomie et leur facilité d'utilisation en production.
Mise au point et validation

- Monter les équipements développés et réaliser leurs tests de validation au laboratoire.
- Interpréter les résultats expérimentaux et vérifier leur cohérence.
- Transférer les équipements validés à l'équipe de production et l'accompagner dans leur prise en main.
Documentation et propriété intellectuelle

- Rédiger la documentation technique, les rapports et les comptes-rendus, et les présenter, en français comme en anglais.
- Participer à la veille technique et à la rédaction des documents de protection (brevets, enveloppes Soleau).
Vie du laboratoire

- Comprendre les essais réalisés au laboratoire pour concevoir des équipements adaptés à leurs besoins.
- Contribuer à l'activité du labo et à l'amélioration continue, dans le respect de la démarche qualité ISO 9001.
Requirements 

Compétences techniques

- Conception mécanique et maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO.
- Instrumentation, capteurs et techniques de mesure.
- Compréhension des grandeurs physiques et physico-chimiques.
- Rédaction technique et anglais professionnel, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

Savoir-être

- Autonomie et capacité à prendre en main un sujet de bout en bout.
- Rigueur, notamment dans les phases d'essais.
- Polyvalence et goût du concret : vous aimez concevoir autant que tester vous-même vos équipements.
- Communication proactive, en particulier pour remonter et résoudre les difficultés rencontrées.
- Envie d'apprendre et de s'investir dans une petite structure.

Formation et expérience

- Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent Bac +5 en génie mécanique, conception, instrumentation ou mesures physiques.
- Expérience d'environ 5 ans en conception d'équipements, en bureau d'études ou en R&D. Les profils plus juniors avec une première expérience significative en conception seront étudiés.
- Une expérience sur des équipements soumis à des contraintes de température ou de pression est un vrai plus.
Benefits 

Vous rejoindrez une entreprise à taille humaine où chaque développement compte : vos équipements seront directement utilisés pour des projets de R&D menés pour des clients internationaux. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe dynamique et multiculturelle, sur des sujets techniques exigeants au service des énergies du sous-sol et de la transition énergétique.

description:
The MongoDB Query Execution Team is hiring software engineers who want to join us in developing a high performing, reliable and modular distributed query system. Our engineers work on implementing and maintaining execution algorithms, building new query language features, tuning database performance, and more to power our customers' critical workloads.

This role can be based remotely in France.

Position Expectations

- Understand and improve current functionality of the MongoDB query engine

- Contribute high quality C++ code and give and solicit feedback in code reviews

- Identify, design, implement, test, and support new features related to query performance and robustness, query language enhancements, diagnostics for query performance problems, and integration with other products and tools

- Work constructively with peers to deliver excellent technical solutions

Candidate Profile

- 5+ years of experience in systems programming

- Experience in databases and/or data management systems is a huge plus, but not a requirement

- Hands-on experience building industrial-strength software

- Solid computer science fundamentals, with strong competencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design/architecture

- Experience with large code bases, preferably in C++, C, Rust or a similar compiled language

- B.Sc in Computer Science or similar field, or equivalent practical experience

- Interest in the theory and practice of database query engines. Hands-on experience or M.Sc./Ph.D in the domain is a plus

Success Measures

- In three months you’ll have contributed to the development of a project slated for the next major version, as well as fixed a few bugs in a minor version of our latest stable release series

- In six months, you’ll have taken on code review responsibilities and are independently delivering complex functionality and squashing bugs independently

- In twelve months, you’re leading the development of a new major feature and are helping to mentor new engineers on the team

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world!

description:

As an Accountant, you will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records and supporting the accounting operations of German entities within an international software group. You will oversee day-to-day accounting activities, contribute to month-end and year-end closing processes, and ensure compliance with German accounting standards and tax regulations. Working closely with the finance team, external tax advisors, and payroll providers, you will help deliver reliable financial reporting and maintain strong internal controls. You will also contribute to budgeting, variance analysis, and financial performance monitoring to support informed business decisions. This fully remote opportunity offers a hands-on environment where you can improve existing processes, bring structure to financial operations, and take ownership of meaningful responsibilities. It is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented accounting professional seeking to grow within an international, entrepreneurial, and collaborative team.

Accountabilities: 

- Manage day-to-day accounting activities for German legal entities, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely financial records.

- Support month-end and year-end closing procedures, including journal entries, accounting adjustments, and financial analysis.

- Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and support the review of account balances to ensure accuracy and completeness.

title: Junior Data & Automation Engineer
description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning 

Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time. 

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario. 

With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software. 

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you. 

The Data & Automations Team

The Data & Automations team builds and operates Pigment's internal data platform, and designs, implements, and maintains the intelligent automation solutions that rely on it. Together, they streamline business processes and enhance data-driven decision making: we empower product, business and corporate functions through technology integration, robust data architecture, and process optimization, enabling teams to focus on high-value activities while ensuring accuracy and scalability.

The data platform is the foundation of everything we deliver. It is a centralized, governed ecosystem that collects, stores, transforms, and serves data to internal consumers across Product, Go-To-Market (GTM), and General & Administrative (G&A) functions, providing a single source of truth for analytics, automations, and AI. Making it reliable, secure, cost-efficient, and scalable is at the core of our mission. The team also consolidates and orchestrates AI efforts across Pigment, from governance and enablement to building AI-powered solutions.

Our team tackles diverse challenges, from integrating finance and HR systems and streamlining employee lifecycle processes, to building pipelines that turn product usage and customer interactions into actionable insights for Finance or GTM teams. AI is now at the center of most of what we do with data: many of our pipelines feed LLM-powered solutions, and the quality, structure, and governance of our data architecture directly determine what these solutions can deliver.

The team is led by Pigment's Deputy CISO and works closely with the Security team: security and data governance are part of how we build, not an afterthought.

Role

As a Junior Data and Automations Engineer, you will contribute to the continued development of Pigment's data platform: ingestion pipelines, dbt models, orchestration, data quality, and the underlying cloud infrastructure. You will also build and maintain the data pipelines, automations, and AI projects that support our G&A (Finance, People, IT) and GTM (Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships) teams.

You will work closely with senior engineers, starting with well-scoped tasks and progressively taking ownership of small projects end to end, from requirements gathering to production monitoring. This role involves collaborating with a wide range of internal stakeholders and requires excellent communication skills in English (primarily) and French, verbal and written.

Tech environment

Our core stack relies on Google Cloud Platform, maintained with Terraform, with components including BigQuery, Cloud Run, and Cloud Composer (Airflow), as well as dbt, Fivetran, Hightouch, Elementary for data observability, and Python for integrations and automations. Our pipelines connect business systems such as Salesforce, NetSuite, our HRIS, Gong, or Slack, and feed Pigment applications used by our own business teams. We also build LLM-powered pipelines and use AI tools in our daily engineering work.

You will have the opportunity to learn and grow your skills across these technologies while making a meaningful impact on Pigment's operational efficiency.

Under the supervision of the Data & Automations team's more senior members, you will participate in addressing the following topics.

Data Platform & Infrastructure: 

- Develop and maintain ingestion pipelines from APIs, databases, and SaaS tools, using Fivetran, Airflow, and Python

- Build and maintain dbt models that turn raw data into clean, documented, and tested datasets

- Contribute to the evolution of our orchestration, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code setup

- Help improve data quality, observability, and alerting across the platform

G&A and GTM Data Pipelines & Automations: 

- Build pipelines and integrations that sync data between business systems (CRM, ERP, HRIS) through our data warehouse, including reverse ETL with Hightouch

- Develop Python-based automations that remove manual work for teams such as Finance, People, IT, and Customer Success

- Prepare reliable datasets for reporting and for the Pigment applications used by business teams

AI Projects: 

- Contribute to AI-powered solutions, such as LLM pipelines that extract, classify, and enrich unstructured data (call transcripts, messages, tickets)

- Build the data foundations these projects rely on: AI-ready datasets, usage and observability data, evaluation data

- Apply data architecture principles that make our data reliable, well-documented, and safely accessible for AI use cases (context, retrieval, access scoping)

Monitoring & Support: 

- Monitor pipelines and automations, troubleshoot incidents, and fix root causes

- Document data models, pipelines, and processes for both technical and business readers

Collaboration & Learning:

- Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing sessions

- Continuously expand your knowledge of data engineering, automation, and AI best practices

Automation Development:

- Implement integrations between various systems and applications using APIs and other connection methods

- Assist in maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automation projects

Data Integration & Transformation:

- Troubleshoot and resolve issues with existing automation solutions

- Continuously expand knowledge of data engineering and automation best practices

- Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing sessions

Who you are

Technical skills

The ideal candidate will possess most or all of the following qualifications. Hands-on experience through personal projects (share your GitHub account!), particularly contributions to open source initiatives, will be valued equally to professional and academic experience for this role.

- Up to 3 years of relevant experience in data engineering, including apprenticeships, internships, and/or demonstrable personal projects

Soft skills

Nice to have

You'll report to Yanis , Head of Engineering, but don't expect micro-management. Yanis grew from Lead Engineer to Head of Engineering over 4 years at Qonto.

- Our primary languages are Go and Ruby , ReactJS for frontend, and Kotlin and Swift for our mobile apps.

title: Senior Creative Designer
description:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers. 

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a certified B Corp , we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries —from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.

We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn , backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

The role 

We’re looking for a Senior Creative Designer to join our Brand team in Paris. You’ll help build a brand that is understood, remembered and trusted, making a powerful product feel simple, human and desirable. As part of our creative team, you’ll shape Brevo’s visual identity, content and digital presence across every channel and market. We believe great design starts with great thinking, so we question the brief, look for the sharpest idea and make sure it holds across every touchpoint.

Your impact at Brevo 

- Contribute to the evolution of Brevo's visual identity and brand guidelines, ensuring consistency across every touchpoint, from paid ads to event signage.

- Design marketing and communication assets for product launches and campaigns, adapting concepts across channels, formats and markets (digital, social media, OOH, events, print).

- Produce social-first content, including video, motion and short-form, for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok and X, tailored to each platform's codes.

- Build content plans that combine organic, paid and evergreen content, then measure performance and keep improving.

- Translate complex product features into simple, engaging messages for different audiences and markets.

- Partner with Growth, Product, Sales and Leadership to align creative work with business objectives.

- Experiment with new formats and AI-powered creative tools, and bring what works into the team's workflow.

Who you are 

- Around 6 years of experience in creative, brand or content design, ideally in an agency, startup or SaaS/tech company, with a strong portfolio of brand, content and digital work.

- You think before you design: you take the time to understand the product, challenge briefs constructively and turn complex ideas into clear visual stories.

- You have a solid understanding of B2B communication, paid campaigns, social media best practices and storytelling.

- You’re comfortable with AI creative tools (Midjourney, Runway, Kling, Claude…)

- You're fluent in Figma (mandatory, including design systems) Adobe suite.

- You're autonomous and organised, juggle several projects at once and take ownership from idea to execution.

- You communicate in professional English (C1 or above).

- Bonus points if you have B2C experience, speak French.

If you don't meet all the requirements above but believe this opportunity matches your expectations and experience, we still encourage you to apply! 

Why people love working at Brevo 

- A place to grow, together: Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighborhood.

- Practical perks for everyday balance: RTT days off, 50% public transport reimbursement, Sustainable Mobility Package (whether you ride a classic bike or go electric, we support your choice to commute greener) and daily Swile meal vouchers (€12.50/day).

- Learning, every step of the way: Access to English classes and 155,000+ courses on Udemy, plus a strong internal culture of knowledge-sharing and support.

- Flexible for life: A remote-friendly setup, budget to support your home workspace, and relocation assistance for international talents.

- Wellbeing that works: Top-notch private healthcare (70% covered), 6-week second-parent leave, extra time off if your child is sick and needs you, and several services related to prevention, health and personal and professional well-being on Welii platform

- A culture that cares: From inter-office trips to regular team events, there are plenty of ways to connect beyond your day-to-day. You'll also find active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, plus Work Council benefits via Leeto, all here to support what matters to you, inside and outside of work.

Our candidate journey 

- Introductory TA call (30 min)

- Meeting and Portfolio review with Rémi, Senior Brand & Com Director. (40 min)

- Creative case study (4–5 hours of work) and presentation (45 min)

- Final interview with our CMO (30 min)

- Reference check 

Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Technical Support & Operations Engineer
description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. 

Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions 

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 

About the Role 

As part of the continued growth of our activities and the deployment of our photonic Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) to international customers, we are looking for a Technical Support & Operations Technician / Engineer to join our team.

You will contribute to the operational monitoring of Quandela's QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites , ensuring their proper operation and supporting maintenance activities, both remotely and on site.

Working at the interface between Quandela's technical teams and system users, you will develop a broad understanding of our products, particularly the interactions between hardware equipment and software control interfaces. You will perform initial technical investigations when issues arise and involve the relevant technical experts when required.

The role combines technical support, maintenance, field interventions, training and continuous improvement in a complex and international technological environment.

Internal training will provide you with the specific knowledge required to understand our technology and systems. No previous experience in quantum computing is required. 

As our support and maintenance activities are still being structured, you will also contribute to improving our processes, tools and operational methods.

Your Key Responsibilities: 

System operations & technical support 

You will contribute to maintaining the operational performance and availability of QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites.

- Monitor the operation and performance of installed systems.
- Analyse operational data and identify anomalies or performance degradation.
- Perform initial technical investigations to characterise issues and help determine the appropriate resolution path.
- Follow up on technical incidents and corrective actions with the relevant teams.
- Maintain accurate technical records of systems and interventions.
- Provide remote technical support to customers and trained personnel working on the systems.

Maintenance & customer-site interventions 

You will contribute to the preparation and follow-up of preventive and corrective maintenance activities.

- Track maintenance schedules and anticipate upcoming interventions.
- Identify the resources, equipment, spare parts and technical expertise required for each intervention.
- Perform diagnostic, maintenance and system recovery operations according to established procedures.
- Support technicians and technical experts remotely or on site during interventions.
- Perform functional checks and testing following maintenance activities.
- Track completed actions, outstanding issues and upcoming maintenance requirements.
The role involves business travel within France and internationally , with frequency and duration depending on the needs of our installed systems. 

User training & technical guidance 

You will help customers and technical operators become increasingly autonomous in operating and maintaining our QPUs.

- Train users and technical operators on routine QPU operation and maintenance activities.
- Support users in operating the systems and their control interfaces.
- Share best practices for operation, troubleshooting and maintenance.
- Contribute to the creation and improvement of training materials and technical documentation.

Documentation & continuous improvement 

You will ensure the traceability of technical operations and contribute to structuring our support and maintenance activities.

- Prepare technical monitoring, intervention and maintenance reports.
- Maintain up-to-date technical documentation for installed systems.
- Contribute to writing and improving diagnostic, maintenance and operating procedures.
- Capitalise on field experience to improve reliability and facilitate future interventions.
- Contribute to implementing tools and methods for the structured monitoring of our installed systems.

Requirements 

Education & experience

- Associate's, Bachelor's or Master's degree in instrumentation, applied physics, optoelectronics or a related technical field.
- The position is open to both experienced technicians and engineers with a strong interest in hands-on, operational activities .
- Previous experience in operations, system integration, maintenance or technical support for complex systems is preferred.
- Experience working in a multidisciplinary hardware/software environment is highly valued.
- Experience supporting or maintaining technical equipment installed at customer sites would be an advantage.

Technical skills Required 

- Good understanding of complex technical systems combining hardware and software.
- Knowledge of electronics, instrumentation and/or control systems.
- Ability to analyse operational data and characterise technical issues.
- Ability to perform diagnostic and maintenance operations according to established procedures.
- Ability to identify and involve the appropriate technical experts when required.
- Strong organisational skills and ability to rigorously track interventions, deadlines and outstanding actions.
- Ability to follow, write and improve technical procedures.
- Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken , as you will interact directly with international customers and colleagues, deliver training sessions and produce technical documentation.
- Willingness and ability to travel internationally.
Nice to have

- Knowledge of optics, photonics and/or cryogenics .
- Hands-on experience with optical systems, including basic optical alignment.
- Experience operating or maintaining cryogenic systems.
- Basic programming or scripting skills, particularly Python .
- Experience maintaining scientific or industrial equipment.
- Experience delivering technical training to users or operators.
Benefits 

- Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience 
- Profit-sharing & company savings plan
- 100% health coverage (Alan)
- 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
- Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
- Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer

- A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
- A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
- A hybrid work model (3 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris, 1 to 2 days remotely)
- Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. 
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As part of our broader IT team consisting of over 50 people, you’ll be a part of the IT Hardware team, which looks after IT infrastructure and IT Equipment in all Vinted warehouses across Europe. The team’s aim is to make sure that the whole organization operates securely and efficiently. The IT Hardware team aspires to deliver world-class space for every Vinted employee which does not stop just with the employee desk and computer.

We aim to provide an outstanding experience at every step of the employee journey-from receiving a laptop at home to having an uninterrupted connection in the meeting room at the office. You will work with a team of engineers, as well as different departments and functions, to accomplish your goals and achieve our vision.

Your responsibilities will mainly focus on French warehouses in Paris, Lyon, Lille and future locations IT infrastructure and onsite support services (workstations, network,warehouse IT hardware i.e. handheld devices / scanners / label printers, servers, ), with frequent business trips to our locations across France and possibly Europe and remote support for them.

Please note that this role requires you to work on-site in Vinted's warehouse 3 to 4 days a week. 

In this position, you’ll 

- Manage the lifecycle of IT Hardware equipment across Vinted Go locations across France and Europe: procurement, replacement, repairs, and disposal.

- Ensure that Vinted Go Warehouse IT equipment and services (printers, scanners, audio and video equipment, etc.) is operational

- Support colleagues via ticketing system and internal communication tools on hardware and services-related topics

- Work together with the team to build roadmaps for your area

- Create valuable processes and procedures to help be more efficient, automate dull work

- Handle daily operational activities, spare time for knowledge management and documentation

- Co-create together with different teams, stakeholders, and suppliers to improve our services and implement solutions

About you 

- Have good understanding of IT hardware and software

- Have basic knowledge in Networks (WiFi, LAN)

- Having experience with logistics warehouse IT infrastructure would be an advantage

- You are comfortable traveling across France and Europe for business needs

- Located near Marseille area, as position is mostly on site

- Knowledge of the ITIL best practices or certification would be beneficial

- Working with vendors and stakeholders is in your comfort zone

- You are willing to help our colleagues with their IT struggles

- Uncertainty is your motivation rather than a challenge

- You are willing to learn and support your colleagues in their growth

- You have great written and in-person communication skills

- A good command of written and spoken English and French languages is a must to have

Work perks 

- The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme

- 25 working days of holiday

- Newest MacBook models

- Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family

- Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture

- Co-contribution meal vouchers for each workday through a convenient meal card

- Comprehensive Medical Coverage

- Frequent team-building events

- A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

- A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget 

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Equal opportunity 

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

€44.200 — €59.800 EUR

title: Associate Director/ Director, Sales Force Effectiveness, International
description:
Mavericks Wanted 

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on 
  
In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.  
  
Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work. 

What You’ll Do 

You will report to the Senior Director Commercial Excellence, International and work closely with country General Managers, International commercial functional leads, IT, and Medical Affairs to drive strategic initiatives that support BridgeBio’s mission of delivering transformative medicines to patients with genetic diseases and genetically driven cancers. This newly created role sits where International’s commercial strategy turns into field execution. Your primary purpose will be to build and own Sales Force Effectiveness, the International CRM platform, and key account management from the ground up, with a focus on launch readiness and flawless field execution across International markets. This role requires effective collaboration with cross-functional colleagues and external stakeholders to ensure high-quality execution and impact. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in sales force effectiveness, CRM, and commercial operations with strong communication skills, adaptability, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.

Responsibilities 

- Lead segmentation and targeting, sales force sizing and territory design as the International footprint grows, embedding data-driven insights into resource allocation, and build the Sales Force Effectiveness performance framework, including KPIs, dashboards, and regular reporting

- Design, implement, and administer sales incentive plans in close partnership with Finance, HR, Legal, and Compliance

- Lead the International CRM build and implementation, partnering with IT to deploy a lean, harmonized, fit-for-purpose Veeva Vault solution across markets, and own CRM operations, data stewardship, and adoption through training and change management

- Design AI-enabled field execution support, including next best action insights and recommendations

- Develop and implement the strategic account planning model and build key account management capability in the field, partnering with Medical Affairs and Market Access to expand access at account level

- Serve as a trusted advisor to country General Managers and International functional leads on SFE, CRM, and account management, and support omnichannel customer engagement in partnership with the Customer Engagement Lead

- Support countries building up for launch with SFE, CRM, and field deployment readiness, ensure compliance with regional and local regulations, and build the International Sales Force Effectiveness function from the ground up

Where You’ll Work 

This is an office-based role in our Zug, Switzerland office, requiring in-office collaboration 2-3x per week, with additional travel of up to 20% across International markets to support country teams and launch readiness

Who You Are 

- BA or BS in Business, Life Sciences, or a related field; MBA or other advanced degree/certification preferred

- 10+ years of experience in the Pharmaceutical/Biotech industry, including sales force effectiveness, sales operations, or commercial excellence, and experience directly supporting one or more product launches (specialty or rare disease strongly preferred)

- Demonstrated track record of designing and deploying sales force effectiveness frameworks across multiple markets, experience leading a CRM implementation or major platform roll-out, and experience designing and administering incentive compensation plans

- Strong analytical and data skills, including advanced Excel and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau, and the ability to influence and align senior stakeholders, including country General Managers, without direct authority

- Prior exposure to multiple geographies strongly preferred, with deep expertise in at least one region required

- Fluency in English required; ability to travel up to 20%

T his position is available at Associate Director or Director level, will be determined by the successful candidate’s qualifications and experience. 

Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible 

We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return.

- Market leading compensation

- Hybrid work model - we value your flexibility in how you work, but encourage time in the office to strengthen our culture, collaboration, and sense of community

- We provide career development through regular feedback, continuous education and professional development programs

- We celebrate strong performance with financial rewards, peer-to-peer recognition, and growth opportunities.

As a global company, our comprehensive benefits may vary based on location. We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return. 

For BridgeBio Full-Time U.S Based Roles: 

Financial & Rewards 

- Market-leading compensation 

- 401(k) with employer match 

- Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) 

- Pre-tax commuter benefits (transit and parking) 

- Referral bonus for hired candidates 

- Subsidized lunch and parking on in-office days 

Health & Well-Being 

- 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents 

- Health Savings Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions, plus Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) 

- Fertility & family-forming benefits 

- Expanded mental health support (therapy and coaching resources) 

- Hybrid work model with flexibility 

- Flexible, “take-what-you-need” paid time off and company-paid holidays 

- Comprehensive paid medical and parental leave to care for yourself and your family 

Skill Development & Career Paths: 

- People are part of our growth and success story - from discovery to active drug trials and FDA pipelines, there are endless opportunities for skill development and internal mobility 

- We provide career pathing through regular feedback, continuous education and professional development programs via LinkedIn Learning, LifeLabs, & BetterUp Coaching 

- We celebrate strong performance with financial rewards, peer-to-peer recognition, and growth opportunities

title: Young Graduate in Data and Software Engineering (Zurich, Switzerland)
description:
Who We Are 

Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a fast-growing Swiss AI and data analytics consulting and services company dedicated to solving complex problems of traditional industries like automotive, chemical, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We work with some of the biggest organizations in Europe to solve the challenges that directly affect their business - be it operations, finance, manufacturing or R&D. Since our foundation, we have successfully delivered more than 300 projects and have grown to 190+ talented individuals across 10 office locations.

Unit8’s mission is to drive the adoption of AI and Data Science in the non-digital industries and to help accelerate their digital transformation. Among its activities, Unit8 dedicates a part of its resources and time on projects that deeply matter to us - that includes collaboration on pro-bono and “engineering for good” causes.

Requirements 

What You’ll Do 

Unit8 is welcoming young graduates for the opportunity to grow in Data and Software Engineering! Join us for a 6-month paid professional experience in building industrial Data and AI solutions. You can start asap, with direct exposure to clients' needs and opportunities to participate in learning activities such as Reading Groups and Knowledge Sharing Sessions. In addition, each young graduate will be accompanied by a dedicated wingmate/mentor who will guide and help them build their technical growth vision.

As a young graduate you will join a team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers and Cloud Engineers who work hand-in-hand with our customers on designing and implementing their industry-specific use cases. You will be directly involved in discussing the client’s challenges and needs and will have chances to develop your client-facing skills. You will be responsible for developing, deploying, and automating our AI services and cloud infrastructure. You will also learn to carefully analyse a given problem and apply the relevant tools and techniques to solve it.

In general you will: 

- use software best practices in continuous integration and delivery, versioning and automation;
- use your skills to build and maintain service and data infrastructure;
- participate as junior engineer in all phases of the software development life cycle - planning, implementation, deployment, testing and maintenance;

Are You the team member we are looking for? 

In order to be successful in this role, you are/have:

- motivated and eager to learn different aspects of engineering
- comfortable interacting with technical and business people
- strong communication and presentation skills
- recently graduated/finishing your MSc or BSc in Computer Science or related major;
- familiar with version control and collaboration tooling (git)
- familiar with CI/CD frameworks and automated deployment concepts (i.e Docker, K8s)
- fluent in both English and German 
- available for a minimum of 32h a week.
- ready to start on the 1st of February 
Benefits 

What We Offer 

- Exposure to a wide variety of projects, industries, and technologies. Each client is different and provides unique opportunities to learn. 
- Ability to contribute to internal open-source projects like Darts ( https://github.com/unit8co/darts ) 
- Learning activities such as ML Reading Group, knowledge sharing sessions with engineers.
- Training-on-the-job and your personal wingmate/mentor
- 15 paid days of holiday

- up to 10% of paid time for self-development.

title: Palantir Foundry Engineer (Relocation to Abu Dhabi, UAE)
description:
Who We Are 

Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a Swiss data and AI consulting company helping organisations in traditional industries solve complex challenges in areas such as operations, finance, manufacturing and R&D. We work at the intersection of technology and business, delivering data and AI solutions that create practical value for our clients.

Our teams have delivered projects across industries including automotive, chemicals, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We are a Palantir partner and work with clients across the full data and AI journey, from understanding a business problem to building and deploying the solution.

Unit8 has delivered more than 300 projects and grown to a team of 190+ talented people across ten office locations. Following our growth across Europe and our expansion into North America, we are now building our presence in the United Arab Emirates. We are looking for a Palantir Foundry Engineer to join us in Abu Dhabi. This role is based in the UAE and includes relocation from Switzerland with full immigration and relocation support.

Requirements 

About the Role

As one of the first members of Unit8’s team in the UAE, you will help deliver Foundry solutions for clients while contributing to the growth of our presence in the region.

You will work directly with client teams to understand their data and operational challenges, then design and build solutions that address them. The role combines hands-on engineering with close collaboration across business and technical teams. You will also contribute your technical perspective during early client discussions and help shape practical approaches to new opportunities.

What You’ll Do 

- Design, build, deploy and maintain data solutions using Palantir Foundry.
- Develop and troubleshoot data pipelines and processing systems using Foundry and relevant open-source or proprietary technologies.
- Build and maintain Foundry components such as Ontologies, pipelines, and user-facing applications.
- Apply sound engineering practices for testing, data quality, performance, security and maintainability.
- Work with client stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify problems and translate business needs into technical solutions.
- Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, product owners and client teams in an agile environment.
- Contribute to technical discovery and solution scoping for prospective and ongoing engagements.
- Help establish Unit8’s engineering and delivery approach in the UAE, sharing knowledge with colleagues and supporting the growth of the local team.

About You 

We are looking for an experienced Palantir Foundry Engineer with a passion for data and solving complex client challenges. You should be a skilled professional who has:

* Foundry Platform Knowledge 

- Demonstrated experience with AIP, Workshop, Code repository, and Pipeline Builder .
- A solid understanding of security concepts within Foundry, including restricted views and markings.
- Knowledge of Ontology and Data connection .
- We're interested in the technical details of what you've built and how you approached the architecture of your Foundry use-cases.
* Programming Skills - proficiency in Python and PySpark .

* Data Skills (Nice-to-have) - knowledge of data modeling and basic concepts of data science (classification, clustering, regression).

* Professional Experience 

- A minimum of 1 year of experience working with the Foundry platform, ideally within a larger company where you may have had a focused but deep exposure.
- Strong client-facing skills: You are comfortable interacting with both business and technical clients, giving presentations, and possess a strong problem-solving mindset.
* Other 

- You are willing to travel to meet with our clients and the team

Benefits 

What We Offer 

- The opportunity to help establish Unit8’s presence in a new market.
- Hands-on work on client challenges with tangible business impact.
- Exposure to different industries, projects and technologies.
- A collaborative team environment with colleagues across Switzerland, Europe and North America.
- Mentorship and opportunities to develop your technical and consulting skills.
- Full immigration support for your move to the UAE.
- Relocation support, including accommodation and travel allowances.
- Opportunities to contribute to knowledge sharing and projects with a positive impact.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

- SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

- SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

- SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

- Committed to our customers and community.

- Obsessed with quality.

- Deliberate in our decisions.

- Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description 
We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join the CI Experience squad within our Code Orchestration department.

The CI Experience squad enables users to analyze their projects in their own CI, making analysis a core part of their workflow. We have a mission to make analysis reliable, fast, configurable and developer-friendly.

What you will do 

- 
Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and engineers to build the best CI-based analysis experience.

- 
Contribute well tested and production ready code.

- 
Participate in the on-call operation of analysis infrastructure, including feature deployments, production monitoring, incident response, and troubleshooting.

- 
Contribute to the definition of the team’s short and long-term goals.

Experience and qualifications 

- MS in Computer Science (or equivalent experience).

- 
0-3 years of professional software engineering experience.

- 
Proficiency with Java.

- 
Solid engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and the ability to reason about correctness and performance

Nice to have 

- 
Familiarity with a variety of build systems and CI runners.

In-office culture 

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. title: Senior Software Engineer (Agentic Search) – Web Rendering Engineer
description:
About Nebius: 

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product

description:

Nebius Token Factory is looking for scientists who can turn frontier LLM and VLM inference bottlenecks into research questions, conduct rigorous experiments, and translate their findings into production capabilities. - Develop rigorous evaluations covering quality, latency, throughput, numerical stability, memory footprint, tail latency, and cost per token. Compare serving architectures under consistent workload conditions and GPU budgets.

- Work with MLE, GPU kernel, backend infrastructure, product, and customer teams to select research priorities with measurable production impact.

- Share results through internal reports, technical blogs, papers, and open-source artifacts, and mentor engineers and scientists on experimental design, scientific rigor, and model/system trade-offs.

Must-haves

- A PhD in computer science, machine learning, ML systems, computer systems, computer architecture, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, or a closely related discipline.

- Strong experimental design skills covering ablations, baselines, metrics, statistical reasoning, and failure analysis.

- Excellent written and verbal communication.

Nice-to-haves

- First-author publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, MLSys, ACL, EMNLP, ASPLOS, OSDI, SOSP, ISCA, or HPCA.

- Experience deploying ML models or inference optimizations in production.

- Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, NVIDIA Dynamo, FlashAttention, FlashInfer, Triton, CUDA, or PyTorch internals.

Facharzt/Fachärztin für Allgemeine Innere Medizin in Liestal (anteilig Home Office) (a)

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Join our mission 

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products. 

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role 

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

As a DevOps Engineer at Namespace, you'll build and operate the infrastructure that makes this performance possible. You'll own the compute, storage, and networking behind every build our customers run, keeping the platform fast, reliable, and cost-effective as we accelerate more companies around the world.

Our culture 

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.

What you'll do 

- Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of the infrastructure that runs every customer’s build, test, and CI job on Namespace.

- Optimize performance across compute, memory, storage, and networking.

- Automate provisioning, deployment, scaling, and recovery across our fleet.

- Build observability, alerting, and incident response processes that identify and resolve issues before they affect customers.

- Drive capacity planning and cost efficiency, so we continue to deliver infrastructure that is both faster and more cost-effective.

- Collaborate closely with product engineers to ship new capabilities quickly and safely.

What we're looking for 

- Strong engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience operating production infrastructure at scale.

- Deep knowledge of Linux, networking, and storage, plus experience with tools like Kubernetes, Terraform, or similar.

- Proficiency in Go, Python, or a similar language, automation is paramount.

- Deep experience with observability tooling and participating in on-call rotations.

- A strong focus on performance and a rigorous approach to measuring and improving it.

- Bonus: experience with bare metal, virtualization (KVM, Firecracker), or running CI/CD systems at scale.

You can expect: 

- Competitive salary and stock options

- Flexible working hours

- Market-leading parental leave

Life at Namespace Labs: 

- We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

- We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

- We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.

title: Embedded Engineer
description:
Accelerating embodied AGI. 

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Embedded Engineer, you will own the firmware that runs on that hardware, from the first register write to the moment data leaves the device, so that what reaches our ML team is clean, synchronized, and trustworthy.

What You Will Do 

- Write and own the firmware for our data-capture hardware: sensors, motion-capture rigs, custom IoT setups, and prototype robots.

- Build real-time data acquisition: drivers, DMA, buffering, and streaming from many sensors at once without dropping a sample.

- Solve multi-sensor synchronization, calibration, and time-stamping so every data point lines up across devices and modalities.

- Bring up new boards with our Electrical Engineer and turn fresh hardware into working devices fast.

- Build the path from device to dataset: communication protocols, on-device logging, and handoff into our data pipeline.

- Work shoulder to shoulder with ML engineers. Your firmware decides what their training data looks like, and a timing bug can quietly ruin months of data.

- Make firmware reliable in the field: testing, OTA updates, error handling, and diagnostics that tell us what went wrong.

Requirements 

- Up to 5 years writing production firmware for embedded or IoT systems.

- Strong C/C++, experience with an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar), and deep familiarity with microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, NXP, or similar).

- Hands-on experience with peripheral interfaces and protocols: SPI, I2C, UART, USB, BLE, CAN, or similar.

- Experience integrating sensors in firmware: IMUs, cameras, depth sensors, force sensors, or similar.

- A strong understanding of how firmware decisions affect data quality, especially for EMG/EEG sensing: ADC configuration, sample rate, jitter, filtering, and buffering. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you write code accordingly.

- Comfortable debugging at the hardware boundary with a logic analyzer, oscilloscope, and debugger.

- Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

- High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. You are comfortable in 0-to-1 ambiguity, where the spec is "figure out what the spec should be".

- Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

- Fluent in English. German is a plus.

Nice to Have 

- A background in robotics, motion capture, or wearable devices.

- Experience with real-time or hard-deadline systems: audio, video sync, or robotic control loops.

- Experience with embedded Linux, time-sync protocols (PTP or similar), or low-power design.

- Familiarity with ML training pipelines. Even if you don't run them, you can read a training script.

- Open-source firmware contributions.

- Experience taking firmware from prototype to small-batch production: test fixtures, provisioning, and certification support.

Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

- Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

- Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

- Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

- Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if: 

- You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

- You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

- You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if: 

- You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

- You would forward output you cannot explain.

- "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

- Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

- Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

- Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

- Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

- Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

- Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

- Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

- A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

- Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.
