description:
We are looking for a Data Engineering Team Lead to lead the Data Platform team at DataSnipper.

Every decision DataSnipper makes about its products runs through the data platform: which features land, which customers are getting value, what we bill for, what we fix next, and which AI capabilities add the most value. You will lead a team of two data engineers who own the systems that make that possible. That means how usage events get captured across a growing set of products, how they become trustworthy models in Snowflake, and how Customer Success, Product and GTM get to answers without waiting on us.

This is a player-coach role in a small, high-ownership team . You are responsible for the people, the roadmap and the technical direction, and you stay hands-on enough to ship alongside the team and make architectural calls credibly. At DataSnipper, Team Lead is our entry point into engineering management: the same people, delivery and product responsibilities as an Engineering Manager, on a smaller team.

We are a handful of people serving the whole company, so your judgment about what not to build matters as much as what the team ships.

About DataSnipper

DataSnipper is the driving force behind an intelligent automation platform that’s transforming the world of audit and finance.

Founded in 2017, DataSnipper has skyrocketed and is now OFFICIALLY the fastest-growing software company in the Netherlands according to Deloitte Fast50 and recently achieved Unicorn status in our latest funding round. With over 400.000 users in 125+ countries and a second base in the heart of New York City, DataSnipper is shaking things up. And we’re not stopping there. At DataSnipper, we’re always on the lookout for innovators who think outside of the box. New ideas aren’t just welcomed at DataSnipper–they’re essential.

What your team owns

The Data Platform team works across three areas:

- Data Platform : reliable, scalable infrastructure that gets the right data to the right place

- Internal Analytics : a self-service platform so every team can be data-informed without a ticket

- Customer-facing Analytics : the dashboards and exports customers use to see the value they get from DataSnipper

Concretely, you would be walking into billions of usage events flowing from our Excel Add-in, web apps and product backends through Azure Event Hubs into Snowflake ; a dbt estate built on medallion principles and managed in dbt Cloud ; Terraform-managed Snowflake and Azure infrastructure; and a set of product teams shipping AI agents faster than we can instrument them .

You will also find real, named open problems rather than a tidy platform: event capture mid-consolidation, multiple methods of user attribution, and a data quality layer that is designed but not yet built. We would rather tell you that up front.

What you will do

Lead the team

- Lead a team of two data engineers through outcomes, not tasks : set clear goals with the team and trust them to figure out how

- Make the team measurably better: raise the engineering bar, grow each engineer into bigger problems, and address performance issues directly when they arise

- Run regular 1:1s, give clear and timely feedback, and own each engineer's goals and development

- Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, documentation and operational excellence

- Take part in hiring and help shape the team's scope as it evolves

Own direction and delivery

- Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success and GTM to shape the team's roadmap , turning vague data requests into scoped, well-defined work

- Make the trade-offs a small team serving the whole company needs: what to build, what to defer, and when a request shouldn't become a pipeline

- Set the technical direction and make the architectural calls that shape the team's systems

- Keep Snowflake performance and cost , tech debt, dependencies and compliance obligations (audit logging, vulnerability remediation, Vanta evidence) visible and under control

- Be the person other engineering teams come to when they need to instrument something new

Stay hands-on in the data platform

- Contribute to the event ingestion architecture end to end: Azure Event Hubs, Snowpipe, Fivetran, and our shared Python/TypeScript event client libraries

- Build and review dbt transformation pipelines that stay reliable as volume, source count and model complexity grow

- Define and enforce event contracts and schemas so product teams can instrument new features without silent breakage downstream

- Evolve the core data models (event, user, license, company) and integrate new sources such as product backends, MongoDB, HubSpot and billing

- Guide reverse ETL and activation work that pushes modeled data back into HubSpot, MongoDB, Postgres and GTM reporting

What you bring

Leadership

- At least 1 year leading engineers as a team lead or engineering manager: 1:1s, feedback, goal setting, performance, and development

- An empowerment style of leadership : you lead through outcomes and trust, not by assigning tasks

- Early evidence of growing engineers and raising a team's bar, and the willingness to address performance issues directly

- Strong product aptitude : you can challenge the framing of a request, translate stakeholder needs into technical solutions, and make roadmap trade-offs

Data engineering

- 7+ years in data engineering or a closely related backend/platform role, with a track record of owning a data platform area end to end

- Deep SQL and strong Python , including query optimization and performance tuning on a cloud warehouse

- Production experience with a cloud data warehouse (we use Snowflake ) and a modern transformation framework (we use dbt )

- Experience with event-driven / streaming ingestion and its failure modes: schema drift, duplication, late data, backfills

- Experience on a cloud platform at the infrastructure level (we're on Azure ; AWS/GCP transfers fine)

- Solid data modeling fundamentals and the ability to defend a modeling decision to both engineers and business stakeholders

- Experience operating data systems in production with a focus on reliability, observability and maintainability

How you work

- Excellent communication in English and genuine comfort working directly with non-technical stakeholders

- Bias to action, a strong sense of ownership, and the judgment to prioritize when demand exceeds capacity

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in a startup or scale-up , ideally as an early member of a data team

- Experience hiring engineers or helping a team expand its scope

- Experience with product analytics tooling (Mixpanel, RudderStack) and warehouse-native BI (Netspring/Optimizely Analytics, Omni, Embeddable, or similar)

- Experience building data products for AI or agent consumption : semantic layers, metrics layers, MCP servers, or governed self-service access

- Experience with Terraform , Docker and data governance at scale

- Reverse ETL experience and familiarity with CRM data models (HubSpot, Salesforce) or customer success platforms

What we offer

- Being part of one of the fastest-growing scale-ups in the Netherlands

- Make an impact by disrupting the audit industry with us

- A step into engineering management, with Engineering Manager scope on a small team

- 28 vacation days

- Excellent salary

- Pension plan

- Stock participation plan

- Hybrid work (Amsterdam-based)

- International team and environment

- Daily lunch

- Mental health support (OpenUp)

- Social events and team activities

Recruitment steps

- Recruiter screen

- Hiring Manager interview

- System design interview

- Product interview

- Final interviews with Engineering leadership

At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience. 

Our hiring decisions are merit based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role. 

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you. 

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper

title: Machine Learning Platform Engineer I
description:
Your Opportunity 

We are looking for a Machine Learning Platform Engineer to join Mollie's Machine Learning Platform team, sitting within our broader Data Domain. Our ML Platform empowers Machine Learning Scientists to develop and deploy custom ML solutions at scale across Mollie, serving domains including Risk & Fraud, Payments, Merchant Experience, Financial Services, Go-to-Market, and more. As the central team responsible for Mollie's Machine Learning Platform, we own the maintenance and continuous enhancement of the platform, ensuring it remains reliable, scalable, and fit for production-grade workloads. We work closely with domain teams to bring custom ML models into products, bridging the gap between research and real-world impact, while also designing and developing custom GenAI tooling and platforms for both internal employees and Mollie's customers.

This is a hands-on role where you will spend the majority of your time writing Python and Terraform alongside a team of skilled ML Platform Engineers. Based at Mollie's Lisbon Hub, you will be part of a geographically distributed team spanning Amsterdam and Lisbon, working in a collaborative environment that embraces both remote and hybrid ways of working.

What you’ll be doing 

As an ML Platform Engineer, you will:

- Collaborate closely with ML Platform Engineers, Machine Learning Scientists, and engineers across Mollie's domain teams to deliver scalable Machine Learning solutions

- Deploy and operationalize ML models to production in partnership with Machine Learning Scientists, bridging the gap between experimentation and real-world impact

- Enhance and maintain our cloud-based ML Platform on GCP, writing production-grade Python and Terraform daily

- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for ML model training and inference, ensuring reliable and automated workflows across environments

- Deploy, manage, and scale model serving endpoints on Kubernetes, ensuring low-latency, high-availability inference for production workloads

- Assist in extending, developing, and hosting custom and open-source AI tooling ; enabling teams to rapidly build and deploy AI-powered solutions.

- Champion MLOps best practices, implementing standards around model versioning, experiment tracking, data validation, and automated retraining

- Ensure platform reliability by setting up observability, monitoring, and alerting for both infrastructure and deployed models

- Maintain and enhance open-source AI tooling hosted at Mollie (such as LiteLLM and LibreChat), and further support and expand our generative AI capabilities.

What you'll bring 

- 1+ year of experience deploying and maintaining ML models in production

- Good understanding of MLOps principles, including matters such as experiment tracking, reproducibility, pipeline automation, model versioning, and monitoring in production

- Strong hands-on Python programming skills, with proficiency across common ML and data libraries such as scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, XGBoost, LightGBM, and MLflow

- Familiarity with at a major cloud platform, preferably GCP

- Experience with containerization (Docker), with preferred familiarity in container orchestration tools such as Kubernetes and Kubeflow.

- Strong context-switching ability with sharp attention to detail, adapting quickly to shifting priorities

- Preferably familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform

- Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for ML workflows

Grow your way 

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy. If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you.

AI at Mollie 

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
description:
Who we are 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 

About the role: 

As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.

Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.

Location: This role is open to candidates residing in Netherlands

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.

- You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.

In this role, you will: 

- Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts

- Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident

- Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives

- Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

- Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response

- Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal

- Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara's investigation processes, with proficiency in Python

- Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis

- Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams

- Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux

- Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services

An ideal candidate also has: 

- 2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience

- GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification

- Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

title: BDR Talent Programme (Amsterdam)
description:
Company Description 

We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. 

About the Programme 

This is a structured 18–24 month global programme designed to launch high-potential commercial careers. You don’t need prior sales or payments experience; what you need is ambition, curiosity, resilience, and the drive to build relationships and solve complex problems.

You will join a global cohort of Business Development Representatives (BDRs) with structured learning, dedicated coaching from sales leaders, and real commercial responsibility from month one. Throughout the programme, you will master enterprise sales: researching strategic accounts, engaging senior decision-makers, conducting sharp discovery conversations, and building pipeline that drives real business growth.

High performers transition into Sales, Account Management, and other commercial roles across the business. Many of our top commercial leaders, including our Chief Revenue Officer, started their journey at Checkout.com as BDRs or interns. Whether you are a recent graduate, an early-career professional with 1–3 years of experience, or a career switcher, what matters most is your hunger to learn and achieve.

What You’ll Do 

- Research Strategic Accounts: Identify high-value targets by researching key organizations, industries, and executive stakeholders.

- Initiate High-Impact Outreach: Open doors with senior decision-makers using personalized outreach across email, phone, and LinkedIn.

- Build Qualified Pipeline: Drive consistent growth momentum through disciplined prospecting, rigorous follow-up, and account mapping.

- Run Consultative Discovery: Uncover merchants' technical and business challenges to align Checkout.com ’s solutions with their goals.

- Partner on Live Deals: Work alongside Sales Representatives to support opportunities through to deal execution.

- Leverage AI & Modern Tech: Use CRM, intent data, and approved AI tools to streamline research, refine outreach, and work smarter.

Who We’re Looking For 

We welcome applications from recent graduates and professionals with 1–3 years of experience looking to change careers. Regardless of your background, we are looking for the following core skills to set you up for success:

- Driven & Goal-Oriented: You set high personal standards, work hard, and stay motivated when tackling challenging commercial goals.

- Resilient & Adaptable: You bounce back quickly from rejection, view obstacles as practice, and maintain consistent output.

- Relational & Engaging: You genuinely enjoy starting conversations, asking sharp questions, and building trust with diverse stakeholders.

- Track Record of Achievement: You demonstrate drive and ownership through professional, academic, athletic, or entrepreneurial success.

- Commercial & Tech Curiosity: You are eager to learn complex fintech products and use AI and sales tools to work smarter.

- Coachability & Clear Communication: You listen well, articulate ideas clearly, and actively apply feedback to improve performance.

What You’ll Get Out of It 

A 2-year structured programme that ensures you have a successful career in sales. A clear progression pathway built around key pillars:

Role type: Full-time

Role Overview 

Systemiq is seeking a Director with deep expertise in power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, system planning, flexibility, market design, utility transformation, and the integration of renewables at scale.

This role will help clients address some of the most critical bottlenecks in the energy transition: grid constraints, connection queues, system adequacy, flexibility markets, transmission and distribution investment, regulatory reform, and the changing role of utilities and system operators.

This is not a generalist energy transition role. We are looking for a senior strategy leader who understands how power systems actually work technically, commercially, and institutionally, and who can help clients unlock the grid, market, and system integration challenges now slowing the transition.

This is a senior leadership role combining:

- Deep power systems expertise

- Top-tier strategy problem solving

- Origination and senior client leadership

- Delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programmes

- Team leadership and platform-building

You will work closely with Eveline Speelman and global partners to build Systemiq’s work on power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, flexibility, market design, utilities, and system-level decarbonisation.

Key Responsibilities 

Power Systems & Grid Transformation 

- Lead work on power system transformation, including grid constraints, transmission and distribution investment, system planning, flexibility, renewables integration, and utility transformation.

- Advise clients on the strategic, regulatory, commercial, and institutional choices needed to accelerate power system decarbonisation.

- Translate technical power system challenges into clear strategic recommendations for senior decision-makers.

- Identify the practical barriers slowing power system transformation and shape interventions to overcome them.

Strategic Advisory 

- Lead high-impact strategy engagements with corporates, governments, investors, utilities, system operators, and other energy system actors.

Systems Change & Platform Leadership

- Identify structural bottlenecks across policy, infrastructure, regulation, market design, and capital allocation.

- Work across sectors and stakeholders to unlock system-wide impact beyond project-level outcomes.

- Contribute to Systemiq’s broader Energy platform strategy and thought leadership.

Origination & Growth 

- Identify, shape, and win new work across power systems, grids, utilities, flexibility, and energy transition topics.

- Build trusted relationships with senior clients, partners, and external stakeholders.

- Contribute to scaling Systemiq’s Energy platform globally.

Team Leadership 

- Lead and mentor high-performing teams.

- Coach and develop team members, building capability in power systems, analytical problem solving, and systems-level thinking.

- Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and mission-driven culture.

Candidate Profile 

We are looking for a high-calibre, strategy-led leader with deep power systems expertise and the ability to operate at the intersection of strategy, policy, regulation, infrastructure, and real-economy delivery.

Essential Experience 

- Deep experience in power systems, ideally including transmission and distribution grids, system operation, power market design, flexibility, renewables integration, storage, demand response, or utility strategy

- Around 10 to 15+ years’ experience in strategy consulting or energy advisory

- Experience working with or advising utilities, TSOs, DSOs, regulators, energy ministries, market operators, developers, infrastructure investors, or major energy users.

- Strong understanding of how grid constraints, interconnection, flexibility, storage, demand response, market reform, and regulation affect decarbonisation pathways.

- Ability to translate technical power system issues into strategic choices for senior decision-makers.

- Proven track record leading strategy engagements, complex programmes, and senior client relationships.

- Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders, policymakers, regulators, and investors.

- Experience combining advisory work with real-world implementation is strongly valued.

Core Capabilities 

- Exceptional problem structuring and analytical rigour.

- Strong commercial judgement and experience in origination and growth.

- Ability to move between high-level strategy and practical implementation.

- Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.

- Systems thinker focused on practical, scalable, real-world outcomes.

- Ability to lead complex work across multiple stakeholders, sectors, and geographies.

Desirable Experience 

- Experience in international energy systems, infrastructure investment, large-scale transition programmes, or power market reform.

- Experience with digital, AI, or advanced analytical tools that improve insight generation, modelling, or delivery efficiency.

- Experience building new areas of work, propositions, or client relationships.

Mindset 

- Entrepreneurial and opportunity-driven.

- Comfortable with ambiguity and building new areas of work.

- Collaborative, low ego, and mission-driven.

- Pragmatic, intellectually rigorous, and focused on real-world impact.

Why This Role Matters 

Power systems are now one of the central constraints in the energy transition. Renewables, electrification, storage, flexibility, industrial decarbonisation, and clean technology deployment all depend on power systems evolving faster than they are today.

This role sits at the centre of that challenge. It will help clients and partners address the grid, market, regulatory, and institutional barriers that determine whether economy-wide decarbonisation can happen at the pace required.

description:

About the role 

WPP Enterprise Solutions in Amsterdam is the central hub for SEO and GEO expertise across the WPP network. From our team, we work with major national and international organisations on complex challenges across search, websites, digital platforms and AI-driven discovery.

Our team currently consists of ten SEO and GEO specialists and is growing rapidly. We are therefore looking for a Senior Technical SEO Specialist to strengthen our technical capabilities.

This is explicitly not a traditional SEO role with some technical SEO added on top. We are looking for someone who approaches SEO from a technical perspective. Someone who understands how websites, platforms, JavaScript frameworks, crawlers, rendering, APIs and search engines interact, and who can independently investigate and solve complex technical problems.

You are comfortable working with SEO specialists, developers, solution architects, product teams and other technical stakeholders. You are able to go deep into the technology when needed, while also translating complex findings into clear priorities, recommendations and implementations for enterprise clients.

What you will do 

As a Senior Technical SEO Specialist, you will be responsible for the technical quality and scalability of our SEO solutions. You will work on complex websites and digital ecosystems where standard SEO checklists are simply not enough.

Your responsibilities will include: 

- Conducting advanced technical SEO audits for large and complex websites, platforms and international domain structures.

- Analysing crawling, indexing and rendering to identify the root causes of technical SEO and indexation issues.

- Working with modern JavaScript frameworks and rendering architectures, including SSR, CSR, SSG and hybrid rendering.

- Analysing HTML, JavaScript, HTTP requests, response headers, status codes, redirects, canonicalisation and robots directives.

- Investigating and optimising crawl architecture, internal linking and information architecture for websites with hundreds of thousands or millions of URLs.

- Advising on complex technical challenges involving migrations, replatforming, URL structures, faceted navigation, pagination, internationalisation and hreflang.

- Performing log file analysis to understand how Googlebot and other crawlers interact with websites and to improve crawl efficiency.

- Developing scripts, tooling and automation that make recurring analyses faster, more reliable and more scalable.

- Reviewing technical solutions, specifications and implementations from an SEO perspective before they go live.

- Working closely with developers and engineering teams to translate SEO recommendations into clear technical requirements and tickets.

The technical expertise we are looking for 

For this role, we are looking for someone whose technical capabilities go well beyond using standard SEO tools.

You have a strong understanding of: 

- HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and can independently analyse source code and identify technical issues.

- HTTP and web architecture, including requests and responses, status codes, caching, redirects, headers and CDN behaviour.

- JavaScript SEO and the implications of client-side and server-side rendering for crawling, rendering and indexing.

- Technical concepts such as SSR, CSR, SSG, hydration and dynamic rendering.

- Crawling and indexing, and how search engines technically process websites.

- txt, XML sitemaps, canonical tags, meta robots, X-Robots-Tag and other crawling and indexing directives.

- Structured data and Schema.org.

- Core Web Vitals and web performance.

- International websites, hreflang and complex multi-market architectures.

- Website and platform migrations.

- Crawl budget and scalable website architectures.

You do not need to be a software engineer in every area. However, we do expect you to be comfortable reading code, manipulating data, working with APIs and building scripts or technical solutions when needed.

What seniority means to us

Being senior means more than being able to independently deliver a technical SEO audit.

We expect you to be able to break down complex technical problems where there is no obvious answer. You combine experience, data and technical knowledge to define your own investigative approach and develop solutions that can realistically scale within enterprise organisations.

You will also:

- Proactively improve the way we work, using tooling and AI to increase efficiency, quality and impact.

- Make significant improvements to our SEO guidelines, workflows and processes.

- Develop innovative solutions to complex SEO challenges, including algorithm changes, large-scale site architecture, crawling and automation.

title: Process Automation Engineer
description:
Functieprofiel 

Als Process Automation Engineer speel je een cruciale rol in het hart van onze productieomgeving. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren, onderhouden en continu verbeteren van het procesautomatiseringslandschap (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3 – zowel hardware als software).

Je borgt de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van onze productieprocessen en vertaalt data en technologie naar slimme, praktische verbeteringen die de organisatie vooruithelpen. Dit is een hands‑on functie met veel impact, waarin je nauw samenwerkt met Operations, Production Support Engineering en externe technologiepartners.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

NX Filtration bevindt zich in een spannende groeifase, gedreven door een unieke en impactvolle technologie. Met onze missie “pure en betaalbare wateroplossingen voor iedereen” ontwikkelen en produceren wij geavanceerde holle‑vezelmembranen voor nano‑, ultra‑ en microfiltratie.

Onze technologie verwijdert de kleinste verontreinigingen uit water, waaronder nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Hiermee maken wij eenvoudige, efficiënte en duurzame oplossingen mogelijk voor waterzuivering, hergebruik van afvalwater en drinkwaterproductie wereldwijd. Door bij NX Filtration te werken, draag je direct bij aan het oplossen van mondiale uitdagingen op het gebied van waterkwaliteit en waterschaarste.

Wat ga jij doen! 

In deze dynamische rol houd je je bezig met:

- Beheren, onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van procesautomatiseringssystemen (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3)

- Continu verbeteren van het NX Production Data Platform

- Initiëren, uitwerken en implementeren van technische verbeteringen en procesoptimalisaties

- Ondersteunen van Operations bij automatiseringsincidenten, inclusief deelname aan de storingsdienst

- Zorgen voor een hoge beschikbaarheid en kwaliteit van productie‑ en QC‑data en actieve ondersteuning van data‑analyses

- Voorstellen van automatisering‑ en digitaliseringsprojecten en – na goedkeuring – deze voorbereiden en uitvoeren

- Adviseren van de organisatie over nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en toekomstbestendige oplossingen

- Actief bijdragen aan het versterken van cybersecurity binnen het OT‑domein

Wat wij vragen! 

- Jij bent een proactieve automatiseringsprofessional met een passie voor technologie en verbetering:

- Een afgeronde bachelor‑ of masteropleiding in Informatica, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare richting

- Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in procesautomatisering

- Hands‑on ervaring met Siemens Step7 / TIA Portal / WinCC

Werken bij NX Filtration biedt je de kans om samen met een gedreven en enthousiast team een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de professionalisering en groei van de organisatie. Je werkt in een open en informele omgeving met zeer korte communicatielijnen, waarin eigen initiatief wordt gestimuleerd.

Het betreft een zelfstandige functie binnen een snelgroeiende, dynamische organisatie in een internationale setting, waar je volop ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen – zowel persoonlijk als in je loopbaanambities.

title: Product Manager

Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day. 

We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. You'll own the products that turn that complexity into clarity, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, sales, and implementation to make sure what we build actually gets adopted. 

Responsibilities

You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind. 

- Market scoping and opportunity-spotting 

Scanning the logistics landscape, competitor moves, and customer signals to find where Bluerock should build next, not just what's already on the backlog. 

- Logistics know-how turned into product decisions 

Planning, transport execution, freight, last-mile — decisions that hold up against how operations actually run, not just how they're described to you. 

- The full lifecycle 

From first idea to adoption. You don't hand off and disappear. 

- The connective tissue across the company 

When priorities compete or a customer escalation needs an answer fast, you're the one pulling the threads together. 

The team you’ll join 

You'll join an international product team with complementary skills and a shared passion for a good challenge, real, hands-on experience in logistics paired with genuine enthusiasm for technology. We don't settle for quick patches: we strive for quality, look for the sustainable solution over the easy one, and keep an eye on what next-level TMS should look like, not just what's in front of us today. 

Life at Bluerock 

We're a distributed team across the Netherlands, Italy, the US, and Canada that operates like one crew: local insight, global perspective. We're curious by default, self-driven without needing to be told twice, and genuinely joyful about solving hard logistics problems together. We're team-minded because the best answers rarely come from one person alone, and unapologetically reliable because our customers' supply chains don't get a “we'll fix it next sprint.” As one of us put it: at the end of the day, it's the people that make Bluerock.

- Analyze test results, performance margins, failure modes, and operational limits to improve product robustness, reliability, and design maturity.

- Apply engineering analyses, trade-off studies, DfMA principles, simulation tools, and FEA to optimize mechanical, thermal, structural, dynamic, manufacturability, lifecycle, and cost performance.

- Investigate qualification failures, manufacturing issues, integration challenges, and field performance topics using structured problem-solving and root cause analysis.

- Provide technical input during design reviews, engineering discussions, development decisions, and cross-functional integration activities.

- Plan and execute work in line with priorities, milestones, quality expectations, and timelines, while proactively communicating risks, dependencies, and recommendations.

- Share expertise, lessons learned, and best practices to strengthen team capability, collaboration, product quality, reliability, and continuous improvement.

Why Join Us?

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

- Fresh team lunches provided3 times/ week.

Qualifications:

- 5+ years of experience in multidisciplinary product development environments.

- Strong experience designing chassis, enclosures, hardware packaging solutions, and mechanical assemblies for high-performance products.

- Proven track record in developing ruggedized opto-electronic hardware products from concept through qualification and release.

- Strong understanding of vibration, shock, thermal, EMC, ingress protection, and environmental requirements for demanding operational environments.

- Experience with 3D CAD tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, NX, or similar.

- Experience creating engineering drawings, specifications, and manufacturing documentation.

- Strong analytical mindset with experience in structured problem solving and engineering verification.

- Strong communication skills in English and collaborative working style.

title: Senior Corporate Tech Recruiter
description:
Bouw mee aan recruitment voor een hoogwaardige tech consultancy

Senior tech professionals vinden vraagt meer dan vacatures publiceren en sollicitaties beoordelen. De beste kandidaten zijn vaak niet actief op zoek. Je moet weten waar je ze vindt, hoe je ze benadert en hoe je ze enthousiast maakt voor een inhoudelijk gesprek. 

Bij Conflux zoeken we daarom een Senior Corporate Tech Recruiter die recruitment en sourcing beheerst. Iemand die zelfstandig de arbeidsmarkt benadert, hiring managers adviseert en verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor het volledige recruitmentproces. 

Conflux is een Nederlandse tech consultancy met gespecialiseerde expertise binnen onder andere Data & AI, Software Development, Cloud en Platform Engineering. Onze consultants werken aan complexe technische vraagstukken en behoren inhoudelijk tot de ervaren professionals binnen hun vakgebied. 

Dat betekent dat onze recruitment vraagstukken niet eenvoudig zijn. We zoeken onder andere Senior Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Java Developers, Kubernetes Engineers, Platform Engineers en Front-end Developers. 

Daarvoor zoeken we een recruiter die zijn of haar vak verstaat.

Wat je gaat doen 

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de werving van ervaren technische consultants binnen onder andere: 

- Data Engineering & AI 

- Machine Learning 

- Java Development 

- Kubernetes & Cloud Native 

- Cloud & Platform Engineering 

- Front-end Development 

Je beheert het recruitmentproces van arbeidsmarktanalyse en sourcing tot selectie en aanbieding. 

Concreet betekent dit dat je: 

- actief technische professionals sourcet en benadert, onder andere via LinkedIn Recruiter en andere sourcingkanalen; 

- zelfstandig searches en sourcingstrategieën ontwikkelt voor moeilijk vindbare doelgroepen; 

- kandidaten screent op ervaring, technische context, motivatie en consultancy-fit; 

- hiring managers adviseert over doelgroep, haalbaarheid, arbeidsmarkt, selectiecriteria en recruitmentaanpak; 

- kandidaten gedurende het volledige proces begeleidt en zorgt voor een professionele en persoonlijke candidate experience; 

- interview- en selectieprocessen bewaakt en waar nodig bijstuurt; 

- talentpools opbouwt en relaties onderhoudt met relevante professionals; 

- data en recruitmentinzichten gebruikt om keuzes en prioriteiten te onderbouwen; 

- externe recruitmentpartners inzet wanneer dit aantoonbaar waarde toevoegt; 

- kansen signaleert om recruitment slimmer, sneller en effectiever te organiseren.

Ongeveer 85% van je tijd ben je bezig met recruitment en sourcing. De overige tijd gebruik je om recruitment verder te professionaliseren, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van tooling, data, processen, arbeidsmarktcommunicatie, AI of nieuwe sourcingmethoden.

Wie jij bent

Je hebt weinig dagelijkse aansturing nodig. Je ziet waar recruitment stagneert, onderzoekt waarom en komt met oplossingen. 

Je wacht niet alleen op sollicitanten, maar gaat zelf de markt in. 

Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe sourcingmethoden, tooling en technologie en experimenteert graag met manieren om moeilijk bereikbare kandidaten toch te vinden.

title: Senior Recruiter
Senior C++/iOS Engineer - User Platform
description:
We’re looking for a Senior C++/iOS Engineer to join the Baldur squad within User Platform (UP). Baldur owns Spotify ’s Session Management and Delegated Authorization domains—the systems that enable applications to securely obtain, use, and manage access tokens for hundreds of millions of users. In this role, you’ll help shape the technology that powers secure access across every Spotify client and third-party integration. 

Your work will support engineers across Spotify building mobile and desktop experiences, platform teams, and third-party developers integrating with Spotify’s authorization platform. You’ll collaborate across disciplines to build secure, reliable, and scalable authentication experiences that have a direct impact on millions of people every day.

What You'll Do

- Collaborate with a highly autonomous and supportive engineering squad responsible for Spotify’s delegated authorization and session management platforms.

- Design, build, and evolve critical infrastructure powering Spotify applications and partner integrations using shared C++ libraries and native Swift on iOS.

- Develop secure, reliable, and performant delegated authorization flows, including token issuance, refresh, revocation, and session lifecycle management across multiple platforms.

- Partner with client and backend engineers to integrate with core authorization services, token issuance, client registration, and token revocation.

- Improve how credentials and access tokens are securely stored and managed on-device while balancing security, reliability, and application performance.

- Contribute to the evolution of Spotify’s authorization frameworks, Spotify-specific implementations, enabling new platforms and product experiences.

- Drive technical improvements, share knowledge with teammates, and help shape the long-term technical direction of delegated authorization and session management.

Who You Are

- You have strong proficiency in C++, along with experience building native iOS applications in Swift, or you're excited to develop your expertise in Swift while applying your C++ skills.

- You have experience designing, building, or maintaining security-sensitive systems such as authorization, authentication, token management, credential storage, or related platforms.

- You bring a systems-thinking mindset and enjoy solving complex engineering challenges that span client and backend technologies.

- You have a solid understanding of software architecture, secure system design, and modern authorization protocols such as OAuth 2.0.

- You approach problems thoughtfully, with strong attention to detail and a focus on building secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions.

- You communicate clearly and enjoy collaborating with engineers across multiple teams and technical disciplines.

- You have experience working with shared cross-platform codebases and understand how native platform layers interact with common C++ libraries.

- You enjoy working on large-scale distributed systems where your contributions improve experiences for hundreds of millions of Spotify users.

Where You'll Be

- This role is based in London or Stockholm. 

- We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Compensation

Additional Information

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

title: Director, AI Platforms
description:
About Life360 

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com .

Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above. 

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

The AI Platforms team builds the shared foundation that lets Life360 use AI quickly and safely. Today, that means powering AI adoption and productivity across the company: model access, agent tooling, and the infrastructure our engineers rely on every day. We work side by side with the teams that are reshaping how Life360 builds with agents. We’ll carry these AI foundations as we look forward towards our future AI product strategy.

About the Job

As the Director of AI Platforms, you will build and lead the team through a defining shift: from supporting how Life360 works with AI to powering how AI shows up for our members. You will be a critical leader in our continued evolution for our agentic product development lifecycle (PDLC), turning early momentum into shared platforms, paved roads, and measurable results. Looking forward, you’ll shape how the platform supports AI inference and AI-powered features within our product. 

You will report to the Chief Information Security Officer with close partnership across our entire leadership team.

The US-based salary range for this position is $216,500 to $318,500 USD. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers. 

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) , as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits. 

What You’ll Do

- Set the direction for the AI Platforms team, with a clear roadmap that balances today's internal needs with where the product is going

- Lead and scale the team to full capacity by strategically hiring and continuing to develop current team members.

- Build and evolve the shared AI platform: model access and routing, agent runtime, MCP integrations, evals, agent identity, and cost controls

- Define and own our AI end-user platforms, enabling a multiplayer ecosystem working side by side with agents

- Partner with core teams to evolve our Agentic PDLC, including the tools, environments, review practices, and workflows through which AI agents help plan, write, test, review, and ship code

- Extend the platform from internal productivity to the product, defining how product teams access, run, and monitor AI inference and AI-powered features in production at member scale

- Drive adoption by making the right way the easy way: paved paths, reusable skills and components, champions, and enablement that engineers choose to use

- Partner with Security, Privacy, and Legal to build data handling, auditability, and safeguards into the platform from day one, with the trust our members expect from a family safety company

- Define and report outcomes that matter, such as adoption, quality, cost per outcome, and time to ship, rather than usage counts

- Stay close to the work: review designs, unblock teams, and make build-versus-buy calls as the model and tooling landscape change

What We’re Looking For

- 10+ years of engineering experience

- 5+ years experience leading engineering teams that build platforms or infrastructure used by other engineers

- Experience building and operating production AI systems, such as agentic workflows, large language model (LLM) integrations, retrieval, and evaluation

- Working knowledge of MCP and agent orchestration, including how agents connect to internal systems with appropriate controls

- Familiarity with AI inference in production, including serving, latency, reliability, provider management, and cost

- Experience driving the adoption of new engineering practices across a large engineering organization through influence, without becoming the bottleneck

- Hands-on technical judgment: comfortable reviewing architecture, setting technical direction, and staying close to implementation

- Comfort working where the platform, the operating model, and the product use cases are all taking shape at once, and a clear communicator with both executives and engineers

- Nice to have: experience with consumer-scale mobile products or privacy-sensitive data

Our Benefits

- Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees)

- Paid parental leave

- 401(k) plan with company matching program

- Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being

- Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns

- Learning & Development programs

- Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment

- Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference 

- Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust. 

- Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.

- Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families. 

- High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done. 

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status. 

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

title: Senior Software Engineer, Growth
description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

**This is a Permanent role ("Umowa o pracę") and not a B2B contract** 

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Growth team , you will be a critical part of our growing company, working at the intersection of engineering, product, marketing, and data science to accelerate product growth through rapid experimentation, data analysis, and scalable technical solutions. You’ll implement and drive best practices in technology, architecture, and process while optimizing funnels, automating growth loops, and shipping features that drive measurable impact.

You’ll have the chance to work in an open and collaborative environment, receive and give hands-on mentorship, and have opportunities to grow and accelerate your career. You love both learning and teaching, enjoy working cross-functionally to solve hard problems, and strive for quality — obsessing over automation, performance, and squashing any bugs that sneak through.

Our tech stack: Ruby/RoR, React.js, TypeScript, Redux, Node.js, Python, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Ansible, Terraform, Grafana, Kibana, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/GCP, GitHub Actions.

Daily Adventures and Responsibilities

- Develop and execute engineering strategies that enable rapid experimentation and data-driven decision-making

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Design, Marketing, Data Science, and Engineering to optimize key growth metrics and contribute to core product initiatives

- Architect and build scalable systems that support growth initiatives, such as onboarding flows, personalization engines, and viral loops

- Implement A/B testing and data instrumentation to ensure accurate tracking and measurement of experiments

- Leverage automation and machine learning to optimize user engagement, reduce churn, and personalize user experiences

- Produce clean, well-structured, well-documented code and implement pixel-perfect designs that work across browsers, per spec

- Help maintain code quality, organization, automation, and continuous delivery

- Ensure technical excellence through best practices in performance optimization, security, and scalability

- Effectively communicate development progress or blockers to the product lead, engineering manager, and other stakeholders

- Work effectively as part of a large global team; attend and engage in stand-ups, team meetings, and manager 1:1s

- Give and receive constructive feedback and praise

Competencies

- Proactively acts without being told what to do; identifies areas of improvement and drives best practices to deliver high-quality, performant, scalable solutions

- Takes ownership over everything shipped

- Communicates effectively, clearly, and concisely — technical and non-technical, written and verbal — and actively listens to ensure understanding

- Helps teammates overcome obstacles, resolve blockers, and complete work; shares credit where due

- Actively seeks out and acts on feedback as a tool for growth

- Confident in owning their role and bringing creative ideas to users

- Excellent leadership and stakeholder management skills

- Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward action; obsession with metrics (LTV, CAC, retention) and rapid iteration

Skills & Relevant Experience

- Proven experience leveraging AI tools to enhance software development (code generation, debugging, productivity optimization), with fluency integrating AI-driven solutions into your workflow and a willingness to stay current with emerging AI technologies

- BS in Computer Science, or equivalent

- Minimum 8 years of industry experience in frontend or full-stack development, building large-scale applications

- Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6)/TypeScript, React, Redux, HTML, CSS, and at least one backend language (Ruby/RoR, Python, or Node.js)

- Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP) and REST APIs

- Experience with analytics tools (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics) and A/B testing platforms (e.g., Optimizely, LaunchDarkly, Segment)

- Familiarity with growth frameworks (e.g., Pirate Metrics, viral loops)

- Strong UX and product sense, with the ability to negotiate the right MVP

- Strong attention to detail; interest in building UI with performance, accessibility, and scalability in mind

Nice-to-Haves

- Experience with growth at a startup or scaling product

- Knowledge of SEO, CRM tools (Braze, HubSpot), or marketing automation

We are AI Native

Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.

Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency , and learn voraciously to stay ahead.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact . Collaboration is at our core—we’re all for one , meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action , giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.

If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you. 

Learn more here!

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Overview of the role 

We’re on a mission to modernize insurance, making it simpler, more accessible, and customer-first. The insurance industry is a $1T market that’s remained largely untouched by the digital revolution, and PolicyMe is here to change that. As a remote-first, Toronto-based startup with big ambitions, we’re building the future of insurance in Canada and beyond.

We're building a groundbreaking new product line that will transform the insurance broker experience through AI and machine learning. You will work across the stack, contributing to front end, back end, and AI/ML initiatives, while also participating in architecture discussions, release planning, and company-wide engineering initiatives. Our core stack includes Python, React, Redux, PostgreSQL, n8n, LangChain/LangGraph and AWS , and we are always open to adopting new tools and technologies that help us deliver better results

What you'll be doing:

- Leading the design and development of full stack features for our AI-powered web application using Python, React, Redux, PostgreSQL, and AWS

- Defining the technical vision and architectural principles for AI/ML systems

- Driving innovation by researching and prototyping cutting-edge AI technologies

- Ensuring security, scalability, and observability best practices across cloud architecture

- Work within a cross-functional environment partnering closely with product, design, and business teams to communicate technical designs/strategies

- Serve as a role model for engineering standards and bring consistency across systems and processes while mentoring junior and intermediate engineers

- Help drive sound technical decision-making across ambiguous, system-spanning problems

What we are looking for:

- A strong technical background with 5+ years of experience in fullstack web development and production AI/ML systems

- Deep expertise in AI/ML domains like NLP, computer vision, recommendation engines etc.

- Proficiency with cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, microservices

- Proven ability to architect and lead end-to-end AI projects, including security best practices

- Exceptional technical communication and knowledge sharing abilities

- Track record of managing ambiguity and delivering innovative solutions

- An appreciation for fast-paced startup environments and experience building foundational systems

- Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous technical challenges and drive them to resolution with cross-functional teams

- Strong development skills in React, Python, and Node, or equivalent technologies with the ability to ramp up quickly

Why join us:

- Generous PTO - 20 vacation days

- A comprehensive benefits plan with premiums paid in full by PolicyMe

- Investment in your professional development, including an L&D budget, AI tooling budget, performance reviews twice a year and ongoing feedback to ensure you reach your highest potential

- An extremely high performing, low-ego, remote-first team that is truly disrupting an old industry

- Option to work from home or our Toronto-based office (bonus: we cover the costs to bring all our employees in-person twice a year for experiential socials!)

- Access to stock options based on performance

- Compensation: The total target cash compensation for this role is $154,000 - $176,000 CAD , based on experience. We’ll walk through the details together during the interview.

Compensation

Additional Information

About PolicyMe 

At PolicyMe, we are Canada’s leading digital insurance solution, offering straightforward and affordable financial protection for families from coast to coast. Our product suite includes Life Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and Health & Dental Insurance, all tailored to Canadians' evolving needs. We also offer B2B2C solutions, partnering with organizations to provide seamless digital insurance options. Founded by a team of insurance experts and technology entrepreneurs, PolicyMe is committed to making insurance simpler and more accessible. Since our launch in 2018, we have grown exponentially, selling over $10 billion in insurance coverage to Canadians.

We are proud of the team we’ve built and are excited for those that are yet to join us. We operate with a remote-first culture, attracting top talent from across Canada. If you’re looking for a fast-paced, collaborative environment, working alongside incredibly ambitious yet humble humans, we may be the right place for you! To learn more, visit www.policyme.com .

Additional Notes 

- Job Vacancy: This role reflects growth in our team and expanded operational scope. We’re hiring to support increasing demand and continue delivering an exceptional customer experience.

- Commitment to Equal Opportunity: PolicyMe is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and provide fair consideration regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

- Accessibility Statement: We are committed to providing an accessible hiring experience. If you require accommodations during the application process, please indicate this in the “Additional Information” section of your application.

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

- 
Collaborate with Kong Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities based on real-world customer feedback and implementation learnings.

- 
Create reusable best practices, technical assets, reference architectures, documentation, and design patterns to scale delivery excellence across the organization.

- 
Support strategic customer initiatives involving AI connectivity, governance, platform modernization, and cloud-native transformation.

What You’ll Bring: 

Experience 

- 
8+ years in customer-facing engineering, platform engineering, professional services, site reliability engineering, or software engineering roles.

- 
Strong hands-on software engineering and implementation experience.

- 
Experience with API gateways, API management, integrations, or distributed systems platforms.

- 
Strong Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure expertise.

- 
Experience building automation frameworks, deployment tooling, CI/CD pipelines, or migration tooling.

- 
Strong proficiency in Linux, networking, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps practices.

- 
Experience with major cloud providers including AWS, Azure, or GCP.

-

title: Senior Software Engineer (Elixir)
description:
Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment.

We think that's because the problem needed AI, not just better software, before it was solvable. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona , and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here .

About the Role 

We're hiring Senior Software Engineers to join our product teams and help build the next generation of workforce management. This isn't a traditional engineering role - at Sona, engineers are deeply embedded in the product development process, working directly with customers to understand their pain points and turning those insights into shipped solutions.

AI tooling is central to how we work. Coding agents produce the majority of our code, and your job is to direct, correct, and architect - not type every line yourself. You'll use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or similar as a core part of your daily workflow, and we'll assess that proficiency as part of the interview process. To do that well, you need strong Elixir expertise - enough to know when an agent's output is wrong and how to fix it.

Day to day, you'll work within a cross-functional product team with significant autonomy over how to reach outcomes. You'll participate in defining features and scope from PR FAQs and kick-off conversations rather than picking up fully specified tickets. You'll also have the opportunity to rotate across different product domains throughout the year - scheduling, payroll, HR, staff engagement - giving you breadth that most engineering roles don't offer.

This role is remote-first for anyone based in a European timezone, with quarterly in-person team alignment sessions and client workshops in London. It's not a fully isolated remote setup - you'll need flexibility to travel for the moments that matter.

Responsibilities 

- 
Own features end-to-end across Sona's platform, from scoping through to delivery, including in the mobile app

- 
Use AI development tooling as your primary workflow - directing and evaluating agent-produced code, not writing everything from scratch

- 
Work directly with customers through workshops, feedback sessions, and discovery conversations to ensure what you build solves real problems

- 
Collaborate closely with Product Managers and Product Designers to shape solutions from vague requirements and kick-off outputs

- 
Contribute to multiple product domains across the year, building deep understanding of workforce management challenges

- 
Participate in the product development process - challenging scope, suggesting approaches, and making pragmatic trade-offs between the ideal solution and the right one for now

Requirements 

- 
You're a senior engineer who's comfortable owning features from scoping to production - not just executing against a spec

- 
You have professional Elixir experience - enough to evaluate and correct agent-produced code in a production codebase

- 
AI development tooling is already embedded in how you work, not something you've experimented with once or twice. You can articulate your workflows and demonstrate them under pressure

- 
You care about understanding customer problems as much as solving technical ones, and you're comfortable being in front of customers directly

- 
You communicate clearly and concisely - adapting for technical and non-technical audiences alike

- 
You're pragmatic: you can let go of a strongly held opinion when the situation calls for it, and you make trade-offs consciously

- 
Bonus: full-stack experience including React Native, background at a product-led engineering team or high-growth B2B SaaS company, or familiarity with HR/workforce management domains

Benefits 

- 
Salary: £85-105k

- 
Remote-first (Europe timezone) with quarterly in-person sessions and client workshops in London

- 
Share options

- 
35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days)

- 
Extra day of leave for every year of service

- 
Pension contributions matched up to 5%

- 
Comprehensive health insurance

- 
Enhanced parental leave & pay

- 
Salary sacrifice childcare scheme (Workplace Nursery)

- 
Co-working space stipend for those based outside London

- 
Annual all expenses paid team retreats

- 
The latest Macbook and equipment budget for your home office

- 
Professional development budget

- 
Unlimited free books

Note: this represents a typical salary and benefits package for a UK-based, full-time employee. Exact details may vary based on location and employment type but we try to be as fair as possible to all of our team members. Please ask your contact in the Talent team to clarify the available benefits for you.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Identity and Access Management
description:
